Some models fabricate details and produce output more harmful than the source material, others defuse claims even while complying, and fact-checking rates vary from 2.9% to 72.9%. Integrity against information operations is at least partly related to refusal to produce content even for benign claims, illustrating the challenge of balancing model usability with safety. With one exception ( this http URL 's GLM 5.2), the Chinese-developed models sharply cut compliance on factually grounded but China-critical claims, dropping 48-70 percentage points relative to matched benign claims.

### [179] [Selective Credibility-Limited Belief Update](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28523)
*Theofanis Aravanis,Costas D. Koutras*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的信念更新框架——选择性可信度受限信念更新（SCL），通过在每个源世界中将认知输入转化为较弱的代理后再执行可信度受限转移，实现对复合认知输入的部分接受，从而统一并扩展了现有的Katsuno-Mendelzon（KM）、可信度受限（CL）和一致可信度受限（CCL）信念更新方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可信度受限信念更新方法将认知输入视为不可分割的整体，要么完全接受、要么完全拒绝，无法表达复合输入中仅有部分可被实现的中间情况。例如，当机器人被指示"将杯子移到桌上并装满它"，若杯子已破损，只能执行移动部分而无法装满，但KM更新会产生物理不可能的结果，CL更新会消除整个源分支，CCL更新则拒绝整个指令并保留源世界不变，均无法刻画这种部分实现的情形。

Method: 方法包括：(1) 语义层面——为每个源世界w配备可信度忠实赋值(C_w, ⪯_w)和点式变换函数f_w，将认知输入φ在每个源世界处独立地变换为较弱的代理f_w(φ)，然后选取C_w中满足该代理的最可信世界；(2) 公理化层面——用选择性变体(K⋄2)^S、(K⋄6)^S、(K⋄8)^S替代KM的对应公理，并新增局部可信度公理(LC)；(3) 变换函数需满足性质(F1)蕴含、(F2)外延性、(F3)幂等性、(F4)弱最大性，并定义两个良性子类——一致性保持型（增加F5）和极大一致性保持型（再增加F6极大性要求），证明其表示定理及与现有框架的严格包含关系。

Result: 本文证明SCL更新算子在语义上由可信度忠实赋值与点式变换赋值共同确定，建立了对应的公理化表示定理（定理16、19、22），并证明CL更新可由恒等变换恢复，CCL更新可由保留源世界的变换恢复，KM更新在移除可信度限制且变换为恒等时恢复。所包含关系均为严格真包含（SCL ⊋ 一致性保持SCL ⊋ 极大一致性保持SCL ⊋ CCL/KM ⊋ KM ∩ CL；CL ⊋ SCL中的非一致性保持部分）。通过杯子场景示例展示SCL是唯一同时保持破损杯子分支、尊重物理约束并刻画复合后置条件部分实现的更新机制。

Conclusion: 选择性可信度受限信念更新提供了一个统一且严格更具表达力的信念更新框架，涵盖了KM、CL和CCL等既有方法，同时支持源相关的选择性接受。未来研究方向包括：研究基于(F1)-(F3)的更松弛变体、变换函数的额外性质（如单调性、否定条件、合取与析取分配等）、代理的存在性与唯一性、计算复杂性分析，以及迭代信念更新、多智能体设置和行动形式语义等扩展。

Abstract: Belief update concerns changes in an agent's beliefs induced by changes in the underlying world. Standard Katsuno-Mendelzon update assumes that an epistemic input can be incorporated from every initially possible world, whereas credibility-limited belief update restricts, for each source world, the successor worlds regarded as credible or reachable. Nevertheless, existing credibility-limited approaches treat the epistemic input as an indivisible whole, and therefore cannot represent cases in which only part of a compound epistemic input can be realized. We introduce selective credibility-limited belief update, in which the epistemic input is transformed, relative to each source world, into a weaker proxy before the credibility-limited transition is performed. We provide semantic and axiomatic characterizations of the resulting class of update operators. We then identify two well-behaved sub-classes; namely, consistency-preserving update operators, which require every transformed epistemic input to be credible from its source world whenever the original epistemic input is consistent, and maximal consistency-preserving update operators, which additionally require the selected proxy to be maximally informative among the credible consequences of the original epistemic input. Finally, we establish the generality of the proposed framework by showing that credibility-limited belief update is recovered as a special case, while Katsuno--Mendelzon belief update emerges when credibility restrictions are removed and the transformation functions are taken to be identities. These results demonstrate that the framework provides a unified and strictly more expressive account of belief update, encompassing established approaches while supporting source-dependent selective acceptance.

</details>


### [180] [MANTA: Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation for Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28527)
*Mao-xun Huang,Jerry Wang,Yi-Cheng Lai,Zhengxin Zhang,Claire Cardie,Hen-Hsen Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MANTA提出了一种多智能体网络拓扑自适应框架，使LLM多智能体系统的通信结构能够在推理时动态演化——任务前根据先验经验初始化拓扑，执行中通过轨迹审计和有限的结构变异进行局部修复，无需更新模型权重即可在五个基准上以74.0的平均分超越最强基线5.8个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统将通信拓扑视为固定的设计选择或离线优化目标；既有的自改进方法（如Self-Refine、APO、DSPy、Reflexion、AFlow、MASS等）分别针对输出、提示、推理轨迹、记忆或工作流进行优化，但均无法在推理过程中自适应地改变智能体间的组织与通信结构。该研究提出核心问题：多智能体系统能否在求解每个具体任务的过程中在线改进其通信拓扑，而无需训练或离线搜索。

Method: MANTA由三个LLM元智能体（Topology Planner、Trace Auditor、Skill Reflector）与确定性代码组成，采用双层结构：目标多智能体系统负责任务求解，编排层负责任务前规划与执行中审计。流程包括：(1) 任务条件化初始规划——Planner根据任务与长期经验库选择交互模式、智能体数量与角色，确定性代码扩展并验证拓扑；(2) 轮次执行——通过结构化中继包传递信息，由共享上下文控制器强制信息可见性策略，并维护仅追加的证据账本；(3) 轨迹审计与修复——审计器扫描固定的过程异常分类法（含9种失败模式）与开放集新发现，决定是否触发至多一次的有限结构变异（每次变异至多3个操作）；(4) 双时域记忆——短期playbook记录当前运行的各轮状态，长期playbook由Reflector每N轮基于过程信号（而非真实标签）重写可迁移的结构经验。可用的变异操作包括add_agent、expand_agent_to_group、set_group_pattern、add_edge、remove_edge、set_context_policy，初始智能体上限为5，修复后总智能体上限为10。

Result: 在BrowseComp、StableToolBench、PlanCraft、WorkBench与MATH五个基准上（每基准30题、3次独立运行、使用Gemma 4 31B），MANTA取得最高平均分74.0，较最强基线提升5.8个百分点，并在PlanCraft上取得最佳成绩76.7。消融实验表明：去除任务条件化初始规划使成功率从71.7%降至57.5%（最大降幅），去除拓扑变异降至60.8%，冻结或移除长期playbook分别降至67.5%与66.7%。变异预算分析显示第一次变异贡献最大。长期playbook在跨域迁移（PlanCraft↔WorkBench）中平均带来+3.3的提升，而基线方法在跨域迁移中均为负向。MANTA同时是评估的多智能体系统中token消耗最低的（平均77,652 token/运行），元层操作仅占约12%。案例分析展示了分支扩展、串行化执行、重连通信与插入验证者等多种结构变异形式。审计器在450次运行中将无修复标志的运行正确率（83.2%）与有标志的运行正确率（62.5%）区分出20.7个百分点的差距。

Conclusion: MANTA将通信拓扑确立为多智能体系统自改进的一个独立层次，证明有效的结构适应不一定意味着增加智能体数量——改变执行顺序、重连通信、添加验证角色同样关键。该框架开辟了一条路径：智能体系统能够根据执行过程中涌现的失败信号动态重组其协作过程，而无需依赖权重更新或离线下游搜索，为自适应多智能体架构提供了新方向。

Abstract: Large language model-based multi-agent systems improve complex problem solving through task decomposition, agent specialization, information exchange, and intermediate validation. However, existing systems typically treat communication topology as a fixed design choice or an offline optimization target. We introduce MANTA, a framework for Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation that enables communication structures to self-evolve at inference time. Before execution, MANTA initializes a task-conditioned topology from prior structural experience. During deployment, it monitors collaboration traces and applies bounded structural updates when the current organization becomes insufficient. These updates can modify agent roles, communication links, execution order, information visibility, and validation pathways while preserving the task interface and agent budget. We evaluate MANTA against representative single-agent and multi-agent baselines on five benchmarks spanning information seeking, tool use, planning, workflow execution, and mathematical reasoning. MANTA achieves the highest average score of 74.0, outperforming the strongest baseline by 5.8 percentage points and obtaining the best result on PlanCraft. These results show that inference-time self-improvement can extend to the architecture of collaboration itself.

</details>


### [181] [Rethinking Inference-Time Scaling in Local Computer-Use Agents: Failure Modes and Compute Tradeoffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28573)
*Woongkyu Lee,Jungwook Choi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了本地(资源受限)计算机使用代理(CUA)中推理时计算扩展的效果,在OSWorld基准上评估了Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B、UI-TARS-1.5-7B和OpenCUA-7B等本地模型。研究发现,在上下文、时序、结构和并行四个维度上增加推理计算往往产生收益递减效应,主要改变失败模式而非提升任务成功率。本地CUA需要选择性计算分配、失败感知控制机制以及与本地模型能力相匹配的代理框架设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿计算机使用代理(如Agent S3、GTA-1)已证明推理时扩展能显著提升任务成功率,但这些方法主要针对大型专有模型。当前的核心矛盾在于:本地小型开源模型在严格的硬件约束下部署,但推理时扩展在本地资源受限模型上的有效性和失败模式尚不清楚。本研究旨在填补这一空白,系统分析本地CUA中推理时计算扩展的边际效用与失败行为。

Method: 1. 框架分类:将CUA分为单代理(直接端到端映射)和两阶段代理(规划+接地)两种架构。
2. 四个扩展维度:(a)上下文扩展H∈{0,1,4,8}截图历史长度;(b)时序扩展S∈{15,50,100}最大步数;(c)结构分解(单代理vs两阶段);(d)并行扩展P∈{1,2,4}候选计划数。
3. 评估设置:OSWorld基准361个Ubuntu任务,A100-80GB GPU,vLLM推理引擎,使用任务成功率和prompt token使用量作为主要指标。
4. 失败模式分析:跟踪最大步停滞、重复循环、过早假成功、格式错误等失败模式的变化。

Result: 1. 上下文扩展:从H=0到H=1带来巨大提升(约18%→25%),H=4达到最佳(28.56%),但H=8(27.16%)收益饱和。失败模式从重复循环转向过早假成功。
2. 时序扩展:S从15增加到100,任务成功率几乎不变,运营成本线性增加,失败从最大步停滞转向过早假成功。
3. 结构分解:两阶段代理持续低于单代理基线,因本地模型规划能力有限及格式解析错误引入额外开销。
4. 并行扩展:P从1增加到4部分恢复性能并减少格式错误,但token消耗急剧增加,收益相对于计算呈亚线性。
5. 总体结论:额外计算主要重新分配失败模式而非提升成功率,需要选择性计算分配。

Conclusion: 本地CUA的设计应从"无限制推理时扩展"转向"选择性计算分配"和"失败感知控制"。具体建议:采用中等历史长度(H=4)、有界时序预算、结构简单的代理设计、谨慎使用并行扩展。未来研究方向包括高效上下文管理(选择性记忆保留)、失败感知代理控制(循环检测、轨迹修正、任务完成验证)以及与本地模型能力匹配的代理框架设计。本地CUA的进步应更少依赖增加推理计算,更多依赖围绕本地模型能力与限制的智能代理设计。

Abstract: Deploying autonomous computer-use agents (CUAs) locally is increasingly important for privacy, cost efficiency, and practical usability, yet improving their performance under strict hardware constraints remains challenging. While recent studies show that inference-time scaling can improve frontier computer-use agents through additional computation during execution, its effectiveness for resource-constrained local models remains poorly understood. We present a systematic empirical study of inference-time scaling in local CUAs across contextual, temporal, structural, and parallel dimensions. We evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B, UI-TARS-1.5-7B, and OpenCUA-7B on the OSWorld benchmark. Our results show that additional computation often yields diminishing returns while changing failure modes. Contextual scaling provides historical grounding that improves trajectory stability and task accuracy, but its gains saturate as token cost increases and failures shift from repetitive or stalled trajectories toward premature false successes. Temporal scaling similarly reduces max-step stalls, yet does not substantially improve task success, indicating that longer horizons often extend erroneous trajectories rather than correct them. We further find that structural decomposition can introduce planning and formatting overhead in local two-stage agents, while parallel scaling partially mitigates these failures at a substantial computational cost. Overall, our findings suggest that efficient local CUAs require selective compute allocation, failure-aware control mechanisms, and agentic frameworks designed around the capabilities and limitations of local models.

</details>


### [182] [DualG-MRAG: Decoupling Macro-Reasoning and Micro-Matching for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28580)
*Jiacheng Tao,Qingyun Sun,Haonan Yuan,Ziwei Zhang,Jianxin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 DualG-MRAG，一种面向多模态检索增强生成（MM-RAG）的双层图框架，通过解耦宏观推理图（Macro Graph）与微观匹配图（Micro Graph），结合查询驱动的 GNN 检索器与动态规划路径解码机制，有效缓解多模态场景下图扩展爆炸与检索噪声问题，在复杂多跳问答任务上显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MM-RAG 方法主要依赖独立实例级的向量匹配，难以捕捉跨模态与跨文档的显式关系；图增强方法虽引入结构建模，但在多模态场景下面临两难困境：引入细粒度视觉特征会导致图规模爆炸与检索噪声，而粗粒度表示又会丢失关键局部证据。此外，静态图结构无法适应查询的动态需求，且传统方法将检索结果以扁平化文档块形式输入生成模型，迫使 MLLM 隐式重建跨文档关系，加重其推理负担。

Method: 1. **双层图构建**：宏观推理图（Macro Graph）基于 OpenIE 抽取实体关系三元组并融合等价边，提供全局拓扑骨架；微观匹配图（Micro Graph）以四元组 (u, r, v, d) 形式捕捉图像/表格内部的细粒度依赖，通过文档指针 d 关联原始视觉证据。2. **结构匹配与证据融合**：通过跨层对齐函数 C(·) 将微观事实映射至宏观实体；采用 LLM 解析器生成约束图 T_cond 与目标图 T_target，利用分支限界启发式算法在 Top-K 子空间内近似子图匹配；融合图级与节点级得分形成 s_micro。3. **查询驱动 GNN 检索器**：基于 NBFNet 架构，以激活掩码 m_q 初始化节点隐藏状态，通过 L 层关系消息传递（DistMult 操作）动态传播相关性，并将节点得分投影至文档空间，经视觉得分调制后取文本/视觉最大值得最终排序。4. **显式路径解码**：定义局部流概率 F^(l)(u→v)，利用层间消息传递天然形成的 L 跳 DAG，通过动态规划（类似 Viterbi 算法）回溯提取最优推理路径，并序列化为结构化证据图指导 MLLM 生成。

Result: 在 MMQA、WebQA、ScienceQA 三个多跳推理基准上均取得最优性能：MMQA 上以 Qwen3-VL-4B 为骨干时 EM 达 44.20%，超越最强基线 7 个绝对百分点；WebQA 上 ROUGE-L 与 BERTScore 同步领先；ScienceQA 上平均准确率 90.99%，在 IMG 子集（91.52%）、G7-12 高年级（87.87%）与 NAT 自然科学（90.36%）上均表现突出。检索方面，MMQA 上 R@5 达 61.9%，显著优于 MMGraphRAG 的 42.1%；效率方面，平均查询延迟约 0.44 秒，远低于 MMGraphRAG 的 40.5 秒。消融实验表明宏观图、微观图与路径注入模块均不可或缺，其中宏观图的移除导致 R@5 从 61.9% 骤降至 21.8%。

Conclusion: DualG-MRAG 通过宏观-微观图解耦设计、查询驱动的动态 GNN 消息传递以及基于动态规划的显式路径解码，有效平衡了多模态 RAG 中结构推理深度与检索噪声抑制的矛盾，将碎片化证据转化为可验证的拓扑推理链，从而显著提升复杂多跳问答的检索召回率与最终生成质量，并为图增强多模态检索提供了一种兼顾效率与效果的新范式。

Abstract: While Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MM-RAG) has shown promising results, it still struggles with complex multi-hop reasoning tasks. Existing methods primarily focus on independent instance-level matching, which often fails to capture explicit relationships across modalities and documents. Although Graph-enhanced methods introduce structural modeling, they face a fundamental challenge in multimodal scenarios: incorporating fine-grained visual features leads to rapid graph expansion and retrieval noise, whereas coarse-grained representations cause the discarding of critical local evidence. To address this dilemma, we propose DualG-MRAG, a Dual-tier framework that introduces a decoupled architecture comprising Macro-reasoning and Micro-matching Graphs for Multimodal RAG. Specifically, to suppress retrieval noise by isolating global structural reasoning from fine-grained evidence matching, we construct a Macro Graph for global topological routing and a Micro Graph for precise local verification. Subsequently, to enable dynamic relevance propagation across heterogeneous evidence sources, we formulate retrieval as a query-driven message passing process via a GNN Retriever. Furthermore, to provide the generative model with coherent structural guidance, we introduce a dynamic programming decoding mechanism that extracts explicit reasoning paths directly from the GNN's forward pass, replacing the standard input of isolated document chunks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DualG-MRAG outperforms baselines in both evidence recall and complex QA accuracy.

</details>


### [183] [OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28609)
*Qiushi Sun,Kanzhi Cheng,Yian Wang,Bowen Yang,Hang Yan,Liheng Chen,Fangzhi Xu,Zichen Ding,Nuo Chen,Jialin Cao,Xingdong Gong,Zehao Li,Kaiming Jin,Xinfeng Yuan,Zhoumianze Liu,Jingyang Gong,Zhangyue Yin,Jiahui Gao,Zhiyong Wu,Tianbao Xie,Jianbing Zhang,Ben Kao,Lingpeng Kong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出OSReward基准（1019条跨四平台人工标注的CUA轨迹，含OSReward-Hard挑战集与OSReward-Multi细粒度评级），系统评估27个VLM判官，发现存在系统性"宽容偏差"（将失败误判为成功）；并发布OS-Shepherd-100K推理标注语料库与两个开源奖励模型（9B/35B），以SFT+GRPO两阶段训练在OSReward-Hard上以30-60倍低成本匹配商用闭源判官水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算机使用智能体(CUA)快速发展，但验证轨迹完成度成为评估、数据筛选和强化学习的瓶颈。人工编写的验证器覆盖范围有限，人工标注也无法规模化，因此业界普遍采用VLM作为轨迹判官。然而这些VLM判官的可靠性长期未经系统检验：判官会过度依赖智能体的文本叙述而非实际屏幕状态，且当前可靠的判官成本过高、无法支撑训练规模的奖励信号需求。

Method: 1) 构建跨平台数据基础设施（Web/Windows/Ubuntu/Mobile，含真实应用、登录账号、干扰内容），人工撰写并交叉审核约800条可执行指令；2) 由四个模型家族（Claude/Gemini/Kimi/Qwen）的智能体执行产生轨迹，经三方独立标注+元评审+困难集复审，最终获得1019条人工金标（其中284条困难样本、440条细粒度评级样本），耗时约800人时；3) 采用统一评判协议（末5帧+完整文本历史+贪婪解码）评估27个VLM判官；4) 利用多判官一致性筛选构建OS-Shepherd-100K语料库；5) 两阶段训练：先SFT（96.6K样本）建立基础判官能力，再GRPO强化学习（约3.1K样本，专门针对"假成功"错误模式）。

Result: 1) 判官性能存在上限：仅闭源前沿模型（Claude-Opus-4-8达89.7%）接近训练所需的90%阈值；2) 系统性宽容偏差：所有判官家族共享"接受不完整任务"为主导错误（占错误三分之二），将失败轨迹误判为成功；3) 困难集崩溃：在OSReward-Hard上最佳判官仅69.7%、均值降至52%，且宽容偏差加剧；4) 视觉输入影响小（改变截图数量变化<0.5pp），文本历史影响大（移除思维链损失7.2pp）；5) 思维增强/集成投票/解码重采样均无法显著提升判官可靠性；6) OS-Shepherd-9B在完整集上达86.1%（中等商用层级）、困难集60.2%，以约1.36美元的全集评判成本（仅为Claude-Opus-4-8的1/60）匹配商用判官能力，且去偏能力可迁移至OSWorld/WebArena/AndroidWorld等独立基准。

Conclusion: 通过OSReward标准化基准与OS-Shepherd开源奖励模型，本文证明了CUA轨迹评判中"假成功"这一关键错误模式可被低成本开源模型有效捕获。OS-Shepherd以30-60倍的成本优势提供可靠、稳定的训练规模奖励信号，跨基准泛化能力验证了其去偏效果的可迁移性，使学术预算下实现可扩展的CUA奖励信号成为可能。论文同时发布了代码、数据集与模型检查点。

Abstract: Computer-using agents (CUAs) are advancing rapidly across the digital world. A CUA trajectory records the agent's actions, states, and reasoning. Verifying whether it fulfilled the task instruction is central to CUA evaluation, data curation, and reinforcement learning. Neither human-written verifiers nor human annotators can provide such verification at scale, so the field increasingly turns to vision-language models (VLMs) as judges of CUA trajectories. But a fundamental question has long gone unexamined: are these VLM judges reliable enough? To study it systematically, we introduce OSReward, a realistic, high-quality benchmark that evaluates VLM judges on CUA trajectories. The trajectories come from diverse agent backbones executing human-verified instructions across platforms, then rigorously labeled with ground-truth verdicts through multi-stage human annotation. Building on it, we derive OSReward-Hard, a challenge set concentrating genuinely hard cases, and OSReward-Multi for fine-grained efficiency and alignment scoring. The most comprehensive evaluation of VLM judges to date finds even state-of-the-art models fall short of an ideal judge, sharing a systematic leniency bias that mislabels failed runs as successes. The few reliable enough to trust are too expensive to run at scale, while affordable open models trail far behind. To close this gap, we construct and release OS-Shepherd-100K, an open corpus of reasoning-annotated trajectory judgments for the CUA community. On it, we train OS-Shepherd (9B and 35B), open reward models that supply low-cost, stable, and reliable reward signals, matching commercial judges at 30-60% lower cost than the frontier. Extensive analyses further inform the design of reliable CUA reward at scale. Our code, benchmark, dataset, and model checkpoints are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [184] [AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28617)
*Xiangning Lin,Shenzhe Zhu,Shu Yang,Zhenyu Zhang,Haoqian Zhang,Yipeng Zhao,Chengxuan Qian,Tianwei Wang,Ziheng Zhang,Zhenlong Yuan,Dingcheng Wang,Juncheng Wu,Yuan Si,Jiaxin Liu,Baolong Bi,Robert Mahari,Tobin South,Dazza Greenwood,Zexue He,Rishi Bommasani,Sophia Kazinnik,Andreas Haupt,Samuele Marro,Erik Brynjolfsson,Alex Pentland,Jiaxin Pei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了AISPA（人工智能系统提示审计）框架，这是一个以用户为中心的系统提示审计框架，包含基于《世界人权宣言》的八个审计维度。作者使用人机协作流程对88款商业AI产品的3,249条系统提示指令进行了审计，揭示了用户保护指令日益普及但问题指令仍然普遍存在的现状，呼吁对系统提示进行更大的透明度、标准化的第三方监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统提示是开发人员配置的基础模型行为指令，但在商业AI产品中很少向用户或监管机构披露，形成了严重的信任与问责缺口。现有AI安全研究主要关注模型层面防护和对抗性输入防御，缺乏对系统提示本身的独立审查。尽管有调查显示近90%的用户要求提高系统提示透明度，但现实远未达到这一期望。此外，多起真实事件（如AI陪伴聊天机器人导致青少年自杀、Meta允许儿童浪漫聊天、Grok被指示扮演"阴谋论者"等）凸显了系统提示设计缺陷造成的实际伤害。该论文旨在填补这一治理空白。

Method: 1. 提出基于《世界人权宣言》的八维审计分类法：身份透明度（D1）、真实性与信息完整性（D2）、隐私与数据保护（D3）、工具/操作安全（D4）、用户自主性与操纵预防（D5）、不安全请求处理（D6）、伤害预防与用户安全（D7）、公平性与中立性（D8）。2. 设计了以"提示片段"（span）为基本分析单元的审计指南，区分核心逻辑片段和非核心逻辑片段，将每条指令标注为保护性（+1）或问题性（-1）。3. 实施三轮人机协作审计协议：第一轮使用Claude-4.6-Opus作为LLM预标注器生成候选片段；第二轮由六名经过培训的人工标注员独立审查（标注员间一致性IAA达0.933）；第三轮由三名领域专家进行最终审查，对问题性标签要求三人一致同意。4. 数据来源于六个GitHub开源仓库中公开披露的88款商业AI产品的系统提示，并通过维护者访谈和跨仓库内容重叠分析（Sørensen-Dice系数）验证数据真实性。

Result: 1. 系统提示设计在不同产品和企业间差异显著：Anthropic平均每产品62.3条保护性指令，接近零问题指令；而Venice平均仅有2.0条保护性指令和3.0条问题指令。2. 98.9%的产品包含至少一条保护性指令，但仅23.9%（21/88）覆盖全部八个维度，表明保护广度不足。3. 从2024到2025年，系统提示平均长度从约9K字符增至超30K字符，保护性指令数量翻倍（15.0→38.4），表明用户保护意识增强。4. 尽管趋势向好，约38.6%的产品仍含至少一条问题指令，保护性与问题性指令常共存于同一提示中。5. 维度间覆盖不平衡：D2（真实性）和D5（用户自主性）覆盖率超90%，而D6（不安全请求处理）和D3（隐私）仅约60%。6. 案例研究显示，Anthropic、OpenAI、xAI三大提供商的保护性指令在六代模型中均呈3-4倍增长，问题指令持续减少。7. 识别出29条"灰色地带"指令，分为四类：人类模仿与身份欺骗、准社会依赖暗示、用户主动权限覆盖、政治化或无限制的内容政策。

Conclusion: AISPA框架是首个系统化的系统提示审计方法，通过八维分类法和可扩展的人机协作审计流程，揭示了商业AI产品系统提示中用户保护的重大质量差距。虽然保护性指令越来越普遍，但全面覆盖仍然有限，约40%的产品包含损害用户利益的指令。该研究呼吁建立第三方审计机制，实施透明度认证、标准化和独立监管，以解决系统提示这一"被严重忽视却影响数十亿用户"的AI治理盲点。研究还表明，系统提示的法律责任已得到司法确认（上海法院判决），使提示层面的审查不仅是伦理必要，更是法律必然要求。

Abstract: System prompts are instructions configured by developers to govern the behaviors of foundation models in AI applications. They are used throughout commercial AI products, but are rarely disclosed to the public or regulators, creating a serious trust and accountability gap in the wide deployment of AI systems. In this paper, we introduce Artificial Intelligence System Prompt Assurance (AISPA), a user-centric framework for systematically auditing system prompts in AI systems. AISPA examines specific parts of a system prompt and evaluates them along eight dimensions that matter to users. We then use this framework to review 3,249 instructions from system prompts in 88 commercial AI products, classifying each instruction as either protective (of users) or problematic. Our audit surfaces four core findings. First, system prompt design varies substantially across products and developers, with some organizations averaging over 60 protective instructions per product while others average fewer than 5. Second, protective instructions are widely adopted but shallow in scope: 98.9% of products contain at least one, yet only 24% cover all eight dimensions of the AISPA taxonomy. Third, system prompts have grown steadily longer and more protective of users, suggesting that user protection is becoming a more visible concern in commercial prompt design. Fourth, despite this progress, problematic instructions remain pervasive: roughly 40% of products contain at least one instruction that works against user interests, and protective and problematic instructions frequently coexist within the same prompt. Our findings highlight the need for greater transparency, standardization, and independent oversight for system prompts in commercial AI products.

</details>


### [185] [Autonomous Event-Driven Multi-Agent Orchestration for Enterprise AI at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20058)
*Harsh Rao Dhanyamraju,Leonidas Raghav,Aaron Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对企业级多智能体系统（MAS）在持续事件监控与编排方面的不足，在208个生产场景中对比了DAG Plan-and-Execute与ReAct两种编排架构，并提出了包含优先级推理、相关事件合并与抢占机制的Task Manager，以支持连续运行。结果表明，智能体规模而非任务复杂度是主要瓶颈，且Task Manager在高优先级队列延迟与企业级相关事件正确性方面带来显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有企业级多智能体系统大多基于离散的请求-响应工作流，难以实现跨专业智能体的持续事件监控、检测与行动；同时，企业规模下编排性能如何变化、任务复杂度与系统规模何者主导性能等关键问题尚未得到系统性研究。

Method: 作者构建了208个源自生产实践的企业场景，覆盖Persona（<10智能体）、Department（20–80）和Enterprise（200）三种规模；评估对象为DAG Plan-and-Execute与ReAct两种主流智能体编排架构；并提出Task Manager模块，包含优先级推理、相关事件合并与抢占三种机制，以支持企业场景下的持续运行。

Result: 实验发现：（1）系统规模而非任务复杂度是编排性能的主导瓶颈，两种架构在小型场景表现良好，但随智能体规模扩大显著退化，根源在于智能体发现噪声；（2）简单任务反而比复杂任务退化更剧烈；（3）DAG Plan-and-Execute在小规模下精度更高且支持结构化并行，但开销较大，在企业级规模下劣势加剧；（4）ReAct因以增量方式处理失败，鲁棒性更强；（5）Task Manager将高优先级队列延迟降低14–75%，并将企业规模下相关事件正确性提升超过20个百分点。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了企业级多智能体编排中"规模噪声"这一核心挑战，强调编排策略需随智能体规模进行权衡选择（DAG偏向精度，ReAct偏向鲁棒性），并验证了通过Task Manager实现优先级调度与事件相关性管理是企业级持续运行的关键路径。

Abstract: Enterprise AI aims to move toward continuous event monitoring, detection, and action across specialist agents, yet existing multi-agent systems largely assume discrete request-response workflows and remain underexplored at enterprise scale. We evaluate DAG Plan and Execute and ReAct across 208 production-derived enterprise scenarios spanning Persona (<10 agents), Department (20-80), and Enterprise (200) scales, and introduce a Task Manager for continuous operation via priority inference, related-event merging, and preemption. Results show that scale, not task complexity, dominates orchestration performance: both architectures perform well at small scale but degrade at enterprise scale as agent discovery noise becomes the primary bottleneck, with simple tasks degrading more sharply than complex ones. DAG Plan and Execute offers higher precision and structured parallelization at smaller scales, but its higher overhead worsens at enterprise scale; ReAct is more robust by handling failures incrementally. The Task Manager reduces high-priority queue latency by 14-75% and improves related-event correctness by over 20 percentage points at enterprise scale.

</details>

### [186] [Recursive transformers for semiconductor thermo-mechanical reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27251)
*Kart-leong Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估并比较了三种用于小数据工程代理建模的递归权重共享 Transformer 架构（Tiny Recursive Model / Simple Recursive / 作者提出的 Depth Recursive），在半导体封装热-机械可靠性（应力与翘曲）与 Laplace PDE 电容场任务上，给出了面向资源受限场景的架构选型准则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程设计空间中的替代模型数据稀缺且维度低，标准 Transformer 因参数过多而容易过拟合并带来不必要的显存与算力开销，亟需以"额外计算"代替"额外可学习参数"的轻量化架构。

Method: 提出并对比三种参数共享的递归 Transformer：(1) TRM——通过耦合的双潜变量 Z、Y 反复迭代精炼；(2) DEPTH（本文提出）——将序列深度 S⁽ᵗ⁾ 作为外部状态注入共享权重的 RECUR，借鉴 RNN 隐状态思想；(3) SIMPLE——对同一 RECUR 重复堆叠 T 次。统一在七种配置（M1–M7）下，以 Recall@K、MRR、参数量、FLOPs 构建 Pareto 前沿，并在 Stress10K/Warpage10K（FEA）与 PINN 电容场（Laplace 偏微分方程）三套小数据集上验证。

Result: 在 MRR–FLOPs 与 MRR–Parameters 两条 Pareto 前沿上，本文提出的 DEPTH（M6、M7，1-Block 与 2-Block RMS 变体）一致占据最优或近优位置，以最少的参数量和最低的 FLOPs 取得最佳或次佳检索精度；SIMPLE（M2、M3）虽 FLOP 高效但精度受限；TRM（M4、M5）在所有数据集上均远离 Pareto 前沿，参数量与 FLOPs 开销大但未能换来对应的精度提升。

Conclusion: 将"深度"显式作为递归注入的状态并在 BPTT 中对每个递归输出施加独立损失，是实现精度/参数/算力三者折衷的关键机制；递归权重共享 Transformer 在小数据工程代理建模中具备良好的泛化性与实用价值，优于直接套用大参数量的常规 Transformer。

Abstract: Transformer-based surrogate models are increasingly used to replace expensive first-principles simulation in engineering design. But conventional transformer architectures are often over parameterized for the small, low-dimensional datasets typical of engineering design spaces, where large simulation data is expensive to generate. Under these conditions, excess parameter capacity leads to overfitting rather than improved accuracy, while also incurring unnecessary memory and compute overhead. This motivates a shift towards architectures that focus on additional compute rather than additional learnable parameters. This paper presents a hardware-aware evaluation of three recursive transformer paradigms for surrogate thermo-mechanical analysis of advanced packages: a)Tiny Recursive Model, b) our proposed Depth Recursive transformer, c) and a simple recursive transformer. We systematically compare their predictive performance (Recall, Mean Reciprocal Rank), parameter count, computational complexity (FLOPs), providing practical design guidelines for selecting recursive transformer architectures under resource-constrained scenarios. We validate this principle on two low-dimensional engineering prediction tasks: 1) thermo-mechanical reliability analysis of advanced semiconductor packages, where stress and warpage from thermal cycling must be evaluated repeatedly across a design-of-experiments sweep under costly finite element analysis (FEA). 2) Laplace PDE iterative numerical solver for capacitance field. Overall, recursive weight-sharing transformers provide an effective and generalizable trade-off between prediction accuracy, parameter efficiency, and computational cost for small data engineering surrogate modeling.

</details>


### [187] [Flat Score, Amplified Failures: How the Error Budget Masks Damage in Quantized LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27275)
*Jiwon Jang,Kisu Yang,Heuiseok Lim,Hyunwoo Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文发现，尽管4位权重量化在多轮工具调用智能体（agent）的标准任务得分上看起来"近乎无损"，但实际上将模型已有的失败模式放大了最高2.5倍。基准测试的容错预算（每次允许10次错误）掩盖了这一过程层面的损伤，使最终得分保持平稳，从而给出虚假的"安全"信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练4位权重量化在单轮评估中被广泛报告为"近乎无损"，但随着大语言模型越来越多地作为多轮工具调用智能体部署，这一结论是否仍然成立尚不清楚。更关键的问题是：标准智能体基准测试的最终任务得分能否检测到量化造成的损伤？本文旨在揭示"无损"结论是否以及为何会在智能体场景下产生误导。

Method: 研究在τ²-bench基准测试上进行，涵盖两个领域（零售和电信），每格456个回合。测试两个开源模型家族（Gemma-4和Qwen-3.6）的密集版与MoE版，以及额外的Qwen-3.5检查点，在BF16、FP8、INT4三种精度下运行。方法包括：（1）将失败分解为"工具名称幻觉"和"实体/参数错误"两个通道进行过程级度量；（2）使用任务聚类bootstrap和TOST等价性检验进行统计分析；（3）通过紧缩容错预算（K从10降到2）进行反事实分析以揭示被掩盖的损伤；（4）部署反射式修复循环作为缓解措施；（5）提出logit-margin理论解释放大机制。

Result: 主要发现：（1）最终得分在所有10个测试格中均无显著变化，量化看似"免费"；（2）在Gemma-4密集版电信领域，工具名称幻觉率从19.5%飙升至38.3%（放大2.5倍，649→1646次事件），而失败集合保持不变（BF16/INT4相关性0.97，仅0.18%为新失败）；（3）将容错预算从K=10紧缩到K=2后，分数差距从1.3分扩大到16.7分（约13倍），且仅在量化增加错误量的单元中暴露损伤；（4）反射式修复提示仅在受损单元（Gemma-4 INT4，+5.9分，p=.017）显著提升得分，其他单元无显著变化；（5）敏感性的决定因素是模型全精度下的失败倾向，而非模型规模或密集/MoE架构。

Conclusion: 智能体基准测试的最终任务得分在结构上对量化损伤"失明"，原因是其饱和性结果被环境的容错预算所缓冲。量化放大的是模型已有的失败集合，而非制造新失败；放大倍数取决于各模型-领域单元。模型的全精度失败倾向可作为廉价的风险筛选指标。建议在报告任务奖励的同时，报告各通道的错误率以及不同容错预算下的成功率，因为这些指标可直接从现有日志中提取，能更敏感地揭示底层损伤。松弛度低的实际部署面临的4位风险远大于单轮基准测试所显示的水平。

Abstract: Post-training quantization to 4-bit weights is widely reported to be nearly lossless. We test this claim for multi-turn, tool-calling agents, where it now matters most. On $\tau^2$-bench, across two open-weight model families in dense and MoE variants and two domains (eight cells, 456 episodes each, at 16-, 8-, and 4-bit weights), quantization indeed looks free on the standard metric. No cell shows a score change that survives multiple-comparison correction, and in the cell that carries the largest process damage, equivalence testing bounds the change within $\pm$7.5 points. The process tells a different story. Quantization amplifies the failure the model already exhibits at full precision (tool-name hallucination in telecom, with the same directional trend in retail entity errors) by up to 2.5$\times$ in volume (+17.6 points per task), while creating essentially no new failures. The failure set is the same at every precision (rank correlation $\geq$ 0.94, 0.18% novel events). The score stays flat because the benchmark's ten-error budget absorbs the extra failures. Shrinking the budget to two errors re-exposes a score gap of 17 points, and it does so only in the one cell where quantization added error volume, exactly as the masking account predicts. A targeted error-repair prompt, run for five telecom models at every precision, removes the damage exactly and only where it lives. Both diagnostics, the per-channel error rate and success under a shrinking budget, come from logs benchmarks already collect; we suggest reporting them alongside task reward.

</details>


### [188] [Benchmarking the Residual: What Long-Horizon Evaluations Add Beyond Matched Short-Task Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27283)
*Chao Peng,Zhiheng Lyu,Peijie Dong,Hande Dong,Qiang Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这是一篇立场论文，主张要诊断LLM智能体的"长视距失败"机制，基准测试必须将自然端到端成功率与基于匹配短阶段性能构建的基线预测进行比较。论文提出"视距残差"（horizon residual, Γ_H），即预期成功率与观察成功率的对数比值，作为一种协议特定的诊断指标，区分部署观察与机制声称，并将"更长就更难"从描述性观察转化为可审计的研究纲领。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的长视距基准测试普遍观察到任务越长成功率越低，但这种下降混淆了多种因素：(1) 更多阶段带来的普通错误复合；(2) 更长任务中固有的局部决策更难；(3) 轨迹诱导退化（trajectory-induced degradation），即早期执行的累积（包括上下文腐化context rot、状态污染、工具输出等）使后续工作更难。原始性能曲线无法区分这些因素，但相关结果常被赋予诊断性解读，超出了部署观察本身所能支持的范围。论文的核心动机是建立一个能够区分部署评估与机制诊断的严格框架。

Method: 方法包含六个核心要素：(1) 预先规范任务分解为语义可验证阶段，每个阶段由验收条件而非轮次定义；(2) 从声明的检查点运行同一部署的智能体，估计条件阶段成功率 q_i；(3) 构建可审计的乘积基线 P_expected = ∏q_i（当检查点形成单一兼容路径时），分支/恢复场景需用条件模型或检查点模拟器；(4) 计算视距残差 Γ_H = log(P_expected/P_observed)（自然对数，单位nats），并给出阶段级分解；(5) 提出工作暴露量（N_work）与依赖深度（H_dep）两个互补注释，将任务结构与局部难度分离；(6) 设计八步基准协议（预注册、定义检查点、匹配预算、审计局部性能、选择模型、运行与干预、敏感性测试、审计基准）。不确定性通过配对或分层自助法在完整任务单元上估计，解析公式（delta方法）仅作规划参考。

Result: 核心提议：(1) 视距残差 Γ_H 是协议特定的对数对比，不是因果测量——Γ_H>0 表示自然滚动比模型预测更差，Γ_H≈0 表示一致，Γ_H<0 表示自然滚动超出预测；(2) 区分三种效果来源及其所需控制：错误复合（测量匹配阶段并合成）、更难的局部工作（匹配局部难度分布）、历史依赖（比较保留与重置/压缩/修复的历史）；(3) 联合解读需同时考虑预期与观察成功率的高低组合；(4) 通过组件级审计表（Table 4）显示，在所综述的研究中，没有任何一项实现了完整序列（匹配局部测量、声明合成、自然滚动、状态兼容性处理、定向干预、协议敏感性分析）；(5) 提出三个可使立场被证伪的条件：协议间残差符号不稳定、兼容检查点无法以可管理成本构建、残差不提供超越现有持续-重置对比的增量诊断信息。

Conclusion: 论文得出最强形式的结论：下降的端到端曲线只能证明部署限制；若要声称长视距机制，则评估必须与端到端成功率一同报告：一份预先规范的组合预测及由此产生的残差。视距残差本身不是因果答案，而是历史、状态、信息与恢复等因素使长视距执行产生差异的"有纪律的起点"。该框架将"更长就更难"从描述性观察转化为可审计的研究纲领，并提出了五项议程：实例化对比、开发分支估计器、运行干预项目、绘制协议稳健性、将方法迁移至编码之外的领域。论文明确指出，其适用范围偏向具有可重放状态和语义验收条件的编码与终端任务，在其他领域的适用性仍是经验性问题。

Abstract: Long-horizon benchmarks often show that agents fail more as tasks become longer. This observation is useful for deployment, but it does not by itself explain why failure occurs. More stages create more opportunities for ordinary errors to compound; longer tasks may also contain harder individual decisions or become harder as conversation history, tool outputs, and environment changes accumulate. We use trajectory-induced degradation to mean this last possibility: earlier execution makes later work harder. When the harmful accumulation is specifically the text visible to the model, it is often called context rot. In this position paper, we argue that to claim a "long-horizon failure", benchmarks must compare actual full-task success against a baseline prediction built from short, individual stages. We call the log-ratio between this prediction and actual success the horizon residual. The comparison must use the same agent configuration and specify in advance how stages, checkpoints, information, and budgets will be chosen. The residual shows that the full rollout differs from the chosen baseline; targeted experiments are still needed to explain why.

</details>


### [189] [Explorative Modeling: Unlocking a Third Pretraining Axis and End-to-End Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27372)
*Alexi Gladstone,Heng Ji,Yilun Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"探索式建模"(Explorative Modeling, XM),一种通过分解训练循环(而非生成过程)来处理多模态分布的新型生成建模范式。核心思想是每步生成 K 个候选样本并仅训练其中最匹配真实数据的那个,从而直接提升模型的"生成表达力"(generative expressivity),既可作为现有生成模型的新预训练轴,也可实现端到端的可重构生成建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可扩展的重构型生成模型(Diffusion、Autoregressive、Flow Matching 等)都通过将生成过程分解为许多小步骤来规避模态模糊问题,这使得训练与推理分布不一致,产生了曝光偏差(曝露偏差)和误差累积。同时,模型的"生成表达力"由训练目标在设计时固定,无法随参数与数据扩展而增长,在大规模训练中逐渐成为性能瓶颈——表现之一是当下先进模型高度依赖 guidance。直接端到端回归则只能预测多模态分布的平均值,生成模糊而非真实的样本。本文试图回答:能否不分解生成过程,而改为分解训练循环,从而兼顾多模态处理能力与端到端生成?

Method: 1. **Forward XM(正向探索)**:对每个真实样本 x,生成 K 个候选样本 ŷ₁,...,ŷ_K,只对其中损失最小者(即与 x 最接近的一个)进行反向传播,本质上是一个 best-of-K 循环。推导表明,这一目标在大 K 极限下等价于最小化数据分布与生成模型(经损失核平滑后)的前向 KL 散度,即在任意 K 下都执行最大似然估计。2. **Reverse XM(反向探索)**:固定一个生成样本,在 K 个数据样本中搜索最近邻进行训练,优化方向对应反向 KL(模式寻求型,可能塌缩)。3. **混合 X 模型**:可将探索机制叠加到 Diffusion/Flow Matching、Jumpy、MDLM 等现有生成模型上,只需改变噪声采样方式,不动原有超参。4. **实现细节**:将 K 个候选折叠进 batch 维度以并行计算;只对最佳候选反向传播,可节省显存。论文通过"生成表达力"(损失极小值能保留的模态数)这一形式化定义,将 K 与模型可捕获的模态数直接挂钩。

Result: 1. **效率提升**:在 RAE 强图像生成配方上,探索带来 4.1× FLOP 效率提升、6.2× 样本效率提升、47% 参数效率提升;在 SiT 基础上带来 52% FLOP 效率提升。2. **SOTA 结果**:XRAE 在 ImageNet 256×256 上无 guidance 时达到接近 SOTA 的 gFID 1.43,FDr⁶ 优于基线;收敛速度比标准 SiT 快近 300×。3. **规模可叠加性增益**:随数据规模扩大,探索带来的增益从 7% 提升至 36%;随模型规模扩大,从 13% 提升至 23%;在 3× 计算量下效率增益翻倍。4. **跨模态有效性**:在图像、视频、掩码扩散语言模型(XMDLM)上探索均单调提升性能(FID/FVD/困惑度-熵前沿)。5. **泛化与端到端性**:探索提高了验证集最优 FVD(Something-Something V2 上从 37.5 降至 30.0),直接增加了"计算-泛化权衡";随探索增加,最佳模型变得更为端到端(Jumpy 模型所需跳数下降)。6. **端到端机器人控制**:Explorative Policy 在 Robomimic 行为克隆上以 1 次前向推理匹配 Diffusion Policy 的 100 步;Explorative World Model 在 Maze2D 目标条件世界建模上以平均 80×(最高 256×)更少的 NFE 超越 Diffuser。

Conclusion: 本文将"探索"确立为继参数、数据之后的第三个预训练轴,首次系统性地将生成表达力提升作为独立可优化对象。主要贡献包括:(1)将 best-of-K 从零散技巧上升为针对多模态分布的统一原理;(2)实验验证探索增益随规模增长而非饱和;(3)证实分解生成与分解训练在数学与经验上均可互相替代,从而把"模型有多端到端"从固定设计选择变为可扩展变量;(4)实现可扩展的端到端重构型生成模型。局限方面,自回归 LLM 因其逐 token 条件已近乎单模态,从探索中受益较小;Forward XM 的 FLOP 随 K 增长,反向 XM 需配合熵正则或覆盖率约束以防塌缩;现有 guidance 技术并非为探索设计,效果受限。总体而言,作者认为在大规模训练下,生成建模本质可能演化为"以很高 K 搜索正确潜变量"的探索问题。

Abstract: The deep learning revolution, kicked off by AlexNet, taught us that end-to-end training beats decomposing a problem into hand-designed stages. Generative modeling, however, has remained the exception-despite generative models being remarkably capable, they are still not trained end-to-end. This is because, at its core, generative modeling is about handling distributions with many modes, and existing scalable approaches handle this the same way, by factoring the generation procedure, which prevents end-to-end generation. In this work, we introduce Explorative Modeling, a new paradigm that instead factors the training loop, exploring K candidate matches between model generations and data, and training on the best, so predictions commit to modes rather than blurring them. We find Explorative Models (XMs) useful in two settings. First, increasing exploration adds a third pretraining axis beyond parameters and data for existing generative models-where scaling exploration monotonically improves performance across both continuous and discrete domains (images, video, and language). Notably, gains from exploration increase with scale, climbing from 7% to 36% as data scales and from 13% to 23% as models grow, with efficiency gains more than doubling at 3x the compute. Concretely, exploration improves FLOP efficiency by 4.1x, sample efficiency by 6.2x, parameter efficiency by 47%, lifts the strongest of image-generation recipes to a near-state-of-the-art 1.43 FID on ImageNet without guidance, enables scaling how end-to-end existing models are, and unlocks scaling generalization. Second, XMs enable end-to-end reconstructive generative modeling, matching diffusion on control tasks with 16-256x fewer inference steps. Together, these results establish XMs as both a new pretraining axis for existing generative models and a standalone end-to-end generative modeling paradigm.

</details>


### [190] [FunL2O: LLM-Guided Feature Function Design for Learning to Optimize](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27389)
*Bingheng Li,Junyang Cai,Yupeng Zhang,Bistra Dilkina,Jayant Kalagnanam,Dzung T. Phan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FunL2O框架,通过LLM驱动的程序进化自动设计学习优化(L2O)中的特征函数,在多种连续和离散优化任务上自动进化出的特征函数均优于人工设计的特征表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有L2O方法依赖人工设计的特征函数来表示优化问题实例,这一设计决策对模型表达能力和下游性能有重要影响,但却被严重忽视。手动特征设计费时费力且难以跨领域迁移,亟需自动化方案。但特征函数自动化设计面临特殊挑战:它是针对结构化优化数据的可执行程序,需保持模型特定的张量接口、满足语义和维度约束,且质量只能通过重训学习器并测量下游性能来评估。

Method: 采用FunSearch风格的循环搜索框架。LLM提出可执行特征函数候选,固定的评估流程重新训练原始L2O模型并测量下游优化性能。框架定义了语义契约以规定有效输入输出格式,涵盖异构图、稠密张量和求解器状态。候选函数需满足管道特定的语义契约,通过可行性、质量、迭代次数、枢轴次数或求解时间等原生指标评估,精英程序被用于下一代生成。评估时不改变模型架构、损失函数、标签、训练计划、数据和求解器,仅隔离输入表示的影响。

Result: 在8个L2O管道上进行评估,涵盖LP和QP解预测、约束非线性预测、对偶预热启动、单纯形基初始化、枢轴选择以及MILP搜索(包括GNN引导的后门分支和Predict-and-Search)。跨连续和离散优化任务以及4个LLM的实验表明,进化出的特征函数始终优于人工设计的表示,在不改变学习模型或优化管道的情况下提升了求解质量、可行性和求解效率。

Conclusion: FunL2O确立了LLM驱动的特征进化作为自动化L2O表示设计的通用且有效的方法。最佳特征函数选定后可作为标准预处理代码使用,部署时无需LLM,证明了自动化特征工程在L2O领域的可行性和广泛适用性。

Abstract: Learning-to-optimize (L2O) methods accelerate repeated optimization by training models to predict solutions, warm starts, branching decisions, or other forms of solver guidance. A critical yet largely overlooked component of these pipelines is the feature function that maps problem instances to inputs for machine learning models. Existing L2O methods typically rely on hand-crafted features, making representation design manual and largely fixed across domains. We introduce FunL2O, the first unified framework for automating feature design through LLM-driven program evolution for L2O. In a FunSearch-style loop, an LLM proposes executable feature functions, while a fixed evaluation process retrains the original L2O model and measures downstream optimization performance. We evaluate FunL2O on linear and quadratic programming tasks involving solution prediction and warm-starting, as well as on mixed-integer optimization tasks using GNN-guided backdoor branching and Predict-and-Search. Across continuous and discrete optimization tasks and four LLMs, the evolved features consistently outperform hand-crafted representations. These results establish LLM-driven feature evolution as a general and effective approach to automating representation design in L2O.

</details>


### [191] [ECG-InterpBench: Benchmarking the Interpretability of ECG Foundation Models with Matched-Scale Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27404)
*Yixuan Duan,Wei Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ECG-InterpBench是一个用于系统评估心电图（ECG）基础模型表示可解释性的基准框架。它使用容量匹配的稀疏自编码器（BatchTopK SAE）作为标准化测量工具，在六种ECG基础模型（CSFM、CARDIAC-FM、ECG-FM、ECG-JEPA、HuBERT-ECG、ST-MEM）、五个标准化编码器深度、五种匹配字典宽度和三个随机种子上构建了一个450单元的可解释性图谱，从稀疏重建保真度、单特征临床可访问性（覆盖49项临床ECG测量指标）和跨种子特征可重复性三个互补维度评估模型表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ECG基础模型基准主要评估下游预测性能（准确率、迁移能力、标签效率），但未能揭示模型内部表示的组织结构：表示能否被忠实分解、临床相关测量是否定位于可识别特征、相同结构能否在独立分解中复现。这一缺口在临床场景中至关重要，因为共享表示可能将采集伪影、人口统计混杂或队列特定捷径传播到所有下游模型。现有可解释性工具（输出归因、线性探针、概念激活向量）回答的是不同问题，无法审计任务通用隐藏表示的组织结构。因此需要一个容量受控的、专门针对表示级可解释性的比较框架。

Method: 1) 数据：PTB-XL（21,799条12导联ECG，49个波形衍生临床概念）为主要基准，凭证MIMIC-IV-ECG（10万条ECG，48,491名患者）为外部验证。2) 模型：六种冻结预训练ECG基础模型通过其原生预处理路径调用，仅训练SAE。3) 标准化深度匹配：相对深度q∈{0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1}映射到各编码器的具体层级，所有源层宽度统一为d=768。4) 容量匹配：扩展因子E∈{1,4,8,16,32}对应字典宽度N∈{768,3072,6144,12288,24576}，固定k/d=1/8（k=96），8000步训练。5) BatchTopK SAE作为标准化稀疏分解工具。6) 三轴评估：稀疏重建保真度（R²、死特征比例、L₀稀疏度）、单特征临床可访问性（训练子集选择最优坐标后在测试集评估|r|，覆盖阈值|r|≥0.20）、跨种子可重复性（256个最活跃解码器方向的匈牙利匹配余弦相似度与子空间重叠）。7) 不确定性量化：2000次患者聚类自助法配对推断，Benjamini-Hochberg校正。8) 稀疏敏感性：固定k/d与固定k/N两种参数化方案对比。9) 输入界面协调审计：原生/导联协调/时序协调/联合协调四种协议测试模型排序稳健性。10) SAE-密集干预选择性：在匹配目标读出效应下比较SAE坐标与原生密集坐标的跨家族脱靶RMS。

Result: 1) 各模型具有不同的深度-尺度分解表面和度量特定的可解释性画像。2) 重建保真度排序：HuBERT-ECG > ECG-JEPA > CSFM > ECG-FM > CARDIAC-FM > ST-MEM（15/15配对对比BH显著）。3) 单坐标临床可访问性排序：ECG-JEPA > ECG-FM > CARDIAC-FM > ST-MEM > HuBERT-ECG > CSFM（13/15显著）。4) 概念覆盖排序：CARDIAC-FM > ECG-FM > ECG-JEPA > ST-MEM > HuBERT-ECG > CSFM。5) ECG-JEPA的49个概念中26个达到AUC≥0.40，心室率、QRS持续时间、P波检测、平均RR为最高可访问概念。6) MIMIC-IV-ECG外部验证保持度量特定领导者（HuBERT-ECG重建0.990，ECG-JEPA语义对齐0.324/覆盖0.781，ECG-FM死特征最低0.099/特征稳定性最高0.378，CSFM子空间稳定性最高0.778）。7) 排名稳定性：重建Kendall τ中位数=1.00，可访问性=0.73，覆盖=0.73。8) 重建对稀疏参数化高度稳定（τ=1.00/0.87），可访问性和覆盖对活跃预算更敏感。9) 输入界面协调审计下六模型排序在所有协议下保持一致（Spearman ρ=1.0）。10) SAE干预在所有五个验证合格模型中均比密集干预产生更少的跨家族脱靶RMS和WBI（q≤0.0011）。

Conclusion: ECG-InterpBench通过容量匹配的多尺度SAE族将ECG基础模型的表示级可解释性转化为系统化、可复现的模型比较问题。其核心单元是精确的六模型匹配块，产生的深度-尺度画像、配对患者推断、种子稳定性、稀疏敏感性以及密集到单坐标校准区分了忠实稀疏重建、分布式概念可用性、单坐标可访问性和可复现特征身份。该基准揭示不同模型在不同可解释性维度上具有互补优势，明确表明重建保真度与临床可访问性识别不同的领先模型，证明单一性能指标不足以表征表示质量。该框架可推广到EEG、医学成像、电子健康记录等临床模态的基础模型评估，为可解释临床AI系统的原则性开发和选择奠定基础。

Abstract: Existing benchmarks for electrocardiogram foundation models primarily evaluate downstream predictive performance, providing limited insight into whether their internal representations can be faithfully decomposed, clinically interpreted, or reproduced across independent analyses. We introduce ECG-InterpBench, a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the interpretability of ECG foundation-model representations. ECG-InterpBench uses sparse autoencoders as standardized measurement instruments and matches their capacity across models to enable controlled comparisons. We evaluate six frozen ECG foundation models across five standardized encoder depths, five matched dictionary widths, and three random seeds, producing a 450-cell interpretability atlas comprising 75 exactly matched six-model comparison blocks. The benchmark evaluates complementary dimensions of representation interpretability, including sparse reconstruction fidelity, single-feature accessibility and coverage of 49 clinically meaningful ECG measurements, and cross-seed feature reproducibility. The evaluation further quantifies patient-sampling uncertainty, depth- and seed-dependent variation, and sensitivity to the sparsity parameterization. The benchmark reveals that ECG foundation models exhibit distinct interpretability profiles. A matched replication on MIMIC-IV-ECG confirms that reconstruction fidelity and clinical accessibility identify different leading models. The benchmark is accompanied by executable evaluation code, standardized manifests, cell-level metrics, and reproducibility audits. ECG-InterpBench complements performance-centered ECG benchmarks by providing a capacity-controlled and reproducible framework for comparing ECG foundation models across distinct dimensions of representation interpretability.

</details>


### [192] [SE(3)-MeanFlow: Few-Step Protein Backbone Generation on Lie Groups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27431)
*Yikun Bai,Binghang Lu,Yikai Liu,Elaheh Akbari,Soheil Kolouri,Linxuan Wang,Ping He,Shuchan Wang,Ruqi Zhang,Guang Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SE(3)-MeanFlow 将欧氏空间的 MeanFlow 框架推广到李群几何（SE(3)），用于蛋白质主链的少步生成。通过在李代数 so(3) 与 R³ 上推导闭式平均速度恒等式，引入 SE(3) α-Flow 目标以消除雅可比-向量积，并结合小 t 稳定化策略与整流后训练，在 SCOPe 基准上以远少于现有流匹配方法的采样步数实现更优的可设计性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 SE(3)^N 的扩散和流匹配蛋白质主链生成方法虽质量高，但推理需在 ODE 上数值积分数百步，每步涉及李群指数映射，成为高通量蛋白质设计流程的瓶颈。MeanFlow 在欧氏空间已展示一步/少步生成的潜力，但难以直接推广到 SE(3) 这类非平凡几何空间——不同轨迹点处的速度位于不同切空间，平均需平行传输。本文旨在将 MeanFlow 拓展至李群几何，避免平行传输，兼顾少步生成与稳定训练。

Method: 1) 利用 SE(3) ≅ SO(3) × R³ 的解耦积几何，分别在 so(3) 李代数和 R³ 上推导平均速度定义 exp((t-s)Ω^avg) = Texp(∫Ω dτ)，并通过对 t 求导得到含右雅可比矩阵 J 的平均速度恒等式（命题 1/3/4）。2) 提出两种等价训练损失（L^J 和 L^{J⁻¹}），并通过 SE(3) α-Flow 目标（用远+近两段构造替代 JVP）作为预热阶段。3) 小 t 稳定化：引入辅助变量 B^θ_A = t·A^avg_θ 推迟 1/t 因子，仅在最终归一化时使用 max(t,t_ε)⁻²。4) 训练流程：阶段 1 用 α-Flow（α 从 1 退火至 0.1）做 JVP-free 预热，阶段 2 切换到端点 + MeanFlow 目标（含 SO(3) 测地距离锚定）。5) 后训练采用自整流（self-reflow）：用模型自身确定性的噪声→生成对替代随机耦合。6) 网络基于 ReQFlow IPA 主干，仅添加共享双时间嵌入与逐块 AdaLN-Zero 门控（约 0.33% 参数）。

Result: 在 SCOPe 基准（3,673 个主链，长度 60–128）上：100 步时 SE3MF 可设计比例 0.936（QFlow 0.885、FrameFlow 0.849、RMF 0.832）；20 步时仍保持 0.867（QFlow 0.778、RMF 0.806），scRMSD 1.369 vs 1.703/1.554；10 步时 0.728（QFlow 仅 0.559）。整流后 RecSE3MF 在 10 步达 0.894、20 步 0.929，几何有效性 Cα-valid 在 10–100 步均维持在 0.97 左右。模型仅 16.8M 参数（约为 RMF 437M 的 1/26），每步采样成本与 QFlow 相同。次级结构分布在少步下保持稳定。代价是多样性（TM 评分）略高、新颖性在大预算下略弱。受控 SO(3)² 消融实验表明：少步优势的根源在于"平均速度参数化"本身，而非架构或耦合；J 矩阵在训练分布上中位相对修正达 7.2%（t-s ∈ [0.25, 0.5)），不可忽略。

Conclusion: SE(3)-MeanFlow 通过在李代数 so(3) 上直接推导闭式平均速度恒等式并利用 α-Flow 预热 + 小 t 稳定 MeanFlow 的两阶段策略，在蛋白质主链少步生成上推进了"可设计性-效率"前沿：以比流匹配基线少若干倍的采样步数实现更优设计率，模型规模仅与 QFlow 相当。主要局限是多样性略有下降。未来工作将探索更好平衡覆盖度与可设计性的目标、拓展到条件生成与 motif 支架任务，以及向一步生成推进。

Abstract: Generative modeling of protein backbones promises the de novo design of proteins with prescribed structural and functional properties. Existing diffusion and flow-matching models produce high-quality backbones on SE(3)^N, but inference requires numerically integrating an ODE over hundreds of network evaluations, each involving a Lie group exponential map - a bottleneck for high-throughput design campaigns. We introduce SE(3)-MeanFlow, a few-step generative framework that extends MeanFlow from Euclidean space to the Lie group geometry of protein frames. Working natively in the Lie algebra so(3) and in R^3, we derive closed-form average-velocity identities for rotations and translations, giving simulation-free training targets. We further introduce an SE(3) alpha-Flow objective that removes the Jacobian-vector product from the rotation branch and serves as a warm-up stage, after which training switches to a small-t stabilized MeanFlow loss that is used for the remainder of pretraining and for rectification-based post-training. In protein backbone generation, SE(3)-MeanFlow matches or exceeds flow-matching baselines that use several times more sampling steps, and its advantage widens in the few-step regime, where rectification lets it lead at every matched budget - at a modest cost in diversity.

</details>


### [193] [Latent States in Neural Networks: Recovering the Temporal Structure of Drifting Data from Model Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27482)
*Kevin Guan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究时序漂移数据流中是否存在离散的"事件结构"，借鉴认知神经科学中Baldassano等人（2017）的事件分割范式，将HMM拟合到按时间顺序排列的分类器权重轨迹上，在Fakeddit（虚假信息检测）和Yelp（情感分析）两个数据集上验证了这一框架的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类认知会将连续体验自发地分割为离散事件，且这些事件边界会影响记忆与迁移。已有神经科学研究表明，可通过HMM从大脑活动数据中恢复事件边界。然而，对于人工神经网络在时序漂移数据流上的训练过程，是否也存在类似的离散"事件"结构尚不清楚。本文将神经科学的事件分割框架转译到人工学习系统，探究权重序列是否编码了有意义的时间结构。

Method: 1. 数据集：Fakeddit（35个60天窗口）与Yelp（56个90天窗口）。2. 模型训练：每个窗口独立训练分类器（Fakeddit用RoBERTa+ResNet-50的MLP，Yelp用RoBERTa的MLP），每个窗口10个种子。3. 权重处理：通过Hungarian算法对齐隐藏层置换对称性，PCA降维后z-score标准化。4. HMM拟合：左到右拓扑的Gaussian HMM，BIC与留一种子交叉验证选K，Fakeddit K=11，Yelp K=16（15被访问）。5. 评估：列中心化macro F1的距离条件gap统计量、置换检验、与等大小分段基线对比、Spearman相关性分析、控制类分布的Freedman-Lane偏置换检验。

Result: 1. 权重轨迹在对齐后呈现按窗口聚类的低维流形结构。2. 状态内泛化优于跨状态：Fakeddit gap=0.1092（p<0.0001），Yelp gap=0.0184（p=0.0001），控制时间距离后仍然显著。3. 优于等大小基线：Fakeddit D=+0.0051（p<0.0001），Yelp D=+0.0016（p<0.0001）。4. 状态与类分布（JSD）相关性比与权重空间几何距离的相关性更强：Fakeddit ρ_JSD=-0.878 vs ρ_weight=-0.617，Yelp ρ_JSD=-0.407 vs ρ_weight=-0.285。5. 控制类分布和时滞后，状态内优势在两个任务上仍超过置换零分布（Fakeddit显著，Yelp较小但显著）。6. 所有效应在Yelp上均减弱，原因是其类分布更稳定、漂移主要表现为协变量漂移。

Conclusion: 本文成功将神经科学的事件分割框架转译到人工学习者，证明了时序漂移数据流的离散结构可以从模型权重中恢复，且这种结构与类内迁移优势、记忆中的事件内一致性行为相平行。状态与数据分布的标签边际漂移密切相关，但即使在控制类分布和时滞后仍保留了对迁移的预测能力，表明权重状态恢复的是超越纯分布变化的结构。该方法为漂移检测、模型再训练时机和事件结构跨生物与人工学习者的比较提供了新工具。

Abstract: A temporally drifting data stream may pass through discrete regimes rather than changing continuously. We ask whether such regimes are recoverable from the weights of models trained on the stream, using a hidden Markov model (HMM) fit to the chronologically ordered trajectory of those weights. We study this question in two domains known to drift over time: multimodal misinformation detection, using the Fakeddit dataset; and sentiment analysis, using the Yelp dataset. We train classifiers on consecutive temporal windows and fit an HMM to the trajectory of their aligned weights, recovering latent states that partition each timeline into coherent phases. On both datasets, classifiers generalize better to data from windows sharing the state of their training window than to windows across state boundaries. This within-state transfer advantage survives a control for temporal proximity and modestly exceeds the advantage recovered by a naive partition into contiguous states of equal size. Although the states are estimated solely from model weights, they correlate more strongly with shifts in the data's class distribution than with the weight-space geometry used to estimate them. After class divergence and lag are residualized out, the within-state advantage exceeds its permutation null on both tasks, indicating that the states recover structure relevant to transfer beyond the data distribution. Every effect replicates on both tasks but is attenuated on Yelp, whose label distribution is more temporally stable.

</details>


### [194] [Expanding Data-Agnostic Pivotal Instances Selection Models with Proximity Trees and Ensemble Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27522)
*Alessio Cascione,Mattia Setzu,Cristiano Landi,Paolo Maria Mancarella,Riccardo Guidotti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于"枢轴点"（pivot）选择的可解释预测模型框架，借鉴决策树思想，通过层次化结构选取代表性样本作为参考点，实现可解释的分类/预测。该方法支持单枢轴、枢轴对（用于邻近树和斜决策树）以及集成模式，且对数据模态无关，适用于表格、文本、图像和时间序列等多种数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着决策过程日益复杂，机器学习模型被广泛使用，但许多方法缺乏可解释性。人类决策通常依赖与少量代表性案例的比较，因此作者希望设计一种能够自动选择代表性"枢轴点"（pivots）的可解释预测模型，以兼顾准确性和可解释性。

Method: 1. 提出层次化的、可解释性内生的枢轴点选择模型，基于枢轴点与输入实例之间的相似性进行预测；2. 方法不仅作为枢轴点选择技术，也可作为独立预测模型；3. 扩展至枢轴对（pair of pivots），以适配 proximity tree 和 oblique tree；4. 结合集成学习增强方法的效果与鲁棒性；5. 数据模态无关，利用预训练网络进行特征变换，从而支持表格、文本、图像、时间序列等不同数据类型。

Result: 在涵盖表格数据、文本、图像和时间序列等多种数据集上的实验表明：该方法在枢轴点数量极少的情况下，性能优于其他实例选择策略，并能取得与当前最先进的可解释模型相当的竞争性结果。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种基于枢轴点的层次化可解释预测框架，在保持极简枢轴集合的同时实现了跨模态的有效预测。该工作为可解释机器学习提供了一条基于"案例对比"（case-based reasoning）的新路径，在准确性与可解释性之间取得了良好平衡。

Abstract: As decision-making processes grow more complex, machine learning tools have become essential for tackling business and societal challenges. However, many existing methods rely on decision-making procedures that are difficult to interpret. Since humans naturally make decisions by comparing new cases with a few representative examples, we aim to design an approach that selects such pivots to construct an interpretable predictive model. Inspired by decision trees, we propose a hierarchical, interpretable-by-design pivot selection model based on the similarity between pivots and input instances. Our method functions both as a pivot selection technique and a standalone predictive model. Extending beyond single pivots, we incorporate pairs of pivots that are used by proximity and oblique trees, as well as ensembles, which enhance the versatility and effectiveness of our proposal. Additionally, our approach is data modality-agnostic, leveraging pre-trained networks for data transformation. Experiments across diverse datasets, including tabular data, text, images, and time series, demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, outperforming alternative instance selection strategies and achieving competitive results against state-of-the-art interpretable models while maintaining a minimal number of pivots.

</details>


### [195] [Understanding Submodular Information Measure Based Objectives for Representation Learning: A Variance and Separation Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27660)
*Rishabh Iyer,Truong Pham,Anay Majee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一的理论框架,将子模信息测度(SIMs)与表示学习中的经典统计概念(如方差、协方差体积、类间分离和表示重叠)联系起来,揭示了不同子模函数作为学习目标时所诱导的几何偏差。核心结论是:Graph Cut总信息(GC-TI)恢复类内方差,LogDet总信息(LD-TI)恢复广义方差,Facility Location总信息(FL-TI)天然强调稀有和易混淆类别;Graph Cut互信息(GCMI)关联质心分离,LogDet互信息(LogDetMI)关联马氏距离分离,Facility Location互信息(FLQMI)度量最近模态的表示重叠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 子模信息测度(SIMs)近期在监督对比表示学习框架SCORE中表现出强大性能,但不同SIM变体(Graph Cut、Facility Location、LogDet等)在嵌入空间中诱导的具体几何与统计性质尚不清楚。这种理论空白导致实践中将不同SIM视为可互换的目标函数,仅凭下游性能做经验性选择,缺乏原则性指导。在长尾分布、多模态类别等复杂场景中,不同SIM的行为差异显著,亟需统一的理论理解。

Method: 1. 理论分析:将Total Information (TI)和Mutual Information (MI)分解为子模函数的不同成分,结合Fisher判别分析、马氏距离等经典统计模式识别概念,推导出6个定理严格刻画各类SIM与统计量间的等价关系;2. 提出通用SCORE目标函数 L = λ_TI·TI_f(C) + λ_SMI·Σ I_f(C_i;C_j);3. 采用受控合成实验,通过独立操控类内方差、协方差结构、类别不平衡、质心距离和重叠模式等单因素变量,使用偏移欧几里得核或高斯RBF核计算相似度,定量验证理论预测。

Result: 1. 定理1(Theorem 1):GC-TI (λ=0) 在偏移欧几里得核下精确恢复经典类内方差(2Σ|C_c|Σ||z_k-μ_c||² + 常数);2. 定理2:LD-TI 在大样本极限下是 Σ log det(Σ_c) 的单调变换,恢复广义方差;3. 定理3:FL-TI 对类别C_c 的影响为 Θ((N-n_c)·exp(-δ_c²/2τ²)),小类需更大间距才能与头类贡献相等,天然执行类别相关裕度自适应;4. 定理4:GC-TI + GCMI 精确分解为聚合质心分离目标 Σ_{a<b} n_a n_b ||μ_a-μ_b||²,重构误差在10⁻⁹量级;5. 定理5:LogDetMI = const - log(1+pq·M_ab),是马氏分离的单调递减函数;6. 定理6:FLQMI ≈ Σ_{r,s} w_rs·exp(-d_rs²/2τ²),仅由最近模态对支配,体现局部表示重叠。实验中:GC-TI与RBF核下方差单调相关(corr=0.984),FL-TI在长尾数据集上对尾部类贡献93.5%而GC-TI仅0.2%,FLQMI在分布式重叠下增加3.4倍但GCMI几乎不变。

Conclusion: 本文建立了子模信息测度与经典统计判别准则之间的首个统一几何理论,证明SCORE框架中不同SIM的组合可精确恢复Fisher线性判别、马氏分离等经典目标。无单一SIM在所有场景下最优:Graph Cut适合紧致性与类间分离,LogDet适合协方差感知判别,Facility Location天然处理多模态结构与长尾分布。这些结论为子模目标函数的选取和设计提供了原则性指导,未来可拓展至自监督学习、检索增强生成和多模态基础模型。

Abstract: Submodular Information Measures (SIMs) have recently emerged as a powerful framework for representation learning and multimodal learning. In particular, the SCORE framework~\cite{majee2024score} demonstrated that SIMs can serve as effective objectives for supervised contrastive learning. Despite their empirical success, however, the geometric and statistical properties induced by different submodular information measures remain poorly understood. In this work, we develop a unified theoretical framework connecting SIMs to classical concepts in representation learning and statistical pattern recognition. We show that Total Information (TI) objectives characterize intra-class structure: Graph Cut TI recovers within-class variance, LogDet TI recovers generalized variance and covariance volume, and Facility Location TI induces imbalance-aware separation that emphasizes rare and confusable classes. We further show that Mutual Information (MI) objectives capture complementary notions of inter-class structure: Graph Cut MI is closely related to centroid separation and Fisher-style discrimination, LogDet MI captures covariance-aware separation through Mahalanobis distance, and Facility Location MI measures nearest-mode representational overlap. We validate these theoretical characterizations using controlled synthetic experiments that independently vary variance, covariance, class imbalance, class separation, and multimodal overlap. Across all settings, the empirical behavior closely matches the proposed theory. Our results provide the first unified geometric and statistical understanding of submodular information measures and offer principled guidance for selecting and designing SIM-based objectives for representation learning.

</details>


### [196] [Towards joint scaling laws with optimal batch size schedules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27731)
*Jiaxiang Li,Zhiqi Bu,Shiyun Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于凸优化理论的动态批次大小（batch size）调度方法，通过推导闭式最优批次大小调度公式（仅依赖于学习率调度的形状），实现了比静态批次大小训练更好的效果。结合 1/√T 缩放的学习率和权重衰减，构建了联合缩放规律，在大语言模型训练中带来 6%~15% 的计算效率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代深度学习训练通常使用静态批次大小，忽视了学习率和批次大小对训练动力学的联合影响。虽然学习率调度已被广泛研究，但批次大小作为调度超参数的研究较少，现有方法多为手工设计的阶梯式调度或固定大小，可能并非最优。此外，超参数搜索在大规模训练中计算成本极高，需要从小规模实验可靠地推断大规模超参数的方法。

Method: 基于随机凸优化理论（convex SGD）推导训练动力学的解析表征。核心方法包括：(1) 定理1：从学习率序列预测损失序列的离散上界；(2) 假设梯度范数满足 ‖g_t‖² ≤ G² + X/B_t，推导出同时依赖学习率和批次大小序列的损失表征（定理2）；(3) 在连续极限下，将离散求和转化为积分，求解约束优化问题得到闭式最优批次大小调度（定理3）：B_t^optim = (K/2) · η_t / √(∫₀ᵀ η_k dk · ∫ₜᵀ η_k dk)；(4) 扩展至一般计算成本函数（引理4）；(5) 推导联合缩放规律，包括 η ∝ 1/√T 和 κ ∝ 1/√T 的峰值学习率/权重衰减缩放以及与模型规模无关的最优批次大小调度；(6) 在凸损失下证明 O(1/√T) 的损失收敛率（定理5）。

Result: 最优动态批次大小调度在多种设置下均显著优于静态批次大小：(1) 在 Llama3（dense）和 Qwen3（MoE）模型上，计算效率提升 6%~15%，模型规模从 0.1B 到 7B，计算预算高达 1e21 FLOPs；(2) 在 LAMBADA、HellaSwag、ARC、WinoGrande、PIQA 等下游基准上一致优于静态基线；(3) 在视觉语言模型（SmoLM2+Siglip2）和数学领域微调（Qwen3-0.6B on OrcaMath）上也观察到性能提升；(4) 保持通用动力学（universal dynamics/supercollapse），即不同模型在归一化后共享相同损失曲线；(5) 对 AdamW 和 Muon-NSGD 优化器均有效；(6) 实验证伪了 η/B 单独决定训练动力学的假设，表明最优批次大小调度与峰值学习率、权重衰减、模型规模、架构和优化器均解耦，是一个独立的缩放维度。但优势在纯半精度训练下会消失，且随基础批次大小趋向无穷而递减。

Conclusion: 凸优化理论可以有效表征深度学习的训练动力学，包括从学习率和批次大小调度预测损失。由此推导出的最优批次大小调度是闭式的，且与学习率调优解耦（无需超参数搜索），在多种优化器、模型架构（dense 和 MoE）、规模（0.1B–7B）和训练阶段（预训练、微调）中一致优于静态批次大小。联合缩放规律实现了超参数的尺度自由迁移，为大语言模型训练提供了稳健且高性能的方案，开辟了批次大小作为一个原则性的缩放维度而非单独调优超参数的新方向。

Abstract: Modern deep learning typically keeps the batch size static throughout training, thus overlooking the joint effect of learning rate and batch size on the training dynamics. In this paper, we study the deep learning dynamics through the lens of convex optimization and derive a joint characterization of loss in terms of both schedules, applicable to general optimizers and model architectures. This characterization yields a closed-form optimal batch size schedule for any prescribed learning rate schedule, and further leads to joint scaling laws that consistently outperform static batch size baselines, highlighting the significance of dynamic batch size schedule in large language model training.

</details>


### [197] [ROCS: Request-Oriented Compute Sharing for Efficient Large-Scale Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27744)
*Yuxin Chen,Liang Luo,Buyun Zhang,Jian Jiao,Boda Li,Haoyu Wang,Tongyi Tang,Ao Cai,Zijian Shen,Zhengkai Zhang,Wenyi Xie,Ryan Dick,Han Liu,Neng Shi,Bin Yu,Jianbo Xiao,Shuyao Bi,Hongtao Yu,Yuanwei Fang,Zhuoran Zhao,Sijia Chen,Yang Chen,Shuqi Yang,Qianru Li,Zikun Liu,Wei Ling,Sihan Zeng,Longhao Jin,Jiaxin Lu,Yinbin Ma,Jiawei Li,Yichen Ruan,Yong Ler Lee,Birmingham Guan,Zijian Li,Jianbo Sun,Zhengyu Zhang,Zeliang Chen,Xiaohan Wei,Yuchen Hao,GP Musumeci,Venkatesh Ranganathan,Yantao Yao,Chunqiang Tang,Wenlin Chen,Santanu Kolay,Ellie Dingqiao Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ROCS（Request-Oriented Compute Sharing），一种针对大规模推荐系统的建模与推理范式。其核心洞察是：每个用户请求会针对多个候选物品进行评分，而请求侧特征在所有候选间共享。ROCS 通过延迟请求-候选交互、隔离候选相关表示，使模型大部分计算每个请求只执行一次而非每个候选执行一次，从而显著提升推理效率。该方法由四个组件构成：广义层掩码（GLM）、深度交叉注意力（DCA）、请求导向资源再分配（RRR）和核内广播优化（IKBO）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代推荐模型通过扩展特征交互和序列模块提升预测质量，但生产环境的成本与延迟约束限制了模型扩展空间。传统排序架构要求请求与候选特征早期融合以提取交叉特征，导致大量计算在多个候选间冗余重复执行。两塔架构虽能延迟交互但牺牲了中间交互的模型表达能力。现有方法（如模型统一、知识蒸馏等）受限于领域干扰、蒸馏效率和新鲜度问题。因此需要一种直接消除逐候选冗余计算的建模驱动方法。

Method: ROCS 包含四个核心组件：(1) **GLM（广义层掩码）**：定义算子级别的依赖契约，确保线性层、线性压缩层、组局部算子、分解机等特征交互模块满足下三角块状依赖结构（候选信息可流入请求侧表示但反向不行），且该不变量在组合下封闭；(2) **DCA（深度交叉注意力）**：将请求导向共享扩展到序列建模，通过请求独占的序列编码器产生候选无关表示，再用 GLM 合规的查询生成器从该共享表示中深度检索候选条件信息；(3) **RRR（请求导向资源再分配）**：通过请求侧缩放比 r 将节省的计算重新投入到请求侧通路，扩大可复用表示的容量；(4) **IKBO（核内广播优化）**：在 GPU 上保持请求侧张量在自然批次大小 B_r 下，通过索引映射 m 在消费核函数内部解析请求-候选关联，避免实体化广播，包含广播融合进 GEMM epilogue、Warp 专用化持久核、请求-候选核合并、双向 Tile 调度、内存对齐等多项优化。

Result: 在三个公开基准（KuaiVideo、KuaiRand、KKBox）上对 DCNv2、FinalMLP、Wukong 三种骨干以及 RankMixer+UGSEP 基线进行评估，结果显示 ROCS-Base 在 N=100 时显著降低摊销 FLOPs（最高减少 90.6%），ROCS-Scaled 在相近摊销预算下匹配或超过 Vanilla 模型 AUC。在生产级工作负载中：广告检索阶段实现 +196% QPS 提升；短视频排序阶段实现 -0.5% 相对 LogLoss + +47% QPS；广告排序阶段实现 +62% QPS。消融研究验证了 DCA 各设计选择的有效性，IKBO-LCB 内核延迟从 1.944ms 降至 0.482ms（-75.2%），IKBO-DCA 注意力吞吐从 245 TFLOPs/s 提升至 594 TFLOPs/s。该方法已在 Meta 数十个生产推荐模型上部署，覆盖广告与自然推荐、检索与排序阶段，复杂度跨度超两个数量级。

Conclusion: ROCS 是一种建模与推理协同设计的范式，通过 GLM 和 DCA 暴露并保护请求侧可复用计算，通过 RRR 将节省的计算重新投入以改善质量-效率前沿，通过 IKBO 在 GPU 上高效执行而无需实体化广播。该方法证明请求级冗余是模型-系统协同设计的结构性机遇。ROCS 在每个请求需要评估多个候选且模型存在大量候选无关计算时最为有效；当候选倍数较低时收益减弱。IKBO 作为通用原则，但其实现依赖于现代 NVIDIA GPU 的原语。ROCS 已成功部署于大规模生产系统，实现了质量提升、成本降低或两者兼得，并释放的容量可进一步用于模型扩展。

Abstract: Modern recommendation models gain prediction quality by scaling feature-interaction and sequence modules, but production cost constraints cap how far systems can scale. In this work, we propose Request-Oriented Compute Sharing (ROCS), a modeling and inference paradigm that exploits a unique property of recommendation inference: each user request is evaluated against many candidates, while request-side features are shared across candidates. ROCS defers request-candidate interactions as late as possible, isolates candidate-dependent representations, and evaluates substantial portions of the model once per request rather than once per candidate, significantly improving inference efficiency while maintaining or improving prediction quality. To realize this paradigm, we develop Generalized Layer Masking (GLM) to enforce candidate isolation in feature-interaction architectures, and Deep Cross Attention (DCA) to extend request-oriented sharing to sequence architectures. To support efficient GPU deployment, we co-design In-Kernel Broadcast Optimization (IKBO) that significantly accelerates ROCS model execution. Experiments on public benchmarks show that ROCS consistently improves the quality-efficiency tradeoff across recommendation backbones. On production-scale workloads, ROCS achieves up to a 3x QPS improvement on retrieval models without quality degradation and a 0.5% relative LogLoss improvement with a 50% QPS gain on a short-form video ranking model. ROCS has been deployed across large-scale recommendation systems spanning ads and organic surfaces, retrieval and ranking stages, and more than two orders of magnitude in inference complexity, delivering significant online gains at reduced infrastructure cost.

</details>


### [198] [Train Small, Deploy Large: Zero-Shot GNN Transfer Through Geometric Renormalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27767)
*Robert Jankowski,Pedro Almagro-Blanco,Marián Boguñá,Melanie Weber,M. Ángeles Serrano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种"小训练、大部署"(Train Small, Deploy Large)的零样本GNN迁移协议，利用几何重正化(GR)将原始网络粗粒化为缩小版的图，在缩小版图上训练GNN，然后将学到的权重直接迁移到原始全分辨率图上进行推理，无需重新训练。实验表明，该方法在合成网络和真实网络上能保留大部分原始尺度的预测性能，同时显著降低训练成本，并保持跨尺度的表征相似性和训练轨迹一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN虽然架构上可应用于任意大小的图，但跨图尺度的迁移性能并无保证。不同分辨率下的图可能呈现不同的结构特性，导致消息传递统计量发生变化，从而损害GNN的跨尺度泛化能力。现有粗化方法多关注全局谱性质而非消息传递所需的局部邻域统计量，难以保证GNN权重迁移的有效性。因此，亟需一种既能保持消息传递相关结构、又能实现大幅压缩的尺度变换方法。

Method: 核心方法基于隐藏度量空间模型（S¹/ℍ²模型）和几何重正化(GR)：1）使用Mercator将网络嵌入双曲空间，获得节点的隐藏度κ和角度坐标θ；2）沿角度方向将连续r个节点合并为超节点，按照ℍ²模型的连接概率公式重缩放超节点间的连边，并通过剪枝保持平均度；3）在粗粒化图G_ℓ上训练GNN（GCN/GraphSAGE/GAT），训练完成后直接将权重应用于原始图G_0进行零样本推理。实验还引入了随机重正化基线（Random/Random-T/Random-G）、并使用线性CKA、正交Procrustes相似度衡量表征相似性，使用JS散度衡量训练预测轨迹对齐程度。此外，论文还发布了GPU加速版Mercator（cuMercator），通过负采样将嵌入复杂度从O(N²)显著降低。

Result: 在HypBench合成网络（N=131,072）和8个真实基准数据集上：1）零样本迁移测试精度在高达32倍压缩率下仍能保持原始尺度精度的绝大部分（GCN在Photo上仅从0.95降至0.85）；2）训练时间显著减少（GraphSAGE在4096节点上训练相比131072节点获得约20倍加速）；3）线性CKA与正交Procrustes相似度在GR下保持较高水平，而随机基线几乎无跨尺度相似性；4）JS散度训练图差异D_JS^TG在GR下保持接近零，表明输出预测轨迹一致；5）与LRG、MagEdgePool、SpreadEdgePool等粗化方法相比，GR在拓扑保持和迁移精度两方面均最优。

Conclusion: 论文证明：经过几何重正化粗化的GNN权重可以零样本迁移至原始分辨率图，且保留大部分预测性能并大幅降低训练成本。这一现象并非仅由图尺寸缩小导致，因为随机聚合会严重破坏迁移性能——表明保持网络结构是关键。GR在有限尺度范围内近似保留了GNN所学表征空间和有效优化目标。结构性相似性（而非网络规模）可能是决定GNN跨尺度可迁移性的更核心因素，为构建尺度等变(scale-equivariant)图架构开辟了新路径。局限性包括：未对节点特征做原则性的尺度变换、GNN超参数固定、GR仅限一维相似空间、主要研究同配性图和节点级任务。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) can operate on large graphs but become infrastructure-sensitive at the scale of millions of nodes and typically require scalable training techniques for even larger graphs. This raises a central question: when can a model trained on a smaller, scaled-down replica of a graph be deployed on the full-resolution graph without retraining? We introduce a zero-shot transfer protocol in which a GNN is trained on a graph coarse-grained by geometric renormalization (GR), and the resulting weights are transferred directly to the original network. Across synthetic and real-world networks, training on GR scaled-down replicas preserves much of the original-scale predictive performance while significantly reducing training cost. We further find that learned representations and predictive trajectories remain aligned across scales. These findings suggest that structural similarity may be more important than network size in determining GNN transferability, opening a path toward scale-equivariant graph architectures.

</details>


### [199] [LoRA Scaffolded Policy Optimization (LSPO): A Sampling-Time Low-Rank Scaffold for Recovering Reinforcement-Learning Gradient on Zero-Reward Cliff Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27787)
*Ken Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LSPO（LoRA Scaffolded Policy Optimization），通过在采样时附加LoRA适配器恢复GRPO在零奖励"悬崖"提示上的梯度信号，使基础模型在数学推理RLVR训练中取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR中GRPO在"悬崖"提示（所有采样均失败）上因组归一化优势为零而无法产生梯度，而这些提示恰好处于模型能力前沿，需要学习信号。

Method: 采样时检测悬崖提示，附加低秩LoRA适配器在真实解上做SFT，重新采样并仅将成功的rollout拼接回RL批次（带重要性采样修正），采用双优化器严格分离梯度（监督→适配器，RL→基础模型），适配器在检查点丢弃。

Result: 在DeepMath-103K训练DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B（5配对种子，1000步报告窗口），LSPO在16个(benchmark, pass@k)单元上均匹配或击败DAPO基线（15严格胜+1平局），AIME24/pass@4提升+10.7点，16单元平均+3.82点；悬崖转换率约43%。

Conclusion: LSPO证明了悬崖问题可在采样时通过瞬态低秩参数中的监督信号解决，无需修改RL损失或永久写入基础模型权重；交付物为纯基础模型，无适配器权重。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) for mathematical reasoning suffers from a structural blind spot: on "cliff" prompts-those on which every sampled rollout in a group fails-the group-normalized advantage is identically zero, so GRPO produces no gradient on precisely the prompts at the frontier of the model's capability. We introduce LoRA Scaffolded Policy Optimization (LSPO), a sampling-time mechanism that recovers this lost gradient. Each RL step, LSPO detects cliff prompts, fits a small low-rank (LoRA) adapter by a brief supervised step on their ground-truth solutions, re-rolls the cliffs with the base-plus-adapter model, splices the now-successful completions back into the RL batch with an importance-sampling correction, and takes a GRPO step on the base alone; the adapter receives only the supervised gradient and is discarded at checkpoint, yielding a base-only model. On DeepMath-103K with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, evaluated over n=5 paired seeds per arm at a matched 1000-step reporting horizon, LSPO's 5-seed mean matches or beats a DAPO baseline on all 16 (benchmark, pass@k) cells (15 strict wins and one exact tie), with gains of up to +10.7 points on AIME24/pass@4, +6.7 points on AIME24 and AIME26 at pass@16, and +2.4 points on MATH500/pass@1; averaged over the 16 cells the improvement is +3.8 points.

</details>


### [200] [Class-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Counterfactual Explanation Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27905)
*Muhammad Adil Saleem,Syed Ali Raza,Mary-Anne Williams*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于反事实解释（CFE）生成的**类别感知强化学习方法**。通过在RL状态表示中纳入实例的预测类别，显著提升了CFE的生成效率与质量，在收敛速度、奖励值、回合长度及有效性等关键指标上均优于类别盲RL基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于RL生成反事实解释的方法，其状态表示仅包含数据集中的预测器特征，排除了实例的预测类别。直觉上，CFE的目标是改变实例的预测结果，因此将当前类别信息纳入状态有助于RL智能体做出更优的决策。作者验证此假设，并指出虽然在监督学习中纳入类别信息通常被视为数据泄露，但在RL生成CFE的情境中具有合理性与价值。

Method: 1. 将CFE生成建模为**马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）**，组件包括状态、动作、转移函数和奖励函数。状态由各特征值及实例类别组成；动作对应于每个可变特征的增/减调整。2. 采用**PPO算法**学习策略，使用XGBoost作为黑箱预测器（默认设置200棵树，学习率0.05）。3. 奖励函数综合考量**有效性（+10）、稀疏性和接近度（余弦距离）**，未触发翻转则给予小负奖励。4. 在7个不同规模数据集上对比**类别感知RL**与**类别盲RL**，并使用SHAP与LIME分析特征重要性。5. 此外与DiCE和ReLAX两种基准方法进行对比。

Result: 1. **训练阶段**：类别感知RL在所有数据集上均获得更高回合奖励和更短回合长度，收敛速度更快、最终方差更低（Breast Cancer收敛值相近，但收敛更快）。2. **测试阶段**：有效性显著优于基线（p=0.0071），Default Credit数据集绝对提升达8%；稀疏性在5/7数据集上更优，接近度在4/7数据集上更优。3. **特征重要性**：基于SHAP，类别特征在5/7数据集中排名第一，其余也位列前三；基于LIME，类别特征在4/7数据集中排名第一。4. **与基准对比**：与DiCE、ReLAX对比，类别感知RL在稀疏性方面优势明显，有效性约99%略低，但整体具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 在RL生成CFE的状态表示中加入实例的预测类别，能够同时提升训练效率与测试质量：加快收敛、提高奖励、缩短回合，并显著提高CFE的有效性、稀疏性和接近度。SHAP与LIME分析进一步验证类别信息是RL决策中最具影响力的特征之一。未来工作可拓展至非表格数据（图像、文本）、深入优化RL奖励函数，并评估其在下游任务中的实际效用。

Abstract: Counterfactual explanations (CFEs) enhance the interpretability of black-box models by generating alternative instances with adjusted feature values that achieve a contrastive outcome. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising approach for CFE generation, enabling efficient exploration of counterfactual instances while ensuring control over key metrics like validity, sparsity, and proximity. Previous studies have formulated RL states exclusively using features derived from the predictors in the supervised dataset. This study explores the impact of including an instance's predicted class, alongside features derived from the predictors, in the RL state representation for generating CFEs. The hypothesis is that class-awareness enhances exploration efficiency and improves policy optimality. We compare the proposed class-aware RL method with the class-blind RL method, which is similar but excludes the instance's class information from the state representation. The comparison was conducted using seven datasets from diverse domains, varying in size. The results show that during training, class-aware RL offers benefits in terms of convergence speed, reward optimization, and episode length reduction. Moreover, it generates significantly more valid CFEs compared to class-blind RL. Finally, the instance's class-based feature consistently ranks among the most influential predictors in RL's action-selection, as shown by the SHAP and LIME values, underscoring the significance of class-awareness in RL for CFE generation. The impact is heightened clarity, faster learning, improved validity, and more effective counterfactual generation across diverse datasets.

</details>


### [201] [TAPO: Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27973)
*Cong Li,Peixi Peng,Yisen Zhao,Xinyu Hu,Shudong Liu,Zhan Su,Zhuojian Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TAPO（Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents），一种通过交替进行策略优化与转移监督来增强LLM智能体环境建模能力的轻量级、即插即用训练框架。该方法复用RL rollout中已有的(s, a, s')三元组数据，在共享骨干模型上施加"动作条件下的下一观测预测"辅助监督任务，无需额外专家数据、采样成本或推理开销，在WebShop和ALFWorld两个基准上对GRPO/GiGPO算法均带来稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体的强化学习方法（如GRPO、GiGPO）主要依赖稀疏的任务奖励信号进行策略优化，未能充分利用在线交互中天然存在的一类密集监督信号——动作执行后的环境反馈（即(s_t, a_t, s_{t+1})转移信号）。理论研究表明，多步目标导向任务中泛化能力依赖于智能体对环境后果的预测性知识。已有方法（如Early Experience、RWML）虽尝试引入世界建模，但通常将其作为RL前的独立阶段，需要额外数据采集或专家数据。论文旨在解决：能否在不增加额外成本的前提下，仅通过复用现有RL rollout中的转移数据，同步增强智能体的策略能力与环境后果建模能力。

Method: TAPO框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 转移监督目标——从RL rollout轨迹中直接抽取(s_t, a_t, s_{t+1})三元组，构建转移监督数据集D，通过teacher-forcing方式在共享骨干模型上施加下一观测预测的负对数似然损失 L_TS(θ) = -E[log p_θ(s_{t+1}|s_t, a_t)]；(2) 交替训练机制——以超参数I为间隔交替执行标准RL策略优化（GRPO或GiGPO目标）和转移监督更新，通过同一组参数θ共享，使转移监督塑造的表示能够反馈至策略生成过程。方法无需独立世界模型、不引入额外推理开销、不需要额外环境交互或专家数据。

Result: 在WebShop和ALFWorld上，使用Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct模型，结合GRPO/GiGPO算法：(1) TAPO-GRPO相对vanilla GRPO在1.5B模型上WebShop成功率从56.8%提升至66.2%，ALFWorld从72.8%提升至76.4%；7B模型上WebShop从66.1%提升至73.7%，ALFWorld从77.6%提升至83.6%；(2) TAPO-GiGPO在所有设置下均优于vanilla GiGPO；(3) 在ALFWorld 7B上达到93.6%成功率，优于Early Experience(82.8%)和RWML(90.1%)；(4) 消融实验显示I=4为最佳交替频率，全过程监督显著优于仅早期监督（前20/40步）；(5) 困惑度分析表明TAPO显著增强了模型对环境反馈的条件建模能力，案例研究显示智能体学会了条件分支式的前瞻性规划。存在轻微的领域外通用能力折损（如GSM8K准确率小幅下降）。

Conclusion: TAPO作为一种计算轻量、即插即用的增强模块，能够一致性地提升现有智能体RL算法在长视野任务上的性能。其核心价值在于揭示了RL rollout中蕴含的转移信号本身即是宝贵的密集学习信号，并证明了转移监督应作为贯穿整个后训练过程的辅助目标，而非仅作为预热阶段。未来工作将探索更优的监督形式、训练调度策略，以及在智能体任务增益与通用能力保持之间的最佳平衡。

Abstract: Recently, Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a crucial paradigm for the post-training of Large Language Model (LLM) agents. However, existing methods predominantly rely on sparse task rewards for policy optimization, failing to fully exploit another class of inherently dense supervisory signals naturally present during online interaction: environmental feedback following action execution. Recent theoretical studies suggest that generalization in multi-step, goal-oriented tasks hinges on predictive knowledge of environmental consequences. Inspired by this, we propose TAPO: Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents, a unified training framework that alternates between policy optimization and transition supervision. Beyond standard RL updates, TAPO repurposes rollout data to apply action-conditioned next-observation prediction supervision on a shared backbone model. This approach enhances the model's sensitivity to environmental transition dynamics and action consequences while concurrently optimizing the policy. It serves as a computationally lightweight, plug-and-play enhancement module for existing agent RL algorithms, requiring no additional expert data, extra sampling costs, or inference-time overhead. We conduct systematic experiments on WebShop and ALFWorld, integrating foundation models of various scales with different policy optimization algorithms. Empirical results demonstrate that TAPO consistently improves task performance over pure policy optimization baselines.

</details>


### [202] [Flux-OPD: On-Policy Distillation with Evolving Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28022)
*Yuran Wang,Zekun Wang,Bohan Zeng,Ruixu Zhang,Wenxuan Liu,Liu Yang,Yifan Dai,Yang Shi,Bozhou Li,Chengzhuo Tong,Daili Hua,Yuanxing Zhang,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Flux-OPD，一种利用演化上下文作为训练中监督的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）范式。通过对反向KL目标进行分解，揭示学生被蒸馏至上下文条件教师的归一化几何均值，且目标中包含衡量教师间冲突的冲突项。基于此设计"上下文修正"（以无上下文教师为锚点，注入上下文差异信号）和"上下文加权"（以冲突项为指标调整修正强度）两种蒸馏策略，在视频生成提示优化和医学问答两个开放性任务上优于现有OPD范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放性领域（如医疗、视频生成提示优化）缺乏可验证奖励，难以将任务偏好形式化为有效监督信号。上下文能够表达这类偏好，但在蒸馏后对学生的额外监督贡献有限。直接将演化上下文作为训练中监督会导致蒸馏目标不稳定且不同上下文间产生冲突分布。因此需要：(1) 稳定蒸馏目标；(2) 降低冲突分布的影响；(3) 在单次连续训练中使上下文随学生表现共同演化。

Method: **理论分析**：对反向KL目标进行分解，得到**蒸馏项**（学生与上下文条件教师几何均值间的KL散度）和**冲突项**（−log Z，衡量教师间分布一致性）。后者在固定解码历史和上下文条件下不贡献直接梯度。**方法设计**：
- **迭代训练**：单次连续训练分K次迭代，每轮包含上下文提取和上下文蒸馏两个阶段。教师从学生轨迹提取经验项作为上下文，并对这些条件化。
- **上下文修正（Contextual Correction）**：将目标锚定于稳定的无上下文教师 q₀，注入上下文差异信号 Δₖ = log q_geo,k − log q₀，通过 λₖ·Δₖ 在log空间插值得到修正后目标，稳定训练目标。
- **上下文加权（Contextual Weighting）**：以冲突项 δₖ = −log Zₖ 作为指标调整修正强度 λₖ = α·clip(1 − δₖ/τ, λ_min, λ_max)，分布一致时增强修正，冲突时减弱修正。

Result: 在两个开放性任务上进行验证：**任务1 - 视频生成提示优化**：使用Qwen3-VL-Instruct 8B教师+4B学生、Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 32B教师+7B学生两种设置，在VBench和Video-Bench上Flux-OPD均取得最佳总分（如4B学生VBench平均分80.18 vs OPD的79.28、OPCD的79.02、OEL的76.86）。**任务2 - 医学问答**：使用Qwen3 8B教师+1.7B学生，HealthBench总分从学生初始的19.06提升至20.61（OPD为19.63、OPCD为19.53、OEL为19.66）。**消融实验**：验证了演化上下文、上下文修正、上下文加权三个组件均有效（满分为20.61，移除各项分别为19.63/19.73/19.97）。**稳定性**：Flux-OPD训练损失平稳下降，避免了OEL的损失尖峰。**泛化性**：在IF-Eval上获得更高的prompt-level严格准确率，跨域泛化能力更强。三次独立运行结果一致。

Conclusion: Flux-OPD通过反向KL分解揭示了上下文条件教师蒸馏的几何均值结构和冲突项，并基于此设计了一种既能稳定训练又能利用演化上下文的OPD范式。实验证明该方法在两个真实开放性任务上、一系列学生-教师配置下均优于OPD、OPCD和OEL等基线，展示了将教师监督与演化上下文相结合作为训练中监督的潜力。

Abstract: Large language model training in open-ended domains lacks verifiable rewards, making task preferences difficult to formalize as effective supervision. Contexts can convey such preferences, yet provide little additional supervision once distilled into the student, motivating contexts that evolve with student performance. However, directly using evolving contexts as in-training supervision results in an unstable distillation target and conflicting distributions, requiring mechanisms to stabilize target and downweight conflicts. In this paper, we analyze the effect of contexts through a decomposition of the reverse KL objective, revealing two findings: the student is distilled toward the geometric mean of context-conditioned teachers, and the objective contains a conflict term that measures conflicts among these teachers. Based on this decomposition, we propose Flux-OPD, an OPD paradigm that uses evolving contexts as in-training supervision to capture task preferences in open-ended domains. Flux-OPD treats the differences between context-conditioned and context-free teachers as contextual difference signals, injects them as contextual corrections into the context-free teacher anchor, and weights their correction strength using the conflict term as an indicator. Experiments on open-ended tasks show that Flux-OPD outperforms existing OPD paradigms, highlighting the potential to combine teacher supervision with evolving contexts.

</details>


### [203] [Chem World: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Physics-Informed Framework for Trustworthy Chemical Property Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28079)
*Tianyou Bai,Huan Wang,Mingchen Gao,Fangyue Lin,Pinze Ren,Zhenlin Zhao,Siming Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Chem World——首个统一的大规模化学混合物性质预测基准（整合17个公开数据集、80万+样本、10条性质预测轨道），以及Mixture-PINN——一种融合物理先验知识的混合物性质预测框架。Mixture-PINN通过组合一致性损失、相互作用对称性损失、热力学一致性损失和物理边界约束，在10个性质轨道中7个取得最优性能，并在三种OOD划分下均显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有化学性质预测基准存在三个核心缺陷：(1) 任务多样性有限，多数聚焦单一性质或孤立分子；(2) 数据碎片化，不同数据集的分子表示、组分格式、目标定义各异，难以系统比较；(3) 缺乏统一评估协议，特别是对混合物系统（电解液、共晶溶剂、燃料混合物等）而言，涌现性质无法由单分子结构推断，亟需依赖组分组成和分子间相互作用建模。此外，纯数据驱动方法易捕获违反物理化学原理的统计相关，导致泛化能力差、物理不一致预测。

Method: **Chem World基准构建**：通过四阶段流程（数据收集→标准化→质量控制→任务组织）整合17个公开数据集，覆盖分子系统、混合物、离子液体、聚合物电解液、深共晶溶剂和燃料配方。采用统一混合表示M={(m_i, x_i)}，并按相互作用复杂度划分为三个层级（分子组分级、混合物组成级、相互作用涌现级），最终形成10条性质预测轨道。默认采用5折交叉验证（70/10/20划分），并提供三种OOD划分协议（组分数量、分子身份排除、温度范围）。**Mixture-PINN框架**：包含三个核心组件——(1) 分子编码器（支持GNN、RDKit、MolT5、MolFormer）；(2) 交互感知混合聚合器，先构建理想混合先验h_ideal=Σx̃_i h_i，再通过MLP从[h_ideal; h_learned; h_learned-h_ideal]学习非理想残差修正；(3) 物理引导学习模块，包含四项可微正则化损失：组成一致性L_comp（对齐注意力权重与实际摩尔分数）、相互作用对称性L_int（e_ij≈e_ji）、热力学一致性L_thermo（通过自动微分对温度一阶导数施加单调性约束、对二阶导数施加平滑性约束）、物理边界约束L_bound（防止负密度等非物理解）。最终采用FiLM调制融合温度/压力上下文，对电导率等结构化任务可选择预测Arrhenius/VFT参数而非直接预测观测值。

Result: **主排行榜**：MolFormer+Mixture-PINN在全部10条轨道的中位指标上最优（RMSE=0.743, MAE=0.521, R²=0.918, Pearson=0.958），优于所有基线组合（含Set Transformer、Self-Attention、DeepSets）。**分轨道性能**：Mixture-PINN在10条轨道中7条夺冠，包括电导率（R²=0.914）、密度（R²=0.921）、粘度（R²=0.903）、混合焓（R²=0.887）、辛烷值（R²=0.926）、溶解度（R²=0.891）、嗅觉感知相似度（R²=0.742）；但在熔化焓（R²=0.792）和熔点（R²=0.803）上MolT5+XGBoost更优，因固态相变主要依赖单分子几何对称性而非流体混合热力学。**OOD泛化**：在scaffold-disjoint、component-disjoint、composition extrapolation三种设置下，Mixture-PINN的R²分别达0.842/0.811/0.778，均显著超越Set Transformer（0.756/0.704/0.671），证明物理约束有效提升了对未见识别化学系统的外推能力。**消融实验**：移除全部物理约束后，平均RMSE从2.843升至3.782，R²从0.934降至0.861，且方差大幅增加；其中L_bound贡献最大（移除后RMSE升至3.216），其次为L_thermo。**诊断分析**：纯数据驱动基线在极端热条件下常产生负密度等非物理预测，而Mixture-PINN通过L_bound保证全浓度范围的物理一致性，并在y=x对角线附近保持齐次误差分布。

Conclusion: Chem World与Mixture-PINN的结合建立了面向可信AI for Chemistry的统一评估平台与物理引导学习方法。基准通过17个数据集、10条性质轨道、5折CV与三种OOD协议解决了数据碎片化问题；Mixture-PINN通过将化学先验（组成守恒、相互作用对称、热力学单调性、物理边界）编码为可微正则化，在多数混合物性质上实现了更高的精度、鲁棒性和物理一致性。固态相变类性质仍由基于树模型的单分子描述符主导，提示未来工作应针对晶体几何信息设计专用编码方案。局限性包括继承自实验数据的测量不确定性与标签噪声，以及物理约束在新化学系统上的迁移仍需进一步验证。作者已在Hugging Face开源基准与源代码，并基于Qwen 3.5构建了多性质预测的智能体工作流。

Abstract: Chemical property prediction plays a critical role in accelerating scientific discovery in chemistry, materials science, and drug development. However, existing benchmarks often suffer from limited task diversity, fragmented datasets, and inconsistent evaluation protocols, making it challenging to systematically assess the reliability and generalization of AI models. In this work, we introduce Chem World, a comprehensive benchmark for chemical property prediction that integrates 17 diverse chemical datasets with over 800,000 molecular samples, covering various properties including density, electrical conductivity, solubility, and other molecular characteristics. Chem World provides a unified platform for evaluating AI models across multiple property prediction tasks. Furthermore, we propose Mixture-PINN, a physics-informed neural network based prediction framework that incorporates chemical prior knowledge into data-driven learning, improving the accuracy, robustness, and reliability of chemical property prediction. Extensive experiments on Chem World demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach compared with existing methods. By combining large-scale standardized evaluation with physics-informed learning, Chem World establishes a foundation for developing trustworthy AI systems for computational chemistry and advancing AI-driven scientific discovery.

</details>


### [204] [Information Bottleneck Learning for Faithful Time Series Forecasting Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28124)
*Xu Zheng,Wei Cheng,Zhuomin Chen,Mo Sha,Jingchao Ni,Dongsheng Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: IB-Forecast是一种固有的可解释多元时间序列预测框架，将预测分解为周期性分量和带可解释掩码的残差分量，通过预算受限的信息瓶颈实现端到端优化，在保证忠实解释的同时匹配黑盒模型的预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可解释预测器仅展示内部结构，但未保证这些结构忠实地反映驱动预测的底层证据；而面向忠实性的方法几乎专门针对事后分类任务设计。多步预测具有持续水平/尺度、周期性时间结构和跨变量/未来时间跨度的输入相关偏差，使得直接迁移面向分类的归因方法不足够。需要弥合忠实性与预测之间的差距。

Method: 将预测分解为：(1) 学习到的周期性轮廓Q（捕捉日/周变化等循环模式），(2) 通过patch和通道上二元稀疏掩码控制输入令牌的门控偏差读出。在结构化背景C=(τ; μ, σ; Q)（即相位、通道均值、标准差和周期轮廓）下，预测仅依赖于掩码E和选中的令牌，满足马尔可夫链X→E→Ŷ|C。通过硬二值Concrete门和直通估计器训练最小化信息瓶颈目标，包括预测损失、稀疏Bernoulli先验KL正则、预算约束惩罚和时间连续性TV正则。解释天然蕴含在前向传播中。
