A local Rademacher argument establishes an upper bound of O~(rd/n) on the excess risk of the empirical risk minimizer over rank-r LoRA, whenever the target adaptation has rank at most r. A matching minimax lower bound of Omega(rd/n) is then proved via a Fano-type packing of the rank-r subspace of R^{d x d}; the bound applies to any estimator whose output lies in the rank-r LoRA class. Combining the two yields a rank-selection dichotomy. For the constrained empirical risk minimizer, the optimal rank equals the intrinsic rank r*, and over-ranking strictly hurts. For adaptive estimators of the nuclear-norm-then-truncate type, over-ranking is harmless and the rate saturates at Theta~(r* d / n) regardless of r. Taken together, the three results characterize the statistical complexity of LoRA fine-tuning within the well-specified locally quadratic regime, and identify the empirically observed over-parameterization penalty as a property of unregularized empirical risk minimization rather than of the LoRA class itself. Predictions of the theory are verified on a synthetic trace-regression benchmark and on real LoRA fine-tuning across three (model, task) configurations covering DistilBERT and RoBERTa on SST-2 and MRPC. All configurations exhibit the predicted U-shape in validation loss, with two showing statistically significant loss inflation at large ranks (paired permutation p = 0.016).

</details>


### [254] [Event-Structured Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Differentiable Critical Clearing Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27681)
*Baoli Hao,Chenxi Hu,Ming Zhong,Ren Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ES-PINN（事件结构化物理信息神经网络），通过将网络表示与故障前、故障中、清除后三个阶段的摆动动力学精确对齐，并对事件接口进行硬链接状态链，构建一个可微的临界清除时间（CCT）边界代理模型，显著提升暂态稳定性评估中CCT估计的精度与计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力系统暂态稳定性评估中，临界清除时间（CCT）是一个关键运行指标，但传统基于重复时域仿真的估计方法计算成本极高。现有的PINN方法难以处理故障清除轨迹中的结构难题：（1）故障前、故障中、清除后三个阶段对应不同算子，状态连续但导数一般不连续；（2）清除时刻是查询相关的输入依赖事件位置。整体平滑代理需同时表示所有阶段，分阶段代理通过软接口惩罚会产生状态缺陷并传播到清除后的响应，即使微小的接口缺陷也可能显著偏移估计的稳定性边界。

Method: ES-PINN采用三阶段分离的子网络结构，通过硬链接（hard chain）保证事件接口处状态精确连续：预故障阶段使用精确平衡点x₀；故障中阶段仅接收(t, α)输入；清除后阶段通过将故障中预测在清除时刻t_c处的值作为其事件状态，确保对t_c的可微依赖。提出Taylor门控的局部物理归纳偏置——在事件边界附近采用物理泰勒展开作为低阶约束，在远端通过门控函数让神经网络修正高阶导数。边界提取通过平滑轨迹诱导的稳定性裕度（log-sum-exp平滑最大值减去阈值Δ_max），零等值面给出CCT边界，可通过隐函数定理求局部灵敏度；可选的后置标量读出头将CCT边界蒸馏为单次前向查询。证明局部残差-轨迹-CCT误差估计定理，表明精确事件链消除独立的状态接口缺陷项。多故障扩展采用硬路由的混合专家架构，共享主干和阶段特定颈部，故障特定专家通过已知故障索引k选择。多故障机制包括母线分流故障、线路中点故障和机械功率扰动三种，覆盖拓扑恢复、线路移除和馈线跳闸三种清除动作。

Result: 在IEEE 30节点主基准测试中，ES-PINN相比最强轨迹基线Enhanced XPINN将角度RMSE降低19%、速度RMSE降低17%、CCT MAE降低79%（从1.49ms降至0.32ms），显著优于Vanilla PINN、Enhanced XPINN和PI-DeepONet三种匹配基线。跨系统实验（IEEE 9节点机械扰动、IEEE 14节点线路移除、IEEE 30节点馈线跳闸）验证了框架对不同故障机制和清除动作的通用性。全网络DAE外部验证显示简化模型和ES-PINN的DAE参考MAE相近（IEEE 9节点：12.11 vs 13.10 ms；IEEE 30节点：4.51 vs 3.94 ms）。消融实验证实硬事件链、正确的右端事件导数和阶段残差正则化三者互补：仅去除右端事件导数使CCT MAE增加3.8倍，软链替代硬链使角度RMSE增加7.3倍、CCT MAE增加3.4倍，去除残差损失导致最大CCT退化。运行效率方面，ES-PINN相比简化ODE在CPU上获得1.90倍加速，CUDA上12.81倍加速，蒸馏标量头延迟仅0.064ms。隐式-有限差分灵敏度一致性MAE为15.24 ms/α（较Enhanced XPINN降低35%），相关系数0.999。低数据多故障共享中，10%数据的MoE已超越全数据独立模型的轨迹精度。

Conclusion: 稳定性边界精度不仅依赖于聚合轨迹拟合，还取决于切换事件的表示方式。消融实验识别出精确状态链接、物理右端事件导数和阶段残差正则化的互补作用，跨系统和目标DAE评估进一步支持主基准之外的研究发现。误差分析将这些轨迹级近似与CCT精度联系起来，强调在临界边界附近保持事件局部结构的重要性。当前范围假设已知阶段降阶动力学、已知事件规则和连续发电机状态，未来工作将扩展至高保真DAE、不确定多阶段事件及更大故障族系，目标是不确定性感知且保留可靠运行边界的混合代理模型。

Abstract: Transient-stability assessment determines whether a power system can recover after a disturbance and is therefore essential to preventing generator trips and cascading outages. A key metric is the critical clearing time (CCT), which specifies the maximum time available to clear a fault before synchronism is lost. Reliable CCT estimation is challenging because complicated fault-clearing dynamics require repeated simulations over many fault severities and clearing times. We propose an event-structured physics-informed neural network (ES-PINN) that aligns its representation with the pre-fault, fault-on, and post-clearing swing dynamics and enforces exact state chaining across event interfaces. A smooth trajectory-induced stability margin defines a differentiable approximation of the CCT boundary, enabling accurate boundary extraction, local sensitivity analysis, and optional direct CCT prediction through a distilled readout. We further prove a local residual-to-trajectory-to-CCT error estimate, in which exact event chaining eliminates separate state-interface defect terms. Experiments on IEEE 9-, 14-, and 30-bus systems show that ES-PINN consistently improves held-out trajectory and stability-boundary accuracy over matched neural-surrogate baselines across mechanical and electrical contingencies with multiple clearing configurations. Additional full-network DAE validation, multi-fault experiments, and runtime analyses further demonstrate the effectiveness and computational efficiency of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [255] [NMINE: Normalized Mutual Information Neural Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27710)
*Petra Eerikinharju,Marko Tuononen,Ville Hautamäki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NMINE（Normalized Mutual Information Neural Estimation），一种用于连续多维变量的全神经网络归一化互信息估计器。该方法结合MINE互信息估计器与受MI-NEE启发的神经网络边际熵估计器，使用Donsker-Varadhan变分表示估计互信息，通过学习边际分布与均匀参考分布之间的散度来恢复熵。实验在1-8维高斯数据上验证，相比基于KSG的基线方法，NMINE在所有维度上均显著降低估计误差（相对误差减少30.7%-74.0%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 互信息（MI）是衡量随机变量间统计依赖性的通用度量，能捕捉线性和非线性关系。然而对于连续多维变量，互信息难以精确计算，且其值是无界的，不同数据集、维度或应用之间难以直接比较。归一化互信息（NMI）通过将互信息转换为归一化依赖分数来解决这一问题。现有NMI估计器主要依赖最近邻统计量（如KSG），在高维场景中存在维度敏感性和数值不稳定性的问题。尽管神经互信息估计已有显著进展，但针对连续多维变量的神经归一化互信息估计研究仍不足。

Method: 1. **神经散度估计**：使用Donsker-Varadhan变分表示，独立训练三个神经评判器（fully connected feedforward network，两层128单元隐藏层+ReLU）估计联合分布和两个边际分布相对于均匀参考分布的KL散度。2. **互信息估计**：基于相对熵公式，通过三个散度估计的组合计算 $\hat{I}(X;Y) = \hat{D}_{XY} - \hat{D}_X - \hat{D}_Y$。3. **神经熵估计**：利用NEE启发的方法，通过 $\hat{H}(X) = \log V_X - \hat{D}_X$ 从散度估计中恢复边际熵和联合熵，参考分布选为观测数据支持域上的均匀分布。4. **非对称归一化**：采用Jerdee等人提出的非对称归一化 $\widehat{\mathrm{NMI}}(X;Y) = \hat{I}(X;Y)/\hat{H}(Y)$，保持互信息的排序关系。优化使用Adam优化器（学习率$10^{-5}$），互信息评判器训练500轮，熵评判器训练100轮，批大小256。

Result: 在零均值多元高斯分布（维度$d \in \{1,2,4,8\}$，相关系数$\rho \in \{0,0.1,...,0.95\}$，5000样本，10个随机种子）上进行评估，以KSG基线（$k=5$）作为对比，使用平均绝对误差（MAE）衡量精度。主要结果：NMINE在所有维度上均优于KSG基线，MAE相对减少30.7%-74.0%。配对t检验证实差异统计显著（$t=9.31$, $p=7.89 \times 10^{-19}$）。在高维设置（$d=8$）中，KSG趋于高估NMI并接近归一化上限，而NMINE表现为系统性低估但保持正确的单调关系。在Student-$t$重尾分布上的初步实验显示NMINE具有单调响应和较低变异性。

Conclusion: 本文证明了归一化互信息可在全神经网络框架中有效估计，为传统的基于最近邻的估计方法提供了可行的替代方案。主要贡献包括：1）提出连续多维变量NMI的全神经网络估计器；2）将MINE互信息估计与MI-NEE启发的熵估计统一在一个框架中；3）通过均匀参考分布的神经散度估计推导熵估计；4）在多维高斯数据上验证方法优于KSG基线。局限性包括：未使用额外的方差缩减技术（如SMILE、EMA），MI和熵估计器分开训练，参考分布支持域依赖于有限样本观测范围，计算成本高于最近邻方法。未来工作将聚焦于MI和熵估计器的联合训练、非高斯依赖评估，以及在可解释机器学习、分子动力学、解耦表示学习和分布外检测等领域的应用。

Abstract: Mutual information is a general measure of statistical dependence that captures both linear and nonlinear relationships between random variables. For continuous and multidimensional variables For continuous multidimensional variables, mutual information must be estimated from samples. Because mutual information is unbounded, its values are not directly comparable across datasets, dimensions, or applications. Normalized mutual information addresses this limitation by converting mutual information into a normalized dependency score. Recent work has demonstrated the practical value of normalized mutual information in applications such as molecular dynamics { arXiv:2405.04980 } and interpretable machine learning { arXiv:2409.16768 }, but existing estimators remain sensitive to dimensionality and numerical stability { arXiv:2410.07642 }. In this paper, we propose a fully neural normalized mutual information estimator for continuous variables. The proposed approach combines a MINE-based neural mutual information estimator { arXiv:1801.04062 } with MI-NEE-inspired neural marginal entropy estimators { arXiv:1905.12957 }. Mutual information is estimated using the Donsker--Varadhan representation, while marginal entropies are estimated by learning the divergence between each marginal distribution and a uniform reference distribution, from which entropy is recovered. The resulting estimator provides a neural alternative to k-nearest-neighbor-based normalized mutual information estimation { arXiv:2405.04980 }. Experiments on Gaussian data from one to eight dimensions show that the proposed estimator improves accuracy over a KSG-based normalized mutual information baseline. These results indicate that neural estimation is a promising direction for normalized dependency measurement in continuous multidimensional settings.

</details>


### [256] [VESTIGE: A Knowledge-Guided Masking Strategy for Corruption-Aware Fine-Tuning of Genomic Transformers, Validated on Ancient DNA Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27712)
*Angshuman Chakravertty,Rahul Maheshwari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 VESTIGE，一种无参数、即插即用的掩码语言模型（MLM）collator 替代方案，通过将掩码分布与经验测量的逐位置损坏曲线对齐，解决了标准 MLM 对所有 token 位置施加统一掩码概率的局限性。该方法在古代 DNA（aDNA）重建任务中得到验证，通过 mapDamage2 量化的 C-to-T / G-to-A 位置依赖性脱氨梯度进行重缩放，在多个指标上显著优于标准 MLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 MLM 微调对每个 token 位置施加统一的掩码概率，假设重建难度与位置无关。然而，当退化过程具有特征性并集中在可预测的位置时（如 aDNA 中胞嘧啶脱氨导致的 C-to-T / G-to-A 位置依赖性梯度），该假设会失效：在峰值损伤位点，模型的表现甚至可能低于频率匹配（frequency-matched）的随机预测器。这促使作者开发一种能够将掩码分布与已知的逐位置损坏曲线对齐的训练机制。

Method: 作者提出 VESTIGE：1）通过 mapDamage2 经验测量 aDNA 序列的逐位置损坏曲线（PMD array）；2）重新缩放掩码概率使平均 C/G 掩码率等于 15%（与标准 MLM 相同），从而隔离空间重分布作为唯一变量；3）保持模型、数据、种子和超参数固定，仅替换 collator；4）在 DNABERT-2 上对猛犸象 CDS 语料（两个标本，七个基因）进行配对实验，跨六个末端区域宽度和 626 个配对窗口进行评估；5）下游任务包括 ESMFold 三维重建（TM-score 评估）和基于 1D CNN 的生物安全分类器（AUC 评估）。作者强调该原理是领域无关的：任何可测量的位置或上下文特定损坏曲线（FFPE、亚硫酸氢盐、宏基因组或纳米孔）都可直接替代 PMD 数组。

Result: 在六个末端区域宽度和 626 个配对窗口中，VESTIGE 在所有宽度上均优于标准 MLM（Δ = +4.18 至 +10.35 个百分点，所有 p < 10⁻⁸）；验证交叉熵降低 13%（3.274 对比 3.757）；在损伤放大 10-30 倍于真实 PMD 率的情况下，ESMFold 重建在六个重建（三个基因）中均达到 TM-score > 0.95；1D CNN 生物安全分类器 AUC = 0.935，清除 98.2% 的重建窗口，剩余 1.76% 可归因于参考基因组特征而非重建伪影。

Conclusion: VESTIGE 是一种知识引导的训练例程，能够使智能系统在退化或噪声序列输入上运行。其实质贡献在于将领域特定的损坏知识（通过经验测量的位置依赖性损坏曲线）注入到 MLM 训练中，无需引入额外参数。其领域无关性意味着该方法可推广到 FFPE、亚硫酸氢盐、宏基因组或纳米孔测序等任何具有可测量位置或上下文特定损坏曲线的问题，确立了"将训练分布与退化分布对齐"作为处理噪声序列数据的通用原则。

Abstract: Standard masked-language-model fine-tuning applies a uniform masking probability across every token position, assuming reconstruction difficulty is position-agnostic. When the degradation process is characterised and concentrated at predictable positions, this assumption fails: at peak damage sites the model can underperform a frequency-matched random predictor. We introduce VESTIGE, a parameter-free, drop-in replacement for the standard MLM collator that aligns the masking distribution with an empirically measured per-position corruption profile. We apply it to ancient DNA (aDNA) reconstruction, where cytosine deamination produces a position-dependent C-to-T / G-to-A gradient quantified per-position by mapDamage2. Rescaling so the mean C/G masking rate equals 15% - identical to standard MLM - isolates spatial redistribution as the sole variable, with model, data, seed, and hyperparameters held fixed across both DNABERT-2 runs on a mammoth CDS corpus (two specimens, seven genes). Across six terminal-zone widths and 626 paired windows, VESTIGE leads standard MLM at every width (Delta = +4.18 to +10.35 pp, all p < 10^-8), cuts validation cross-entropy by 13% (3.274 vs. 3.757), and yields ESMFold reconstructions with TM-score > 0.95 across all six reconstructions (three genes) even under damage amplified 10-30x beyond authentic PMD rates. A 1D CNN biosecurity classifier returns AUC = 0.935 and clears 98.2% of reconstructed windows, the 1.76% remainder attributable to reference-genome features, not reconstruction artefacts. The principle is domain-agnostic: any measurable position- or context-specific corruption profile - FFPE, bisulfite, metagenomic, or nanopore - substitutes directly for the PMD array, making VESTIGE a knowledge-guided training routine for intelligent systems operating on degraded or noisy sequence inputs.

</details>


### [257] [Improving the Robustness/Accuracy Tradeoff Against Adversarial Attacks Using Information Bottleneck Distillation Through Dual Teachers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27737)
*Vincent Ryusuke Takahashi,Yoshinari Takeishi,Jun'ichi Takeuchi,Kave Salamatian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对深度神经网络面临的对抗攻击脆弱性问题，提出两种基于信息瓶颈蒸馏（IBD）的双教师蒸馏框架：双重蒸馏（DD）和联合蒸馏（JD），通过引入一个仅在干净样本上训练的"干净教师"与对抗训练的"鲁棒教师"协同指导学生模型，在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上实现更好的干净精度与鲁棒精度平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗训练等防御方法虽能提升深度神经网络对对抗样本的鲁棒性，但通常会显著降低模型在干净样本上的分类精度。IBD（信息瓶颈蒸馏）等方法同样面临这种"精度/鲁棒性权衡"问题。本文旨在通过引入额外的"干净教师"来缓解这一权衡，在保持对抗鲁棒性的同时提升干净精度。

Method: 提出两种双教师蒸馏架构：(1) 双重蒸馏（DD）：干净样本由干净教师提供软标签，对抗样本由鲁棒教师提供软标签和特征蒸馏；(2) 联合蒸馏（JD）：在DD基础上，额外从干净教师蒸馏中间层特征，两个蒸馏分支各有独立的跨层注意力矩阵。损失函数由交叉熵、KL散度和注意力加权的特征匹配项组成。同时研究了全局正则化与选择性正则化两种训练配置对注意力模块行为的影响。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上，DD和JD方法在最优配置下均取得比基线IBD更高的干净精度（DD达84.97%，JD达85.08%）及更高的谐波均值（综合权衡指标）。在CIFAR-10上，JD在所有对抗攻击下均达到最高的鲁棒精度和最高的谐波均值。在CIFAR-100上，JD也持续获得最高的谐波均值。方法对较大规模的学生模型效果更为显著。代价是训练参数增至约115.4M，训练时间约为IBD的1.5倍。

Conclusion: 双教师信息瓶颈蒸馏框架（DD和JD）能有效改善对抗鲁棒性与干净精度之间的权衡，尤其在使用较大学生模型时优势明显。但训练复杂度增加，需要在性能与计算开销之间做出权衡。受B-MTARD启发的自适应平衡变体（B-DD/B-JD）虽进一步提升了干净精度，但在强对抗攻击（如AutoAttack）下鲁棒性下降，故未被采纳为主要方法。

Abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved remarkable success in classical machine learning problems. However, they are known to be vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Countermeasures proposed in the literature, notably Information Bottleneck Distillation (IBD) introduced by Kuang et al., degrade the classification accuracy on clean inputs while improving the robustness to adversarial inputs. In this work, we extend the IBD framework by introducing an extra teacher model (clean teacher) trained with only clean inputs, into the distillation process from a robust teacher model trained by adversarial training. The features of both clean and robust teachers are transferred to the student through a cross-layer attention matrix. Experimental results on the CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 datasets show that the proposed method improves classification accuracy on clean samples compared to the original IBD, while maintaining similar accuracy on adversarial samples. Furthermore, our methods are competitive with state-of-the-art approaches, including the recent dual-teacher distillation framework B-MTARD, particularly in terms of the harmonic mean between clean and robust accuracy. We also analyze the impact of different training settings that have different influences on the attention module.

</details>


### [258] [DAS-PMVC: A Framework for Partial Multi-View Clustering via Dual Alignment and Structure Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27761)
*Shubin Ma,Liang Zhao,Chuanye He,Zhenjiao Liu,Liang Zou,Lin Yuanbo Wu,Yu Shao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了DAS-PMVC框架，用于解决部分视图对齐问题（PVAP）下的多视图聚类任务。该框架通过锚点图结构对齐、结构增强特征学习和双重对齐策略三个核心组件，有效处理视图间不对齐数据，并在多个数据集上超越了现有最优方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视图聚类通常假设各视图间样本完全对应，但实际场景中由于数据采集设备限制、硬件故障或噪声，不同视图间常出现对应关系丢失的问题（PVAP）。现有方法存在两个主要局限：(1) 无法有效利用视图的结构信息，忽视了视图间的结构一致性；(2) 仅对训练样本执行单次对齐，导致较大的对齐误差。因此需要一种能够联合进行视图对齐与下游聚类任务、并充分利用图结构信息的方法。

Method: DAS-PMVC框架包含三个核心部分：(1) **锚点图结构对齐**：利用已对齐样本作为锚点，构建二部图计算未对齐样本与锚点的相似度，经结构过滤后获得联合嵌入表示，再通过匈牙利算法求解置换矩阵实现初始对齐；(2) **结构增强特征学习**：采用两阶段训练策略——预训练阶段使用重构损失和结构对齐损失训练自编码器，训练阶段使用多视图图卷积网络（GCN）从对齐图结构中提取深度潜在特征，包含样本重构损失、结构重构损失和对比学习损失；(3) **双重对齐策略**：在预训练阶段通过锚点图进行初始对齐，在训练阶段通过GCN学习特征后，再次使用匈牙利算法在特征空间进行二次对齐，进一步优化潜在特征的对齐精度。最终对二次对齐后的特征进行谱聚类得到聚类结果。

Result: 在6个多视图数据集（Caltech20、BDGP、Scene-15、Aloi、3Sources、BBCsports）上与8种先进方法对比，在50%视图对齐率下，DAS-PMVC在5个数据集上取得最优ACC（如3Sources上ACC达0.5341，超第二名5.79%；Caltech20上ACC达0.5731，超第二名5.97%）。消融实验表明：锚点图对齐方法相比属性直接对齐方法在视图对齐性能上提升最大超过50个百分点；移除锚点对齐模块后（PMGCN）性能显著下降，验证了各模块的有效性。但在BDGP数据集上表现不佳，原因是GCN难以捕捉该数据集隐式且微弱的局部结构关系；在Aloi数据集上NMI和ARI指标因类别数过多而略逊。

Conclusion: DAS-PMVC通过双重对齐策略有效减少了单步对齐的误差，结构增强和结构引导的特征提取缓解了无关样本的影响，在多个数据集上显著优于现有方法，证明了其在部分视图对齐多视图聚类任务中的有效性和优越性。未来工作将聚焦于探索GCN在结构相关性较弱数据上的适用性。

Abstract: In recent years, multi-view clustering has attracted widespread research interest. However, due to limitations in data collection devices, data across different views often suffer from misalignment, leading to the partial view alignment problem (PVAP). To mitigate the impact of view asymmetry and irrelevant samples, this paper proposes a framework for partial multi-view clustering via dual alignment and structure enhancement (DAS-PMVC), which leverages view structure consistency and semantic relevance. Specifically, DAS-PMVC includes three parts: \textbf{anchor graph structure alignment}, where sample joint embedding representations with consistent latent space are derived from anchor point relationships for initial view alignment; \textbf{structure-enhanced feature learning}, where the model learns view structure information through pretraining and combines multi-view graph convolutional networks to further extract deep latent features from the aligned graph structure to improve the discriminative power of representations; and \textbf{a dual alignment strategy}, where initial alignment is performed through the anchor graph in the pretraining phase, and contrastive learning loss and the Hungarian algorithm are introduced in the training phase to further optimize the alignment of latent features. Experimental results on various datasets demonstrate that the DAS-PMVC framework outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in clustering performance, showcasing its effectiveness and superiority.

</details>


### [259] [Beyond the Best Teacher: Expanding and Compressing the Reasoning Solution Manifold](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27770)
*Songshuo Lu,Zhi Chen,Yaohua Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"先扩展后压缩"框架：通过残差GRPO（RGRPO）训练多个互补教师策略，再通过可靠性门控的教师联合在线策略蒸馏（TU-OPD）结合共识-残差分解（Consensus-Residual Decomposition），将多个互补教师压缩为单一学生模型。Qwen3-1.7B学生在数学推理、代码生成和指令跟随任务上分别以2.0%、8.3%、6.9%的相对优势超越最强单个教师。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单次强化学习运行只能强化部分有效解模式，所训练的策略是推理解流形（多盆地结构）上的局部探针而非全局可靠的监督者。因此应将RL训练的教师视为互补的专家集合，而非选择单一最优教师——需要构建并压缩一个互补的教师联合体。

Method: 两阶段框架：（1）扩展阶段——残差GRPO（RGRPO）从同一初始化π₀训练M个教师，每轮将后续训练重定向到尚未被教师联合覆盖的样本（覆盖阈值τ_drop）；（2）压缩阶段——可靠性门控的教师联合在线策略蒸馏（TU-OPD）让学生从自身生成的前缀中学习，每样本仅可靠教师贡献监督，损失按逐样本质量加权；并引入共识-残差分解，保留获胜教师相对其可靠同伴在Top-K token上的超额偏好，防止专家行为在教师聚合时被抑制。最终损失为L_base + λL_res。

Result: Qwen3-1.7B学生在数学推理（Math Mean 16.70）、代码生成（LiveCodeBench Avg.@8 20.83）和指令跟随（IFBench 28.50）三个领域均超越最强单一教师，相对提升分别为2.0%、8.3%、6.9%。RGRPO相对于随机划分数据的并行GRPO，Macro Avg.@8提升2.71点、Macro Pass@8提升6.61点。Qwen3-4B验证了可扩展性，数学推理提升6.9%。消融实验证实质量感知加权与残差传递均贡献显著，残差目标带来0.71点均提升。

Conclusion: 框架验证了两阶段设计的有效性：覆盖感知的RL训练构造出真正互补的专家，残差感知的在线策略蒸馏将教师联合体压缩为在主要聚合指标上超越所有单个教师的学生模型。核心原则：先构建互补教师，再蒸馏联合体而非平均值。单一模型推理保留部署优势。

Abstract: A single reinforcement-learning run can produce a strong reasoner yet an incomplete teacher: it often amplifies only a subset of the valid solution modes. We argue that reinforcement learning (RL)-trained policies should therefore be viewed as local probes of a multi-basin reasoning solution manifold, rather than as globally reliable supervisors. Based on this view, we propose an expand-then-compress framework that couples teacher construction with multi-teacher policy distillation. In the expansion stage, Residual Group Relative Policy Optimization (RGRPO) trains a sequence of teachers from a common initialization and redirects each later round toward examples not yet covered by the accumulated teacher union. In the compression stage, reliability-gated Teacher-Union On-policy Distillation (TU-OPD) lets the student learn from its own response prefixes. For each example, only reliable teachers contribute, and their sampled-token OPD losses are weighted by their per-example quality. We further introduce Consensus-Residual Decomposition, which preserves a winner teacher's excess token preferences over its reliable peers, preventing specialist behavior from being suppressed during teacher aggregation. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction following show that the resulting Qwen3-1.7B student consistently outperforms the strongest individual teacher across all three domains, yielding relative improvements of 2.0%, 8.3%, and 6.9%, respectively, while retaining single-model inference. These results establish a simple but powerful principle: stronger students can be obtained not by selecting a single better teacher, but by deliberately constructing and compressing a complementary teacher union.

</details>


### [260] [RIPPLE: Generating Multi-Channel Phase, Not Recovering It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27775)
*Jaehyuk Lee,Yeajin Lee,Dayeon Shin,Donghun Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 RIPPLE，将 Griffin-Lim 从相位"恢复器"重新定位为相位"先验"，配合解耦的两阶段 rectified flow 和显式的跨通道相位差（IPD）损失，直接生成多通道波形的相位。在一阶 ambisonics（FOA）环境转换和三分量地震动跨台站翻译两个物理无关领域上，RIPPLE 在下游分析真正消费的相干性指标上均优于基于恢复的管线；最显著的证据是 S 波偏振误差从逐通道恢复的随机水平 57.3° 降至 33.8°。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多通道波形生成管线沿用单通道范式：生成器合成幅度谱，相位被委托给 Griffin-Lim、神经声码器或潜空间解码器等"恢复模块"，且各通道独立处理。对于多通道信号，空间音频的源方向与三分量地震图的粒子运动等物理信息恰好编码在通道间相位关系中，独立恢复会将其完全破坏。问题更隐蔽：业界常用的幅度类指标（波形 L2、MRSTFT、GOF 等）在跨通道相干性坍塌时几乎不变，导致管线可以在丢掉物理信息的情况下仍"看起来"很好。本文主张：多通道相位应当被生成，而非被恢复。

Method: RIPPLE 的核心设计包含四个要素：（1）将 Griffin-Lim 重定位为相位先验而非终解，以源相位 ϕ_init=∠X^(s) 进行迭代初始化，使先验天然携带源端的跨通道结构，再叠加 σ_prior=0.1 的高斯扰动以提供 R² 中径向支撑；（2）采用解耦的两阶段 rectified flow，幅度流从 log|X^(s)| 到 log|X^(t)|、相位流从扰动先验 p₀ 到目标相位 (cos∠X^(t), sin∠X^(t))，两阶段时间步 t_m、t_p 独立采样以解耦学习信号；（3）采用 S¹ 嵌入 (cosϕ, sinϕ) 消除相位的环绕不连续性，并将幅度与相位作为分离场以便幅度为相位提供条件；（4）显式跨通道相位差（IPD）损失，将预测与目标投影到 S¹ 后最大化通道对 (i,j) 相对相位向量的内积，并对低能量 bin 做幅度加权门控。总损失为速度回归、相位质量、IPD 与重建损失的加权和，其中 λ₃、λ₄ 在前 5–15/150–200 个 epoch 内线性预热。推理时先积分幅度流得到预测幅度 m̂，再用 m̂ 与源相位构建先验，最后积分相位流并投影回 S¹。

Result: 在 Spatial LibriSpeech 跨房间 FOA 任务上，RIPPLE 在所有相位敏感与空间精度指标上最优：Δ_Spatial-Angle 从 Diff-SAGe 的 0.425 降至 0.319（相对下降 25%），L1_θ 从 0.261 降至 0.243。ImmerseDiffusion 虽 Wave L2 最低（0.013），但方位误差接近随机（1.523 vs π/2≈1.571），验证了幅度指标对相干性坍塌的盲性。在 SCEDC 跨台站地震翻译上，RIPPLE 平均 GOF 达 68.79（"良"），HEGGS 仅 49.85；最关键的是 S 波偏振误差：所有逐通道恢复方法（GAN 59.1°、HEGGS 55.0°、RIPPLE(GL) 51.9°）均接近 57.3° 的随机期望，而 RIPPLE 降至 33.8°，95% 置信区间 [30.8, 36.9] 与随机水平相差逾 20°。消融实验表明：（i）以高斯先验替代 Griffin-Lim 先验会使两个域同时坍塌到无学习基线；（ii）去掉 IPD 损失（λ₄=0）会使 L1_θ 从 0.243 跃升至 1.627、PAE_S 回到 57.31°；（iii）耦合时间步（t_m=t_p）使 Phase L2 仅轻微退化（0.619→0.807）而 Δ_Spatial-Angle 坍塌至 1.581，定位损坏于跨通道对齐；（iv）即使仅使用先验（不学流），S 波 PAE 已达 44.6°，远低于 57.3° 随机水平，说明源一致性初始化本身已可保留可被转移函数保留的结构。Oracle 重建实验进一步证实瓶颈在恢复阶段而非生成器：在 GT 幅度上做 Griffin-Lim 已使方位误差达 1.567、PAE_S 达 42.9°，三种架构不同的地震生成器共享逐通道恢复时 S 波 PAE 落在 51.9°–56.8° 的窄带内。

Conclusion: 多通道波形的物理内容（ambisonics 中的源方向、地震图中的粒子运动）编码于通道间关系中，而现有方法将相位委托给逐通道恢复，使这一信息被静默丢弃。RIPPLE 通过将 Griffin-Lim 重新解释为源一致的相位先验，并以解耦 rectified flow + IPD 损失将其转化为生成目标，在 FOA 环境转换与地震跨台站翻译两个物理无关领域均于相干性指标上取得显著提升，S 波偏振误差由近随机水平降至 33.8°。该工作将"生成多通道相位而非恢复之"定位为多通道波形建模应作为一等公民的设计原则。局限性在于：框架假设源-目标通过公共信号共享跨通道结构，在低信噪比或转移函数严重破坏共享结构时先验退化为随机初始化；FOA 非回放格式，未进行主观听音测试；Griffin-Lim 迭代次数 K 仅在推理时做了敏感性扫描，训练时固定。

Abstract: Generative models synthesize magnitude spectra with high fidelity, while phase is delegated to a recovery module---Griffin--Lim, a vocoder, or a latent decoder---applied independently to each channel. For multi-channel waveforms this delegation is costly: the physical content of spatial audio and three-component seismograms lives in the phase relationships between channels, precisely what channel-independent recovery cannot produce. The cost is also invisible, since the magnitude-based metrics common to both fields barely move when inter-channel phase coherence collapses---so a pipeline can discard the physical information in its output while still scoring well. We argue that phase should be generated, not recovered, and present RIPPLE (Rectified Inter-channel Phase with Prior-based LEarning), which reinterprets Griffin--Lim as a phase **prior** rather than a final estimator: initialized from the source phase, this prior carries the inter-channel structure to be preserved, and a rectified flow refines it toward the target under an explicit inter-channel phase loss. Tested on first-order ambisonics environment transfer and seismic cross-station translation---two physically unrelated domains---RIPPLE outperforms recovery-based pipelines on the coherence metrics that downstream analyses consume. The seismic case is decisive: across architecturally distinct generators, per-channel recovery leaves S-wave polarization error near the $57.3^\circ$ random expectation, whereas learned phase reduces it to $33.8^\circ$.

</details>


### [261] [Revisiting Predictive Process Monitoring in the Age of Foundation Models: A Comparative Study of Sequence, Tabular, and LLM Approaches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27797)
*Lennart Fertig,Lukas Kirchdorfer,Tobias Sesterhenn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对预测性流程监控（PPM）领域，系统性地比较了三种建模范式——从头训练的经典序列模型（LSTM/Transformer）、基于LoRA微调的大语言模型（LLMs）以及表格基础模型（TabPFN-3/ConTextTab）。在五个真实事件日志和三项预测任务（下一活动NA、剩余时间RT、下个事件时间NT）上的受控基准测试表明：序列模型在NA任务上始终最优，表格基础模型在时间任务上具有竞争力，而LLMs尽管成本更高但整体表现通常落后。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来PPM研究以从头训练的深度序列模型（尤其是LSTM）为主，但随着基础模型（特别是LLMs）在该领域的探索，表格基础模型凭借上下文学习能力也展现出潜力。然而，目前尚缺乏对这三类建模范式在PPM任务上的系统比较，特别是表格基础模型在PPM中的应用尚未被基准测试。因此，社区不清楚在基础模型时代，经典序列模型是否仍然具有竞争力。

Method: 1. **概念比较**：从前缀表示（事件序列 vs. 特征向量）、骨干网络参数化、适应机制（监督学习 vs. PEFT vs. 上下文学习）三个维度对比三种范式。2. **受控实证基准**：在五个公开事件日志（BPI12、BPI17、BPI20的三个变体）上，采用防泄漏的时间划分方法，对比LSTM、Transformer（从头训练）、Llama-3.2-1B与Gemma-2-2b（LoRA微调）、TabPFN-3与ConTextTab（上下文学习）六类模型。3. **评估任务**：下一活动预测（NA，准确率）、剩余时间预测（RT，MSE）、下个事件时间预测（NT，MSE），并记录运行时。4. **分析**：基于分支复杂度（前缀后续活动数）进行切片分析，探究性能差异成因。

Result: **主要发现**：1. **NA任务**：序列模型在所有五个日志上均达到最高准确率，例如BPI12上LSTM达78%，而TabPFN-3和Gemma仅64%。2. **时间任务**：表现更混合，表格模型在RT任务上最频繁地获得最佳结果，序列与表格模型在NT任务上各占两个日志的领先地位。3. **LLMs**：在时间任务上普遍落后，且运行时显著高于其他模型（尤其是BPI17上Llama达112分钟，Gemma达232分钟）。4. **表格模型**：无梯度训练并不意味着低运行时，TabPFN-3在多个日志上比序列模型更慢。5. **分支分析**：NA任务中，序列-表格模型差距随分支复杂度增加而扩大；时间任务中无明显趋势。6. **LLM失败模式**：在BPI12上，LLMs有23%-25%的NA错误源于过早预测序列结束令牌。

Conclusion: 经典序列模型在下一活动预测上仍是最强范式，证明直接从事件数据学习特定于流程的序列模式的有效性；表格基础模型在时间任务上具有竞争力但明显落后于NA任务；LLMs尽管在NA上优于表格模型，但时间任务表现欠佳且成本高昂。序列与表格模型在NA上的性能差距主要由分支复杂度驱动。未来工作应探索更多PPM任务、更广泛的流程特征、更大规模的LLMs以及更适合表格模型的特征表示方法。

Abstract: Predictive process monitoring (PPM) leverages event logs to forecast the future of running process instances, for instance, predicting the next activity, the remaining time until case completion, or the time to the next event. While PPM research in recent years has been dominated by deep sequence models trained from scratch, such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models, foundation-model approaches---particularly large language models (LLMs)---are increasingly explored for PPM. At the same time, tabular foundation models with in-context learning capabilities offer a promising alternative but have not yet been systematically benchmarked for PPM. Thus, it remains unclear whether classical sequence-based models remain competitive in this evolving landscape. This paper compares the three modeling paradigms both conceptually and empirically through a controlled benchmark across multiple datasets and prediction tasks. The results show that sequence models consistently perform best for next activity prediction, whereas tabular foundation models are competitive on temporal tasks, with LLMs usually lagging behind despite higher cost.

</details>


### [262] [Learning-Augmented and Randomized Algorithms for Line Aggregation with Delays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27807)
*Tianhang Lu,Runtian Ren,Shengcai Liu,Ke Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究线度量上的在线聚合问题（Line Aggregation with Delays, LAD），提出了确定性学习增强算法LA-B（(4/λ+1/λ²)-鲁棒、(4+λ)-一致）、随机化算法RB（(e+1)-竞争比）以及两者结合的LA-RB（(e/λ+1/λ²)-鲁棒、(e+λ)-一致），并证明了随机化算法e的竞争比下界，突破了原确定性算法4的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线聚合问题需要在"尽早服务以降低等待成本"与"延迟服务以批量处理"之间权衡。该问题在库存补货、物流、数据传输等领域有广泛应用。经典在线算法虽然最坏情况鲁棒，但过于保守导致平均性能差；机器学习方法平均性能好但可能因分布偏移而失效。学习增强算法旨在结合两者的优势：在预测准确时接近机器学习性能，在预测错误时仍保持在线算法的鲁棒性保证。随机化方法则能突破确定性算法的竞争比下界。

Method: 1. **请求紧迫度（Request Urgency）**：对每个请求r，定义 q(t,r) = λw(min{t,t_cov(r)}-τ)+ + (1/λ)w(t-t_cov(r))+，其中t_cov(r)为建议首次覆盖请求的时间。覆盖前紧迫度增长慢（权重λ），覆盖后增长快（权重1/λ），参数λ∈(0,1]控制对建议的信任度。
2. **层级势能（Level Potential）**：Q(t,g) = Σ_{待处理请求} q(t,r)，在层级g变"紧"（Q(t,g)=g/4或g/e）时服务最大紧层级。
3. **LA-B算法**：使用固定2^j网格，在Q(t,g)=g/4时服务。
4. **RB算法（随机化）**：使用随机偏移网格b_i = e^{i+U}（U~Unif[0,1]），在W(t,b_i)=b_i/e时服务，期望竞争比(e+1)。
5. **LA-RB算法**：结合LA-B的建议调整紧迫度与RB的随机网格。
6. **下界证明**：通过Yao原理构造M个区间的硬实例，利用参数化分布Pr[K_p≥i]=e^{-iε}生成请求，取极限得到e的下界。

Result: **理论结果**：
- LA-B：对于λ∈(0,1]，竞争比为(4/λ+1/λ²)-鲁棒、(4+λ)-一致
- RB：随机化竞争比(e+1)，优于确定性Balance的5-竞争比，且低于确定性下界4
- 随机化下界：e（改进了原e/(e-1)下界）
- LA-RB：(e/λ+1/λ²)-鲁棒、(e+λ)-一致

**实验结果**（6种分布上的ACR对比）：
- LA-B和LA-RB的ACR均低于Balance和RB
- LA-B和LA-RB在advice替换率p增大时性能稳定，而Blind-Following策略性能急剧下降
- 在空间非均匀分布下，随机化的优势更明显

Conclusion: 本文成功将学习增强和随机化技术结合应用于线度量聚合问题，证明了二者兼容性：建议提升预测准确时的性能，随机化改善对抗基准。核心发现是使用随机偏移几何网格（底数e最优）能突破确定性算法的竞争比下界。下界证明表明e是随机化算法的最优竞争比。未来工作包括缩小确定性与随机化算法竞争比之间1的差距，以及将学习增强聚合推广到树度量和一般度量空间。

Abstract: This paper studies learning-augmented and randomized online aggregation with delays on a line metric. We consider advice given as online suggested service lengths, and evaluate the algorithms in terms of robustness and consistency. For each $\lambda \in (0,1]$, we first propose a deterministic learning-augmented \textsc{Balance} algorithm that is $(4/\lambda+1/\lambda^2)$-robust and $(4+\lambda)$-consistent. We also propose a randomized algorithm for the problem in the classical adversarial model, which is $(e+1)$-competitive against an oblivious adversary, improving over the deterministic $5$-competitive \textsc{Balance} benchmark~\cite{bienkowski2013chain}. Notably, this competitive ratio is even lower than the lower bound of $4$ for deterministic online algorithms. Moreover, we establish a lower bound of $e$ on the competitive ratio of randomized online algorithms, improving the previous lower bound of $e/(e-1)$. Besides, we combine the two ideas and obtain a randomized learning-augmented algorithm that is $(e/\lambda+1/\lambda^2)$-robust and $(e+\lambda)$-consistent. Finally, we conduct numerical experiments to complement our theoretical analysis and evaluate the empirical performance of our algorithms.

</details>


### [263] [Contrastive Concept Importance: Explaining Pairwise Class Decisions Through Automatically Extracted Concept Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27904)
*Roel Visser,Isaac Roberts,Barbara Hammer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出对比概念重要性（Contrastive Concept Importance, CCI），一种基于自动提取视觉概念的概念级归因方法，用于解释成对类别决策。通过将目标类别与干扰类别之间的logit margin归因到概念上，产生带符号的分数，可分解为target-logit和foil-logit效应，从而揭示普通概念重要性无法捕捉的类别对特定模型行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于概念的可解释性方法通常回答"为什么是P?"这一非对比性问题，但在误分类、类别混淆、低边际预测等场景中，更自然的问题是"为什么是P而不是Q?"。传统概念重要性方法无法揭示概念在类别对之间区分中的具体作用，尤其忽略了与分类器不确定性相关的概念。

Method: 方法包含三个步骤：(1) 概念表示——遵循CRAFT框架，将分类器分解为f=h∘g，对中间激活应用非负矩阵分解(NMF)获得概念激活向量(CAVs)库；(2) 对比概念归因——定义目标类别a与干扰类别b之间的logit margin M_{a,b}(x)=z_a-z_b，通过重建激活得到概念空间margin函数，对其应用Integrated Gradients计算CCI分数（使用零向量作为基线），分数的符号表示概念对类别对比的方向；(3) 局部到全局聚合——在样本队列上聚合CCI分数，得到类别对的全局边界配置文件Γ。

Result: 在ImageNet-1k上使用ResNet50进行实验，主要结果包括：(1) beagle vs English foxhound示例表明CCI能识别出对类别对区分重要的概念（如concept 2对边界有强负向影响），这些信息是普通概念重要性无法提供的；(2) 插入/删除曲线证明带符号的对比排序能方向性地控制target-vs-foil margin；(3) Logit分解分析显示高混淆对（beagle vs foxhound）共享概念多、对比证据少，而低混淆对（beagle vs Rhodesian ridgeback）有更多单边和对比性证据；(4) 基于WordNet语义层次的扫描表明，靠近语义层次的foil对共享更多广义证据，而远距离foil对则特异性更高，验证了特异性分数S_spec的合理性。

Conclusion: CCI是一种有效的概念级归因方法，通过对比性的logit margin归因揭示了类别对特定的模型行为。带符号分数和logit分解提供了区分共享/非对比、单边、直接对比证据的紧凑方式。实验证明对比视图能捕捉普通概念重要性遗漏的信息。未来工作包括：评估共享概念字典（如稀疏自编码器产生的），以及将CCI扩展到拒绝选项、保形预测集等不确定性导向场景。

Abstract: Concept-based explanations are a prevalent way to explain the decisions of complex black-box methods through semantically meaningful, human-interpretable concepts. To attribute the contribution of such concepts to a model's decisions, feature attribution methods are used to quantify how strongly each concept contributes to a model output. These attributions are typically computed for a single output class and therefore answer a non-contrastive "why P?" question. In many situations, however, such as cases of misclassification, class confusion, and low-margin predictions, the more natural question to ask is "why P rather than Q?". We introduce contrastive concept importance (CCI), which attributes the logit margin between a target class and a contrast, or foil, class to concepts in an automatically extracted visual concept basis. The resulting scores are signed, indicating whether a concept supports the target over the foil or the foil over the target, and can be decomposed into target-logit and foil-logit effects. This makes it possible to distinguish globally important concepts from concepts that specifically influence a class-pair distinction, including whether their effect is shared, one-sided, or directly contrastive. We evaluate the method on ImageNet class pairs using CRAFT-style concept bases, insertion and deletion curves, logit-wise decomposition analysis, and semantic class hierarchy. The results show that contrastive concept importance reveals class-pair-specific model behavior that is not captured by ordinary concept importance alone, and that highly contrastive concepts can be evaluated against semantic superclass structure to assess whether they affect fine-grained distinctions rather than broad category evidence.

</details>


### [264] [S-CEReBrO: Breaking the Memory Barrier in Continuous EEG Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27913)
*Glenn Anta Bucagu,Thorir Mar Ingolfsson,Yawei Li,Luca Benini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 S-CEReBrO（Streaming CEReBrO），一种面向连续 EEG 监测的 Transformer 基础模型。其核心创新是"窗口交替注意力"（Windowed Alternating Attention）机制，将注意力计算分解为固定大小的时空窗口，使 KV 缓存内存与信号时长 T 解耦，实现 O(1) 常驻内存与 O(CT) 线性计算复杂度。该模型仅用 2.4M 参数即可在 11 项下游任务中 7 项达到 SOTA，可处理长达 14 小时的连续 EEG 信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 架构虽主导 EEG 基础模型领域，但其全局注意力机制的 KV 缓存内存随信号时长 T 线性甚至二次增长，导致可穿戴设备在连续 EEG 监测（如癫痫检测）场景下出现内存溢出。此外，EEG 信号具有二维非线性时空结构，不能简单沿用 NLP 中针对一维文本的窗口化注意力方法。需要一种既能保持长时建模能力、又能实现恒定内存占用的注意力机制，以支撑面向持续监测的实时部署。

Method: S-CEReBrO 的核心技术为窗口交替注意力，由两类互补层构成：
1. **时空分词（Spatiotemporal Tokenization）**：对 C×T 的 EEG 信号沿通道维进行滑动窗口切片，经卷积编码后叠加时序位置编码与基于 3D 电极坐标映射的连续空间编码。
2. **窗口时间注意力（WTA）**：每个通道独立地在局部时序邻域 N_t(i,l) 内计算注意力，采用层级膨胀因子 d_l 与偏移因子 s_l 扩大感受野。
3. **窗口空间注意力（WSA）**：在固定时间索引上，仅在局部空间邻域 N_s(c,l) 内进行跨通道信息交换；WSA 作为"时间桥"使被淘汰的 WTA token 信息得以间接传递。
4. **FIFO 流式推理**：以先入先出方式维持连续有状态的感受野，避免分块处理造成的长程依赖丢失。
预训练采用掩码自编码（MAE）策略，重建被掩码与可见 patch 的加权和。整体计算复杂度 O(CT)，KV 缓存 O(1)。

Result: 1. **可扩展性**：窗口交替注意力可处理 50,000 秒（14 小时）连续信号，分别是全自注意力的 100×、交替注意力的 10×、低秩线性注意力的 3×；在 4 小时信号上仅需 55% 内存并实现 2.1× 推理吞吐。
2. **任务精度**：在 11 个涵盖癫痫检测、睡眠分期、运动想象、情绪识别等任务的公开基准上取得 7 项 SOTA，包括 CHB-MIT（AUROC 87.45）、Neonate（85.76）、STEW（Weighted F1 52.90）、SEED-VIG（NRMSE 0.93）等。
3. **参数效率**：仅 2.4M 参数（较 BIOT/CBraMod/LaBraM 减少最多 60%），却优于参数更大的全局注意力基线模型。
4. **预训练规模**：在 >25,000 小时、>12,000 受试者、跨 2–62 通道异质数据集上完成预训练。

Conclusion: S-CEReBrO 通过引入时空局部性归纳偏置，同时解决了 Transformer 在连续 EEG 监测中的内存瓶颈与精度损失问题。其"窗口交替注意力"机制在保持线性计算复杂度的同时实现了与信号时长无关的恒定内存占用，验证了全局注意力对 EEG 分析并非必需。未来工作将聚焦于构建小时级流式评测基准，以及提升在小样本场景下的样本效率。该研究向高效、可泛化、连续的 EEG 实时分析迈出了关键一步。

Abstract: Foundation models offer a promising paradigm for Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis, leveraging generalizable representations from vast unlabeled datasets. Yet, Transformer-based architectures face a critical bottleneck: global attention mechanisms couple the attention memory state to the signal duration, causing memory overflow during continuous monitoring. To address this, we introduce S-CEReBrO (Streaming CEReBrO), an evolution of the CEReBrO architecture designed for continuous monitoring. Our novel Windowed Alternating Attention mechanism factorizes attention computation into fixed-size spatiotemporal windows, guaranteeing constant KV cache memory as only the active window requires resident attention maps. Empirical scaling analysis confirms that windowed alternating attention can process signals 100X longer than full self-attention and 3X longer than low-rank linear attention. Compared to low-rank linear attention on long contexts, windowed alternating attention requires 55% of the memory while increasing inference throughput by 2.1X. Pre-trained on >25,000 hours of recordings from >12,000 subjects, S-CEReBrO achieves state-of-the-art performance on 7 of 11 downstream tasks, with up to 60% fewer parameters. This work represents a significant step toward the realization of efficient, generalizable, and continuous EEG monitoring. An accompanying code repository is available.

</details>


### [265] [Exact Action Values Are Not Enough: Rollout-Verified Reinforcement Fine-Tuning of a Reasoning Model for Multi-Zone VAV Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27914)
*Takumi Shioda,Kohei Terashima,Tatsuo Nagai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究将推理大语言模型(LLM)用于多区域变风量(VAV)空调控制的可行性与迁移能力。先验证前沿模型GPT-5能否通过文本接口实现竞争性控制,再测试基于TD3引导的 rollout-verified 强化微调(RFT)能否将控制知识迁移到本地可部署的开源模型gpt-oss-20b。结果表明GPT-5无需建筑专属训练即可实现最低能耗(-6.2%),但减少了通风裕度;而gpt-oss-20b即使经过200步RFT仍未能超越基线。核心发现是:精确的rollout评分虽能对采样动作排序,但既不能揭示下一状态效应,也不提供改进方向——这揭示了连续控制中"动作价值充分性"的局限,提示应在value-based RFT之前先进行transition-focused监督微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多区域VAV控制需要在多个连续执行器上平衡热舒适、空气质量与能耗。传统MPC和RL方法需要建筑专属建模或训练,难以规模化部署。LLM推理模型凭借预训练获得的物理/规划先验知识,有望通过统一文本接口实现跨建筑的通用控制,且推理通道可审计、可本地化部署。研究的动机是:(1)探索LLM能否作为通用VAV控制器;(2)若可行,能否通过RFT将前沿模型的控制能力迁移到轻量级开源模型,以便实际部署。VAV控制相比此前作者研究的TES调度问题更难:7维连续动作空间无法枚举评分,且多区域空气-水耦合系统难以精确预测下一状态。

Method: 方法分为两部分:(1)能力评估——5个控制器(ASHRAE Guideline 36基线、TD3、GPT-5、gpt-oss-20b微调前后)在四区物理仿真器中跨三天夏季工况对比,评价能耗、温度和CO₂合规性;(2)Rollout-verified RFT——以TD3为教师,通过确定性仿真器restore-and-rollout机制:在保存状态s上施加候选动作a,后续由冻结TD3控制至当日结束,discounted return作为精确评分;审计显示TD3 critic虽与直接回报时间上r=0.9998,但状态内排序仅5/10状态选最优,故改用直接rollout作为verifier;采用Dr.GRPO目标(softmax温度τ=0.05,clip ε=0.2,无KL惩罚)对gpt-oss-20b的LoRA适配器(r=4,α=8)进行200步微调,30个TD3训练状态、每状态16个采样,共12,800次生成;另外设计反事实过渡测试,在12个状态上±25%扰动单个执行器,评估模型对下一状态预测的方向准确率,与持久性基线对比。

Result: 控制结果:GPT-5总能耗最低(-6.20% vs Guideline 36),但CO₂合规率从98.53%降至92.86%,最大CO₂达1033ppm,牺牲了通风裕度;TD3在所有指标上均改善基线(能耗-4.54%,温度合规96.31%,CO₂合规99.97%,最大CO₂ 1007ppm);gpt-oss-20b微调前(+5.63%)和微调后(+4.47%)均高于基线,CO₂合规恶化,最大CO₂从1086升至1143ppm。审计发现:TD3 critic在TD3轨迹上r=0.9998,但状态内排序Spearman仅0.71、pairwise accuracy 79.8%,42.5%的LLM动作超出TD3参考分布。RFT 200步后:最佳采样动作有时超过TD3但移动平均未持续在TD3之上,平均采样回报全程低于TD3,无持续改进。过渡测试:GPT-5方向准确率37.2-97.7%,MAE低于持久性基线;gpt-oss-20b方向准确率0.0-2.1%,MAE高于基线,RFT未改善。理论分析表明Q对a的梯度分解为∂r/∂a + γ(∂V/∂s')(∂s'/∂a),精确rollout只评分不提供方向;completion级value监督在token级优化中无法传授局部动力学知识。

Conclusion: 研究得出核心结论:在多区域VAV控制中,精确的动作价值评分对于连续控制并不充分。LLM作为控制器的可行性已由GPT-5验证——其能在不更新建筑专属参数的情况下,凭文本接口协调7个连续执行器并达到最低能耗,证明信息内容而非接口是限制因素。但将能力迁移到轻量级开源模型的RFT尝试失败,根因在于value-based RFT仅能对采样动作排序,既不能扩展策略支持集,也不传授"动作如何改变下一状态"的局部过渡知识;通过将Q的梯度分解为回报偏好与Jacobian ∂s'/∂a两部分,明确指出了缺失方向性内容的来源。因此研究建议:应在value-based RFT之前先进行transition-focused监督微调,通过同一save-and-branch接口训练模型预测动作条件下的状态变化,再组合RFT以保留过渡知识并发展动作排序能力。这一发现对LLM-based连续控制器的训练范式具有普遍意义。

Abstract: Multi-zone variable-air-volume control must balance thermal comfort, indoor air quality, and electricity use across several continuous actuators. Model predictive control and reinforcement learning are widely studied, but deployment typically requires building-specific modeling or training, limiting scalability. We first test whether a frontier reasoning model (an LLM trained to use additional inference-time computation) can achieve competitive VAV control from text without building-specific training. With that capability established, we then test whether TD3-guided reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) can transfer control knowledge into a locally deployable open-weight model. Five controllers are evaluated over three summer days in a physics-based four-zone emulator. Relative to a Guideline 36-based baseline, TD3 reduced HVAC electricity by 4.5% while improving temperature and CO$_2$ compliance. Without building-specific training, GPT-5 achieved the largest reduction (6.2%) but reduced the ventilation margin. For RFT, deterministic rollouts restore a saved state, apply one candidate, and follow TD3 to score each action. Auditing a learned critic against these rollouts exposed a failure hidden by its near-perfect across-time correlation ($r=0.9998$): within-state ranking was unreliable; the critic selected the rollout-best candidate in only 5 of 10 states. Even with the rollout verifier, 200 RFT steps produced no sustained improvement in sampled-action return; the open-weight controller used more electricity than the baseline before and after training, and its five-minute predictions remained worse than persistence. GPT-5 predicted transitions far better. Exact rollout scores rank sampled actions but reveal neither next-state effects nor an improvement direction. The unchanged transition errors motivate transition-focused supervised fine-tuning before value-based RFT.

</details>


### [266] [ODEWorld: A Continuous Predictive Architecture via Physical-Time Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27924)
*Dongxiu Liu,Haoyi Niu,Peng Cheng,Yuan Gao,Xirui Kang,Sangli Teng,Koushil Sreenath,Xianyuan Zhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ODEWorld——一种基于物理时间流的连续时间潜空间世界模型。其核心是PT-Flow范式，通过学习由常微分方程(ODE)刻画的潜空间速度场，将未来预测重新定义为在物理时间上的ODE积分。该模型解决了JEPA类潜空间世界模型中长期存在的表征坍缩问题，并支持任意时序分辨率的双向视频生成与下游策略学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型几乎完全依赖离散时间建模范式（如离散帧序列预测、离散时间步决策），存在两方面不足：1）对训练数据时间对齐的严格要求以及处理不规则采样数据的脆弱性；2）本质上仍属于"视频模仿"，无法有效捕捉现实世界的内在高阶物理连续性。另外，JEPA类潜空间世界模型存在表征坍缩问题——潜空间退化为平凡解，导致表达能力受限。亟需一种在连续物理时间下运作、且兼具表达力与效率的预测架构。

Method: 方法包含两大核心设计与一个具体架构实例：1) **动力学表征解耦（PT-Flow核心设计一）**：设计以初始状态为条件的动力学编码器f_dyn和解码器g_dyn，将时变动态信息从静态背景、时不变细节中分离出来，使潜表征z_t专注于本质动力学变化，并强制f_dyn满足ODE性质。2) **直接一阶监督（PT-Flow核心设计二）**：通过Jacobian向量积（JVP）投影直接获得潜速度的真值ẑ_t = JVP(f_dyn(s_t;s_0), ṡ_t)，并用速度监督损失直接约束速度场v_θ，避免JEPA中常见的间接一致性约束导致的坍缩。3) **ODEWorld架构**：采用冻结的DINOv2作为视觉骨干提供数值稳定的特征空间，使用单个768维token作为紧凑潜表征（相比16×16×768的原始特征极度压缩），速度场由轻量3层MLP参数化，通过FiLM注入时间信息；使用Savitzky-Golay滤波器估计目标速度；推理时采用RK4等ODE求解器在潜空间积分实现视频生成和子目标规划。预测可通过反转积分符号（v → -v）实现反向生成，并支持任意时间分辨率的灵活生成。

Result: **视频生成**：在LIBERO数据集16帧短片段上PSNR达20.53、LPIPS为0.109，64帧长片段PSNR为19.46、LPIPS为0.134，均优于LDP和V-JEPA 2；64帧预测延迟仅0.072秒（A100 GPU），效率显著优于基线。支持双向生成、任意时序分辨率及时间超分辨率（如在1/3降采样数据上训练后可生成中间帧）。**消融实验**：动力学子目标在768维潜空间中的有效秩达425.2，显著高于V-JEPA 2的203.7和DINOv2 CLS的376.1，证明无表征坍缩；动力学解耦和直接一阶监督均为关键组件。**机器人策略学习**：在LIBERO-LONG基准上采用序列潜子目标引导的方法平均成功率83.6%，超过GLCBC（78.0%）、SuSIE（76.3%）、Seer（78.6%）和VPP（81.0%）；真实世界双手机器人（AgileX）四个任务（虾入锅、鼠标装箱、笔插入、双臂重排）平均成功率从X-VLA基线的55%提升至80%。

Conclusion: ODEWorld成功地将世界建模从离散时间范式推进到以物理时间为轴的连续时间范式，融合了可解释的潜速度场、任意方向的预测、任意时序分辨率、高质量长时预测重建，以及面向规划的动力学中心表征。这为高保真视频合成与有效机器人策略学习提供了一种新的"连续性配方"，有望启发下一代预测模型以更忠实地理解与建模连续物理世界。

Abstract: In the physical world we inhabit, space and time are fundamentally continuous. However, existing machine learning paradigms for world modeling are largely confined to discrete-time prediction, thereby exhibiting significant inefficiency in capturing the dynamics of physical world. We introduce Physical-Time Flow (\textbf{PT-Flow}), a novel approach that learns a continuous latent velocity field operating in physical time. Crucially, the underlying dynamics of sequential data are parameterized by an ordinary differential equation (ODE) embedded in a well-structured representation space. Under this paradigm, the prediction of future can be recast as temporal integration via an ODE solver in the compressed latent space. Building upon PT-Flow, we construct \textbf{ODEWorld}, a continuous-time latent world model that is both efficient and versatile. By extracting time-variant features and enforcing ODE properties on both the dynamical representation space and the latent velocity field, ODEWorld effectively addresses the long-standing representation collapse issue in latent world model literature. This also enables high-quality image reconstruction even after long-horizon prediction. Moreover, its continuous nature allows for arbitrary temporal resolution and even backward prediction, which is impossible for most discrete-time models. Lastly, ODEWorld can provide rich planning-oriented information to facilitate downstream policy learning. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that ODEWorld successfully reconciles planning-conducive dynamics abstraction with visual realism, excelling in both video generation and robotic control. \href{ this https URL }{Project Website}.

</details>


### [267] [Harnessing the Potential of Optimizing Data Mixtures via Bayesian Domain Reweighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27928)
*Xiang Yuan,Kaiqing Lei,Zhenyu Jin,Jun Shu,Deyu Meng,Zongben Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ByDoRe（Bayesian Domain Reweighting），一种用于LLM预训练数据混合优化的贝叶斯域权重学习方法。通过将域权重建模为Dirichlet分布并引入Gamma先验信息，该方法解决了现有方法中直接优化不稳定、函数拟合方法依赖强假设导致偏差的两大核心问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM预训练中，数据混合（data mixture）的最优比例难以确定。现有方法分为两类：1）函数拟合方法（如RegMix、AutoScale、MDE）依赖rank invariance或scaling laws假设，但这些假设在实际中常被违反；2）直接优化方法（如DoReMi）因单遍训练（one-pass training）中高方差批次损失信号导致权重剧烈震荡，需要遍历海量数据才能稳定收敛，计算开销巨大。本文旨在解决直接优化方法的稳定性与效率问题。

Method: ByDoRe采用Gamma-Dirichlet分层贝叶斯模型：1）将域权重w视为Dirichlet分布的潜变量，引入不确定性以消除批次级波动的负面影响；2）设计一个先验预测网络G_Φ（线性投影+两层Transformer+Softplus输出），以经验域损失信号s_t为输入，自适应地预测Gamma分布的shape和rate参数；3）通过重参数化采样生成浓度参数β和域权重w；4）采用中心有限差分近似（central finite-difference）替代双层优化中难以计算的Hessian-向量积，以估计超梯度；5）在每个batch内通过加权采样（intra-batch weighted sampling）执行域权重干预；6）在ELBO目标下交替更新模型参数θ和先验网络参数Φ，并提供O(1/√T)的收敛保证。

Result: 在The Pile的17个域上进行验证，使用1M参数代理模型在0.4B tokens上搜索权重，再用1B参数目标模型在150B tokens上训练，13项下游零样本评测。结果显示：1）Case 1通用场景下，ByDoRe平均准确率48.50%，优于RegMix（48.22%）和所有其他基线，仅需2.40×10^16 FLOPs（RegMix的0.8%），是MDE的4倍以上效率提升；2）Case 2专业域场景下（GitHub+Enron Emails），Enron Emails违反scaling law和rank invariance假设导致RegMix/AutoScale/MDE崩溃，ByDoRe以38.35%平均分保持SOTA；3）消融实验证实概率建模显著抑制权重轨迹震荡，intra-batch weighted sampling收敛最快、验证损失最低；4）权重学习轨迹显示ByDoRe相比DoReMi显著更平滑稳定。

Conclusion: ByDoRe通过将域权重学习从确定性优化范式转变为概率建模框架，成功解决了直接优化方法的不稳定性和函数拟合方法的偏差问题。其Gamma-Dirichlet分层先验有效抑制了批次级方差引起的优化抖动，并大幅降低了计算开销（仅为RegMix的不到1%）。该方法在通用和专业数据分布下均表现出稳定且高效的最优混合识别能力，为LLM数据优化提供了新的方向。理论分析证明了O(1/√T)的收敛率，加之有限差分引入的O(ε⁴)和O(ε²)近似误差项。

Abstract: The performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) is fundamentally influenced by the distributional composition of multi-domain pre-training data. While manual heuristics were prevalent in early models, they increasingly fail to capture the intricate synergies between domains as data complexity grows. To overcome the issue, a dominant approach seeks to fit a proxy function mapping between domain weights and their corresponding validation losses, and then find the optimal domain weights to minimize validation losses. These methods rely on strong structural assumptions, such as rank invariance or scaling laws, which are often violated, resulting in non-negligible estimation bias. A promising approach is to directly optimize the weighting scheme from data. However, it suffers from unstable optimization trajectory and prohibitive computational overhead, limiting its potential to search better domain weights configurations. This paper presents a Bayesian domain weighting method to infer the weights from a Dirichlet distribution via introducing Gamma prior information learned from observations. Experimental results demonstrate that proposed method could achieve stable and efficient domain weights learning, and identifies optimal mixtures while consuming substantially less data than search-based function-fitting methods, revitalizing optimization-based domain weighting for large-scale applications.

</details>


### [268] [TriShield: Zero-Utility-Loss Defense Against Privacy Backdoors in Federated Language Model Fine-Tuning via Orthogonal Gradient Projection and Optimizer State Entanglement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27940)
*Cheng Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TriShield，一种针对联邦大语言模型微调中 NeuroImprint 隐私后门攻击的三层客户端防御框架。该防御通过参数伪迹检测（PAD）、状态化虚拟迭代（SVI）和零效用正交投影（ZUOP），在 GPT-2 和 Llama-Guard-3-1B 上实现了 0% 重建率、<0.3% 精度损失和 <5% GPU 额外开销的"零效用损失"防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦微调（FL + PEFT）面临恶意参数服务器的隐私后门威胁。NeuroImprint 攻击通过预植入 PEFT 适配器中的"记忆神经元"，利用闭式反演公式 x̂ = ∇W/∇B 以 59%-79% 的高语义保真度重构客户端训练样本的原文。现有防御（本地差分隐私 LDP 会带来 5-20% 精度损失、梯度裁剪可被绕过、异常检测与拜占庭鲁棒聚合针对的是客户端而非神经元级后门）均无法同时兼顾隐私保护与模型效用，因此亟需一种既能完全阻止重建又不损害模型性能的防御机制。

Method: TriShield 是三层客户端确定性防御，串行执行：（1）PAD 在本地训练前扫描接收到的适配器权重，检测具有近零行内方差（<10⁻⁴）与高跨行相关性（>0.95）的记忆神经元签名，并将其重置为 Kaiming 正态初始化；（2）SVI 在真实训练前执行 K=3 次仅更新 Adam 动量/二阶矩状态但不更新权重的"虚拟步骤"，使用公开辅助数据 D_aux 预污染动量状态，使 NeuroImprint 的单步线性反演假设失效；（3）ZUOP 通过对 D_aux 上计算的梯度矩阵进行 SVD，提取前 k 个主任务方向（k ≈ 0.8·rank(G)），将本地梯度正交投影到该子空间，物理消除与任务正交的记忆神经元梯度分量。理论证明：Theorem 2 保证任务梯度在投影下不变（零效用损失），Theorem 3 证明记忆神经元梯度经投影后归零，Theorem 1 证明 SVI 使反演方程欠定。

Result: 在 GPT-2（117M，LoRA rank=8）和 Llama-Guard-3-1B（LoRA rank=4）上的实验显示：本地验证中 TriShield 将重建率从基线 100% 降至 0%，梯度范数从 ~4.13×10⁻² 降至 ~3.08×10⁻³（约 13 倍降幅，低于 10⁻² 攻击阈值）；n-鲁棒验证（n∈{8,64,256,1024}）和五种自适应攻击变体（VTB/MLD/MLPL/LCN/SR1E）在 n=256 下均实现 0% token 重建；PAD 对记忆神经元检测率达 100%；与 LDP（ε=1.0, 精度损失 13.7%）等基线相比，TriShield 保持 ≤0.3% 精度损失且 GPU 开销 <5%。ZUOP 投影秩消融显示 rank_fraction=0.80 为安全默认值（0.95 会导致 SR1E 泄漏 50%）。

Conclusion: TriShield 是首个同时满足客户端部署、零效用损失、可证明隐私（I(x̂;x)=0）、无需架构改动且专为 PEFT 设计的防御框架。它通过三层协同机制（检测-污染-投影）形成纵深防御，对 NeuroImprint 类隐私后门攻击实现了信息论意义上的重建不可能性。局限在于：需要 32-500 个领域相关的公开辅助样本来估计任务子空间；在仅 CPU 部署时开销较高（约 72%）；理论证明仅适用于 NeuroImprint 类逐神经元记忆攻击，对新型跨神经元纠缠编码尚需扩展分析。

Abstract: Federated fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) enables collaborative training without exposing raw data. However, a recent attack, NeuroImprint [1] ( arXiv:2606.20553 ), demonstrates that a malicious parameter server can corrupt a PEFT adapter into a privacy backdoor: by assigning a dedicated memorization neuron to each training sample and ensuring each neuron updates at most once, the server can analytically reconstruct 59\%--79\% of client training data with high semantic fidelity. Existing defenses---including local differential privacy (LDP) [8] and gradient clipping---either fail against this attack or impose unacceptable utility degradation. We present \textbf{TriShield}, a three-layer deterministic defense that completely prevents NeuroImprint-style reconstruction with \textbf{zero model utility loss} and \textbf{no additional communication rounds}. TriShield consists of: (1) a \textbf{Parameter Artifact Detector} that identifies memory-neuron signatures in distributed model parameters before local training begins; (2) a \textbf{Stateful Virtual Iteration} mechanism that forces Adam/AdamW's momentum state to irreversibly entangle gradients across virtual steps, invalidating NeuroImprint's closed-form inversion; and (3) a \textbf{Zero-Utility Orthogonal Projection} operator that projects all local gradient updates onto the main-task semantic subspace computed via SVD, physically eliminating any gradient components that carry private memorization. We prove theoretically that after Layers 2 and 3, the mutual information between the uploaded gradient and any individual training sample is zero. Experiments on GPT-2 (117M) and Llama-Guard-3-1B verify that TriShield reduces NeuroImprint reconstruction rate to \textbf{0\%} across all tested attack variants, while maintaining or improving training accuracy, with less than 5\% additional GPU computation overhead.

</details>


### [269] [AutoPref: Automatic Discovery of Task-Specific Preference Objectives for Neural Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27953)
*Shengda Gu,Kai Li,Xinyi Ke,Haobo Fu,Yifan Zhang,Jian Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AutoPref是首个面向神经组合优化（NCO）的LLM引导偏好目标自动发现框架。它将偏好目标分解为成对损失程序（pairwise loss）与集合感知加权程序（set-aware weighting），通过分阶段条件搜索在TSP、CVRP、FFSP、JSSP四类问题上自动发现任务专属目标，在发现规模与未见规模上均稳定超越PO4COPs、BOPO、SLIM等强人工基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合优化问题（COP）解空间随规模呈指数增长，基于强化学习的NCO虽高效但样本效率低；基于偏好的NCO通过相对解质量进行监督，但现有方法（PO4COPs、BOPO）将两个本质不同的设计选择耦合在"一刀切"的人工公式中：（1）从每对解中提取何种学习信号；（2）在采样集合内如何加权每对解。手工设计的目标在不同COP族（路由、调度）间难以迁移，需要重复专家投入，限制了其任务适应性。

Method: 1. **目标分解表征**：将偏好目标定义为O=(f,g)，f:𝒰→ℝ为基于对级特征（成本差、log-prob差、排名差等）的成对损失程序，g:𝒱→ℝ≥0为基于集合上下文（成本MAD、log-prob标准差等）的集合感知加权程序，其归一化加权和构成统一编程空间ℱ×𝒢，现有人工目标是其特例。2. **分阶段条件搜索**：Stage 1固定均匀权重g₀=1搜索成对损失f*（Uniform Pair Weighting, UPW）；Stage 2冻结f*搜索加权程序g*（Adaptive Pair Weighting, APW），将联合搜索的组合爆炸与信用分配难题解耦。3. **行为筛选门控**：对候选程序执行四类诊断检查——可执行性（编译通过、有限值/梯度、运行时长）、偏好一致性（交换解后梯度符号翻转）、尺度不变性（仿射成本变换下损失稳定）、加权非退化性（变异系数超阈值），滤除行为不可接纳的程序。4. **短时域双状态评估**：在"早期"（随机初始化）与"晚期"（部分训练检查点）两个策略状态下以PO4COPs为参考评估适应度F(c)=½Σ(J^s_ref−J^s_c)；配合结构多样性过滤避免进化停滞。5. **LLM引导的提出-校验-训练-选择进化回路**。

Result: 在TSP50/100/1000、CVRP50/100/1000、FFSP50/100/1000、JSSP10×10/15×15/50×20共12组设置下，APW均取得偏好类方法最优结果，且相对人工基线的优势随规模扩大而扩大（如TSP1000上APW gap 9.40% vs PO4COPs 10.64% vs BOPO 17.84%）；因子消融证实发现的成对损失与加权程序各自贡献性能提升，二者组合达到最大改进（TSP100减0.0067，FFSP100减0.300）；TSP发现的APW目标采用成本差相关的"逆温度"机制σ(clip[αₜΔpᵢ(1−βₜ·qᵢ)])配合基于归一化成本差与log-prob差的加权ωₜ，与BOPO专家先验相反，有效纠正误序对并集中权重于常采样区域。

Conclusion: AutoPref将偏好目标设计从手工规则范式转变为可计算发现的任务自适应组件，在四类COP上确立新SOTA并稳健泛化至未见规模，验证了"学习目标本身应作为优化问题处理"的范式转变；未来工作将探索非成对目标形式及利用代理模型加速目标评估。

Abstract: Combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) underpin many real-world decisions, but their exponentially large search spaces make high-quality solutions costly to obtain. Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) learns fast construction policies, typically with reinforcement learning (RL), while preference-based NCO improves sample efficiency by learning from relative solution quality. However, existing preference objectives combine two distinct design choices in manually specified, one-size-fits-all formulations: what learning signal to extract from each solution pair and how to weight each pair relative to the sampled set. We present AutoPref, the first LLM-guided framework for automated preference-objective discovery in NCO. AutoPref factorizes the objective into a pairwise loss program, which defines the learning signal, and a set-aware weighting program, which determines each pair's relative contribution. Their composition forms a unified programmatic objective space containing existing preference objectives as special cases. To make its search tractable, we introduce a staged conditional search strategy with behavioral gates that filter inadmissible programs before short-horizon training and evaluation. Across TSP, CVRP, FFSP, and JSSP, AutoPref consistently outperforms strong hand-designed baselines across problem scales, demonstrating the benefits and scalability of automated objective discovery for NCO.

</details>


### [270] [What Makes Graph Unified? Principles and Generative Sliding-Window Transformer for Graph Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27966)
*Dongxiao He,Siqi Liu,Jitao Zhao,Yawen Li,Yi Wang,Di Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对图基础模型(Graph Foundation Models, GFMs)中跨域节点特征异构性问题，提炼出四条特征统一准则（形式一致性、跨域可迁移性、信息保持性、主干兼容性），并提出SliGFM模型——基于拓扑感知滑动窗口特征编码与生成式重建实现异构特征的统一表征。模型在跨域少样本节点分类与零样本图分类任务上均达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图基础模型跨域迁移面临节点特征维度与语义高度异构的根本性障碍。现有方法通常仅通过投影（如PCA/SVD）或语言中介将异构特征映射到固定维度空间，隐含地将"维度一致"等同于"特征统一"，但维度对齐并不保证语义对齐、信息保持或与主干网络的兼容性。作者指出当前缺乏评估跨域特征统一有效性的原则性标准，因此从功能属性角度出发提出四条应有的准则。

Method: SliGFM由四个核心组件构成：(1) 拓扑感知特征Tokenizer——按特征维度在拓扑上的平滑度排序后，使用参数共享的滑动窗口编码器将定长特征切片映射为统一维度token序列；(2) 节点内Token关系Transformer——引入类似ALiBi的相对平滑度偏置（基于token间平滑度差异的注意力偏置），建模节点内不同平滑度特征子空间的依赖关系；(3) 结构引导的自适应传播——根据图的度直方图、聚类系数、模体计数等结构统计量，经MLP生成各图专属的跳数融合权重，自适应组合多跳邻域信息；(4) 生成式特征Token重建——通过Transformer解码器与可学习查询重建原始特征切片，保持原始信息。训练损失包含MSE重建损失、局部对齐损失与全局分散损失三者加权。推理时无需任何下游微调。

Result: 在9个基准数据集（涵盖同配图如Cora/CiteSeer/PubMed/Photo/Computers/CS与异配图如Chameleon/Squirrel/Actor）的少样本节点分类任务中，SliGFM在8个数据集上达到最优，平均准确率48.93%，超过最强基线TFSGFM 1.57个百分点，在Chameleon、PubMed、Cora上分别提升3.91、3.82、2.62个百分点。在零样本图分类任务（IMDB-BINARY/ENZYMES/DD）上，三个数据集均取得最优准确率。消融实验表明特征排序贡献最大，其次为重建损失；超参数分析显示滑动窗口尺寸dp=256时性能最优且模型对中等窗口尺寸较为鲁棒。

Conclusion: 工作从功能属性视角重新审视跨域特征统一问题，提出的四条准则为评估特征统一有效性提供了原则性框架。SliGFM通过拓扑感知排序、滑动窗口编码、节点内Transformer与生成式重建的组合，无需下游微调即可在异构图数据集间实现有效迁移，验证了"原则驱动"的跨域图学习方法可行性，并为GFM处理异构输入提供了通用设计思路。

Abstract: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose graph learning, aiming to learn reusable knowledge that generalizes across diverse graph domains and downstream tasks, reducing the need for specific model development. Achieving this goal requires reconciling the substantial heterogeneity in node features, graph structures, and semantic information across domains. Among them, heterogeneous node features constitute a fundamental input-level barrier, as their dimensionality and semantics vary substantially across datasets. Existing studies typically project or map heterogeneous node features into a fixed-dimensional space, often implicitly equating dimensional uniformity with effective feature unification. Yet dimensional consistency alone does not ensure that the unified features preserve informative semantics and capture transferable patterns that can support cross-domain knowledge transfer. To bridge this conceptual gap, we distill four desiderata for cross-domain graph feature unification: formal uniformity, cross-domain transferability, information preservation, and backbone compatibility. Guided by these principles, we propose SliGFM, a graph foundation model built upon topology-aware sliding-window feature encoding and generative reconstruction. SliGFM orders feature dimensions by topological smoothness and scans the reordered features with a shared sliding-window feature encoder, transforming heterogeneous features into a common space of ordered fixed-dimensional feature tokens. This formulation enables a smoothness-aware transformer to capture transferable relational patterns among feature tokens within each node, while the generative reconstruction objective encourages preservation of the original feature information.

</details>


### [271] [Beyond Binary Rewards: A Comparative Study of Reward Design for Reinforcement Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27968)
*Efstratios Zaradoukas,Davide Gabrielli,Bardh Prenkaj,Gjergji Kasneci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对强化遗忘（RUL）框架中现有二元奖励信号稀疏、导致收敛慢的问题，提出了一种原则性的奖励设计框架。该框架将"可验证性"与"奖励稀疏性"解耦，并基于信息层次结构提出了两种新奖励函数：指数衰减奖励（根据违规计数提供分级惩罚）和PageRank奖励（通过语义重要性加权惩罚）。在RWKU基准上的实验表明，新奖励在遗忘效率和模型效用保持方面均显著优于二元基线（最高可达3倍加速）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着GDPR和欧盟AI法案等隐私法规的出台，从已训练大语言模型中选择性移除特定知识的需求日益增长。现有强化遗忘方法（如PURGE）依赖稀疏的二元奖励，仅在生成内容完全避开遗忘概念时才返回奖励，导致学习信号不足、收敛速度受限。本文旨在系统研究奖励设计如何影响强化遗忘效率。

Method: 1. 提出通用奖励分解框架：将可验证奖励分解为信息提取组件I（基于禁止匹配算子M(y;F)和辅助信息ψ）和奖励变换函数Γ；2. 建立信息层次结构（最小信息→计数信息→身份信息→结构化信息）；3. 实例化三种奖励：二元奖励（基线）、指数衰减奖励ϕ_exp=exp(-m/τ)、PageRank奖励（基于kNN语义图与个性化PageRank计算重要性权重w_j，对违规进行语义加权惩罚）；4. 理论分析GRPO框架下不同奖励的优势方差与收敛速度；5. 在RWKU基准上使用Phi-3-Mini-4K-Instruct进行实验，对比二元基线、指数衰减（τ∈{0.1,...,5.0}）和PageRank变体（Softmax、Linear、Argmax、ExpRank）。

Result: 1. 主实验（1500步、20个遗忘目标）：PageRank-Softmax在遗忘集上取得最强性能（FB: 0.346, QA: 0.350, AA: 0.390，均为最佳），且效用指标与Base模型偏差≤0.014；2. 效率优势显著：PageRank-Softmax在500步即达到Binary在1500步才达到的遗忘水平（约37.1%改善），实现最高3倍加速；3. 指数奖励最优衰减常数τ*=0.5，可同时最小化三个遗忘指标；4. PageRank-Softmax在整体排名（0.64）和鲁棒性（跨目标一致性）方面均为最佳，PageRank-Linear表现最差；5. 理论证明收敛速率排序：rate_bin < rate_exp < rate_pr。

Conclusion: 奖励设计是强化遗忘效率的关键驱动力。通过将可验证性与稀疏性解耦，本文提出的指数奖励和PageRank奖励在保持完全可验证性的同时显著提升了学习信号密度。实验和理论分析共同证明，更密集的奖励通过稳定的优势估计加速收敛，为可扩展、高效的机器遗忘提供了实用路径。未来研究方向包括无需访问原始训练数据的自适应可验证奖励设计。

Abstract: Machine unlearning seeks to selectively remove specific knowledge from trained language models without full retraining, a growing necessity under privacy regulations such as GDPR and the EU AI Act. Recent work has reformulated unlearning as a Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) problem, where models are optimized against verifiable rewards computed directly from their outputs. However, existing methods rely on sparse binary rewards that provide minimal learning signal, indicating only whether forbidden content was avoided, and limiting convergence speed. In this paper, we study how reward design affects unlearning efficiency within the Reinforcement Unlearning (RUL) framework. We introduce a principled reward decomposition framework that decouples verifiability from sparsity, and propose two new reward functions: an exponential reward that provides graded penalties based on the count of forbidden-concept occurrences, and a PageRank inspired reward that weights penalties by semantic importance. We conduct experiments on the Real World Knowledge Unlearning (RWKU) benchmark, demonstrating that both rewards consistently outperform the binary setting, while reaching similar forgetting performance up to $3\times$ faster and preserving general model utility. Our results show that reward design is a key driver of unlearning efficiency offering a practical path toward scalable and efficient machine unlearning.

</details>


### [272] [Generalization Bounds on Optimal Control for Transformer Training and Wasserstein Distributional Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27975)
*Kağan Akman,Naci Saldi,Serdar Yüksel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将Transformer泛化问题重新建模为有限时域马尔可夫控制问题，通过对状态、动作和测度空间进行三重量化推导有限样本泛化界，并将其与Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化建立联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer作为当下主流的神经网络架构，其泛化能力是一个核心问题。由于Transformer的token演化显式依赖于序列的经验测度，经典基于假设类（hypothesis class）的泛化理论无法直接捕捉其结构特征。因此需要一种能够处理"经验测度依赖动态系统"的新型泛化分析框架。

Method: 1. **双重提升建模**：将数据集视为输入-输出经验测度对上的概率律，使训练问题转化为有限时域马尔可夫控制问题，恢复Markov性。2. **三重量化**：对状态空间𝕏、动作空间𝕌以及测度状态空间𝒫(𝕏)进行离散化，得到有限MDP。3. **Lipschitz稳定性估计**：利用Kantorovich-Rubinstein对偶性证明值函数关于数据律的Lipschitz连续性（引理2.4）。4. **集中不等式**：在量化有限度量空间上运用McDiarmid不等式证明经验提升律的Wasserstein距离集中性（命题3.1，引理3.3）。5. **分布鲁棒控制**：将泛化问题重构为Wasserstein球上的零和博弈，证明Γ-收敛与Painlevé-Kuratowski收敛。

Result: - **定理3.5**（量化模型）：以至少1-δ的概率，经验训练最小化器在真实律下的值函数不超过最优值加上 2L·ρ_r^{ℓ,n}(δ)，其中 ρ_r^{ℓ,n}(δ) = O(K_r^{-1/2})（样本量的最优速率）。- **定理4.5**（基础模型）：将量化界以显式量化误差 α_{ℓ,n}（状态/测度量化）和 β_{ℓ,n,m}（动作量化）转移到基础模型，呈现 O(K_r^{-1/2} + 1/n + 1/ℓ + 1/m) 的完整上界。- **命题5.1**：通过Weierstrass极值定理证明Wasserstein球上极小极大问题鲁棒最小化器的存在性。- **定理5.5**：在概率意义下证明鲁棒目标到训练目标的Γ-收敛，以及鲁棒最小化器集合上极限到训练最小化器集合的包含关系。- **定理5.9**：证明鲁棒最小化器与训练最小化器享有相同的泛化上界。- **界限依赖**：最终界对层数T呈指数依赖（Lipschitz常数含 L_Φ^T 因子），对宽度/状态维度d呈多项式依赖（|𝕏_n| ~ N·n^d）。

Conclusion: 论文成功将Transformer泛化问题转化为分布鲁棒控制框架，主要贡献包括：(1) 对完全离散化可实现的控制问题给出了显式有限样本泛化保证；(2) 将泛化与Wasserstein DRO建立严格联系；(3) 通过Γ-收敛论证了鲁棒最小化器的渐近有效性。主要局限在于：动作空间的紧性假设对应于带范数约束的训练方案而非通用SGD；渐近分析需在 K_r ≫ ℓ ≟ n → ∞ 的优先次序下成立；界限在状态维度d上呈现"维度诅咒"。

Abstract: We derive finite-sample generalization bounds for Transformers trained with dynamic programming recursions. Building on the doubly lifted, measure-valued formulation of Transformer dynamics, we view data sets as probability laws on pairs of empirical input-output measures, allowing us to interpret the training problem as a finite-horizon Markovian control problem. We then analyze a quantized model, derived by quantizing the state, action, and measure-state spaces, and derive explicit finite-sample generalization bounds using concentration inequalities for empirical laws on finite metric spaces together with a Lipschitz stability estimate for the value function. These bounds are transferred to the base model at the cost of an explicit approximation error. Finally, we show that the same machinery yields a distributionally robust control formulation of the training problem, connecting Transformer generalization to Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization.

</details>


### [273] [It's All Just Vectorization: einx, a Universal Notation for Tensor Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27987)
*Florian Fervers,Sebastian Bullinger,Christoph Bodensteiner,Michael Arens*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通用的张量操作符号 "einx"，通过矢量化（vectorization）作为转换函数，统一并简化现有张量框架的复杂 API，提供声明式、易读易写的张量编程范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的张量框架（如 NumPy）采用的下标风格符号虽然广泛使用，但可读性差、易出错（尤其是 shape 错误），且不同操作之间的规则不一致。虽然 einsum 和 einops 改善了部分问题，但它们仅支持有限的操作，缺乏通用性，无法作为通用的张量编程模型。因此需要一种更优的范式来表达张量操作。

Method: 1. 重新审视矢量化（vectorization），将其视为一种转换张量操作的函数。
2. 利用矢量化将低阶操作提升为高阶操作，并将高阶操作概念性分解为低阶操作及其矢量化。
3. 基于矢量化构建 einx——一种通用的张量操作符号，采用类循环表示法的声明式、pointful 表达式，表示张量操作的矢量化。
4. 该符号将现有框架庞大 API 缩减为一小组基本操作，并在所有操作上应用一致的规则。
5. 提供嵌入 Python 的 einx 实现，无缝集成现有张量框架。

Result: 提出了 einx 这种通用符号，能够用简洁、一致的方式表达各类张量操作，涵盖 einsum 和 einops 所不支持的更广泛操作。einx 作为 Python 嵌入式实现，可与现有张量框架（如 NumPy、PyTorch、JAX 等）无缝集成。

Conclusion: einx 通过矢量化提供了一种通用且统一的张量操作表示范式，克服了 einsum/einops 的局限性，简化了 API，提升了代码的可读性、可写性和一致性，为张量编程提供了一种更具表达力的新范式。

Abstract: Tensor operations represent a cornerstone of modern scientific computing. However, the Numpy-like notation adopted by predominant tensor frameworks is often difficult to read and write and prone to so-called shape errors, i.a., due to following inconsistent rules across a large, complex collection of operations. Alternatives like einsum and einops have gained popularity, but are inherently restricted to few operations and lack the generality required for a universal model of tensor programming. To derive a better paradigm, we revisit vectorization as a function for transforming tensor operations, and use it to both lift lower-order operations to higher-order operations, and conceptually decompose higher-order operations to lower-order operations and their vectorization. Building on the universal nature of vectorization, we introduce einx, a universal notation for tensor operations. It uses declarative, pointful expressions that are defined by analogy with loop notation and represent the vectorization of tensor operations. The notation reduces the large APIs of existing frameworks to a small set of elementary operations, applies consistent rules across all operations, and enables a clean, readable and writable representation in code. We provide an implementation of einx that is embedded in Python and integrates seamlessly with existing tensor frameworks: this https URL

</details>


### [274] [Building a User Foundation Model for the Open Web](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28019)
*Solal Vernier,Ivan Can Arisoy,Merwan Barlier,Blaž Škrlj*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向开放网络实时竞价（RTB）场景的用户基础模型（UFM），通过自监督学习（MLM + 时序对比学习 NT-Xent）从碎片化、稀疏的用户浏览历史中学习序列表示，并采用 LLM-in-the-loop 神经架构搜索优化预训练流水线。该模型在 Teads 生产环境中部署，在 CTR 排序器、DCN-v2 排序器以及出价胜出率模型等多个下游任务上均取得稳定的 RIG 提升，并通过 7 天在线 A/B 测试验证了 +2.13% CTR 与 -1.13% eCPC 的业务收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放网络 RTB 的数据分布与电商、社交推荐存在结构性差异：用户身份跨会话碎片化且非持久，相当比例流量无历史数据，传统做法只能使用聚合计数与时效分桶等离散特征，序列结构未被利用。本文旨在探索在次毫秒延迟、稀疏历史的约束下，自监督序列建模能否成为生产模型新的改进轴。

Method: 1) 数据构建：将每个用户行为表示为 (publisher, advertiser, event_type) 三元组序列，按随机切点划分为时序不相交的两个视图 A 与 B；2) 预训练：基于 BERT 结构的双向 Transformer，使用 MLM（掩码率 0.30）和 NT-Xent 对比损失（温度 τ=0.04）联合训练；3) 微调：在曝光级点击标签上对编码器 + sigmoid 头进行端到端微调；4) 嵌入集成：通过两层非线性 Adapter 将 [CLS] 向量接入生产 GDCN 排序器；5) LLM-as-Optimizer：以约 150 个文献锚定的代码级 "lifter" 为搜索原子，由 LLM 提议候选配置，按 RIG 代理评分迭代优化。

Result: 1) 预训练损失相对基线降低 25.2%（4.85→2.37），且收敛轮次从 10 降至 6；2) CTR 排序器：GDCN 提升 +1.354% RIG，DCN-v2 提升 +0.894% RIG；3) 跨任务泛化：出价胜出率模型提升 +1.197% RIG（仅用点击微调的编码器）；4) 历史缺失子流量（=1 事件）仍获 +0.99% RIG，历史存在子流量（≥2 事件）获 +1.62% RIG；5) 7 天线上 A/B 测试：CTR +2.13%（80% CI [1.55%, 3.17%]）、eCPC -1.13%、访问率 +2.37%、eCPV -1.47%。

Conclusion: 本文证明在用户身份不稳定、历史稀疏的开放网络 RTB 场景下，序列式用户基础模型可作为独立于排序器架构与任务之外的改进轴。LLM-in-the-loop NAS 提供了一种可审查、可复现的工业级训练流水线优化范式。学习到的表示同时具备排序器无关性与任务可迁移性，并已在生产环境中以次毫秒延迟稳定部署。

Abstract: User foundation models have demonstrated strong results in e-commerce and social recommendation, but most industrial deployments assume environments where user identity is stable and persistent. Open-web real-time bidding (RTB) operates on a structurally different data distribution: user identity is fragmented and non-persistent across browsing sessions, and the availability of browsing history depends on user privacy choices. Consequently, a significant portion of traffic carries no historical data, and available records often consist of relatively short, disjointed sessions. As a result, historical signals in this domain are typically represented as aggregated counters and recency buckets, leaving the sequential structure unexploited. To address this limitation, we present a user foundation model that applies self-supervised learning on user browsing histories and show that the learned representation improves multiple downstream production tasks, demonstrating the viability of this approach on the open web. We pre-train a Transformer encoder with masked language modeling and a sequence-level contrastive objective, then fine-tune it on the click prediction task. We optimize the encoder's pre-training pipeline with an LLM-in-the-loop search over a curated catalog of reviewable, code-level edits (lifters), instantiating the LLM-as-optimizer paradigm in an industrial setting. The same encoder representation yields +1.197% RIG on the production bid win-rate model and +1.354% RIG on the production CTR ranker; a 7-day live A/B test confirms +2.13% CTR, -1.13% eCPC (80% CI excluding zero on both metrics).

</details>


### [275] [Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization via Privileged Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28026)
*Xingjian Wu,Junlin Liu,Xingchen Liu,Xuhang Zhu,Jianing Wang,Linsen Guo,Xiaoyu Li,Xuezhi Cao,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出对比强化策略优化（CRPO），将智能体场景下的在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）重新构建为对比学习框架，通过预测熵区分正样本位置（反思性探索）和负样本位置（暴露偏差），在13个推理与深度搜索基准上实现了对现有强化学习和自蒸馏基线的一致性超越。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的OPSD方法在多轮智能体后训练中存在两个核心问题：（1）自教师在工具调用后的反应-复制阶段（10-30 token窗口）出现显著的熵塌缩，72%-76%的位置暴露偏差超过阈值，原因是自教师倾向于复制特权演示中的推理路线而非进行独立推理；（2）纯OPSD在多轮长程交互中因暴露偏差导致位置级监督信号不可靠，KL散度急剧增大而奖励曲线波动，优化方向丧失。现有混合方法（如RLSD、SDAR）将RLVR与自蒸馏作为两个独立框架结合，引入了额外计算开销。

Method: CRPO从对比学习视角重构OPSD：（1）将学生上下文与带特权信息的自教师上下文视为两种视图，策略模型为编码器，输出logits为表征，负KL散度为相似度函数；（2）利用预测熵差ΔE = E^S - E^T作为判定器——低ΔE表示教师进行反思性探索（正样本），高ΔE表示教师复制特权演示（负样本）；（3）通过组内排序将底部p%位置划为正集P，其余为负集N；（4）采用InfoNCE对比损失，最小化P位置KL同时最大化N位置KL。理论证明其梯度等价于带软门控的逐token策略梯度，正样本c≤0（拉向教师），负样本c≥0（推离教师）。CRPO*将L_CRPO与GRPO结合，替换GRPO中静态参考模型的KL正则项为位置感知的动态自教师耦合。默认超参数p=30%，λ=5，τ=1.0，采用EMA自教师（α=0.1）实现信任域正则化。

Result: 在13个基准（AIME24/25、MATH500、GSM8K、WebWalker、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue、Bamboogle、GAIA、HLE、xbench）上的实验表明：（1）CRPO*在所有骨干模型（Qwen2.5-3B/7B、Llama3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B/14B）和基准上均排名第一；（2）在深度搜索任务上，8B/14B CRPO*超越32B直接推理基线（Qwen3-32B-thinking、QwQ-32B、DeepSeek-R1-32B）超过30绝对百分点（GAIA-Avg）；（3）CRPO*在4个深度搜索基准上比ARPO平均提升6.8%-9.5%，且随交互轮次增加优势扩大；（4）Pass@1到Pass@5稳定提升，Qwen3-14B在GAIA上达到70.7%（+20.2%）；（5）训练动力学显示CRPO保持熵与KL在窄带内，避免OPSD的熵塌缩；（6）消融验证负样本排斥贡献+3.9%至+4.0%的提升，组内rollout规模G=8时性能趋于饱和。

Conclusion: CRPO通过对比学习重构OPSD解决了智能体后训练中位置级监督不可靠的问题，利用预测熵差实现选择性蒸馏门控，有效缓解暴露偏差同时保持反思性探索信号。其梯度形式自然整合了token级信用分配与软门控机制，可独立使用或与GRPO结合。在长程智能体任务中展现出优于现有RL与自蒸馏基线的训练稳定性与泛化性能，证明了token级位置感知信号在稀疏奖励场景下的必要性。

Abstract: Recent advances in post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) or On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD). While OPSD provides dense, logit-level supervision, it inherently suffers from exposure bias due to the privileged information of the self-teacher. In multi-turn agentic settings, this leads to reasoning route convergence and the loss of clear optimization directions. To tackle these challenges, we introduce Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization (CRPO), which reformulates agentic OPSD from a contrastive learning perspective. By leveraging predictive entropy to distinguish between positive positions (reflective exploration) and negative positions (exposure bias), CRPO conducts group-wise contrast to preserve reliable, fine-grained optimization signals. Extensive evaluations across 13 challenging reasoning and deep-search benchmarks demonstrate that CRPO consistently outperforms existing reinforcement learning and self-distillation baselines, significantly enhancing training stability and generalization in long-horizon interactions.

</details>


### [276] [Enhancing Irregular Time Series Forecasting with Continuous-Time Modeling Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28035)
*Tianen Shen,Zhengyu Li,Yutong Li,Xiangfei Qiu,Xingjian Wu,Bin Yang,Jilin Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 WrapFlow，一种用于不规则多元时间序列预测的连续时间建模框架。该框架包含两个核心组件：输入端的连续时间分词化（Continuous-Time Tokenization）和输出端的残差流匹配（Residual Flow Matching），通过标准 Transformer 主干连接，避免了离散化预处理和数值求解器的高计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不规则多元时间序列（IMTS）在医疗监护、人体活动识别和环境传感等领域广泛存在，其核心挑战包括异步观测、非均匀采样间隔以及时间模式本身携带关键动态信息。现有方法存在两大局限：一是依赖插值/填补/聚合等离散化预处理，破坏连续时间语义；二是采用基于 ODE 的连续时间建模，需要专门架构和数值求解器，计算开销大。因此，如何高效且有效地捕获连续时间动态成为核心问题。

Method: WrapFlow 框架包含以下核心组件：（1）连续时间分词化：将原始观测事件编码为事件级 Token，包含三种类型——Event Token（普通观测）、GAP-aware Event Token（长间隔后的观测，附加 GAP 类型嵌入）和 Mask GAP Token（训练时屏蔽的历史段），保留值、变量身份、时间戳、间隔时间和 Token 类型指示。（2）Transformer 主干：使用标准带掩码注意力机制处理 Token 序列，生成变量级历史记忆。（3）基于查询的解码器：通过共享的跨注意力机制将无值的未来查询和屏蔽历史查询映射到时间上下文。（4）预测头：生成确定性基准预测。（5）残差流匹配：学习从基准预测到真实值之间的条件残差向量场，包括 Future branch（未来预测）和 Masked-history branch（训练时辅助自监督），采用仿真无关的训练方式直接回归目标向量场；推理时通过少量固定步数的 Euler 滚动生成残差修正。总体损失由直接预测损失、未来 FM 损失和历史 FM 损失三部分组成。

Result: 在 PhysioNet、MIMIC、HumanActivity 和 USHCN 四个数据集上的实验结果表明，WrapFlow 取得了最先进性能，相比次优方法 APN 在 MSE 上提升 3%、MAE 上提升 5.7%。消融实验验证了连续时间分词化（影响最大）、流匹配细化、跨注意力、GAP 感知 Token 和相对位置编码均为关键组件。参数敏感性分析表明隐藏维度、编码器层数和时间间隔阈值需要根据数据集复杂度进行调整。该方法在不同领域（临床、生物力学、气候）和更长预测视域下均表现稳定。

Conclusion: WrapFlow 是一种用于不规则多元时间序列预测的连续时间增强框架，通过输入端的连续时间分词化和输出端的仿真无关残差流匹配机制，有效建模连续时间动态，无需依赖离散化或计算昂贵的数值求解器。该设计在保留不规则观测内在时间语义的同时，实现了准确且高效的预测，在多个数据集上优于现有最先进基线。

Abstract: Irregular multivariate time series are widely encountered in applications such as healthcare monitoring, human activity recognition, and environmental sensing. Their core challenges stem from asynchronous observations, non-uniform sampling intervals, and the fact that temporal patterns themselves carry critical dynamic information. Existing approaches either rely on discretization-based preprocessing (e.g., interpolation, imputation, or aggregation), which disrupts the underlying continuous-time semantics, or adopt continuous-time modeling via ODE-based frameworks, which typically require specialized architectures and incur substantial computational overhead due to numerical solvers. To address these limitations, we propose WrapFlow, a continuous-time modeling framework for irregular time series forecasting. On the input side, WrapFlow introduces Continuous-Time Tokenization, which directly encodes raw observation events and explicitly models long unobserved intervals via gap-aware tokens. The resulting continuous-time tokens are then processed by a standard Transformer backbone to capture long-range temporal dependencies. On the output side, we develop a simulation-free training paradigm for Residual Flow Matching, which learns conditional residual vector fields around base predictions while avoiding numerical-solver simulation and backpropagation during training. This design enables high-quality continuous forecasting using only a small number of fixed rollout steps at inference. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that WrapFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [277] [Learning features from Newton's algorithm: a way to accelerate nonlinear parametrized PDE solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28036)
*Rémy Vallot,Florian de Vuyst,Thibault Dairay,Mathilde Mougeot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于机器学习的两阶段牛顿法初始猜测策略，通过学习参数空间采样和预计算解数据库的特征，构建解特征空间和修正搜索方向特征空间，从而显著减少牛顿迭代次数和CPU时间，可应用于广泛的非线性PDE问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 牛顿法的收敛速度高度依赖于初始猜测与真实解的接近程度。传统方法中，初始猜测的选择往往缺乏针对性，导致牛顿迭代次数多、计算成本高，特别是在处理大规模非线性PDE问题时效率瓶颈明显。需要一种能够利用已有解数据、参数化问题和已有残差信息来生成高质量初始猜测的方法。

Method: 1. 两阶段策略：第一阶段通过回归模型从参数空间采样和预计算解数据库中预测代理解近似值；第二阶段采用基于GMRES的残差最小化修正方法进行校正。2. 构建两个互补的简约空间：解特征空间（基于收敛状态）和修正搜索方向特征空间（基于牛顿增量中间过程）。3. 弱侵入式方法：只需高层保真度残差场和脚本化编程接口即可应用。4. 修正步骤计算开销低，仅需残差评估和小型最小二乘问题求解。

Result: 在代表性PDE问题上的数值实验表明：(1) 该方法相比单独使用代理模型初始化显著减少了牛顿迭代次数；(2) 总体CPU时间大幅降低，实现了显著加速；(3) 方法具有通用性，可应用于广泛的非线性问题；(4) 通过离散牛顿轨迹构造特征空间的方法有效捕捉了问题的关键信息。

Conclusion: 本文提出的两阶段牛顿初始猜测策略是一种通用且高效的方法，能够有效加速大规模非线性问题的求解。该方法通过结合机器学习预测和数值校正，为牛顿法提供了高质量的初始猜测，在理论和实践层面均具有重要意义，特别适合处理需要重复求解的工程和科学计算问题。

Abstract: It is well known that Newton's method converges faster when the initial guess is closer to a root of a system of nonlinear equations. In this paper, a two-stage Newton initial guess strategy is proposed by learning features from a parameter-space sampling and a database of precomputed solutions. The method uses discrete Newton trajectories to construct two complementary reduced spaces: a solution feature space, built from converged states, and a corrective search direction feature space, built from intermediate Newton increments. For an unseen parameter, a regression model is used to predict a surrogate solution approximation. Then, in a second step, a residual-minimizing correction is computed using a dedicated GMRES-based approach. The resulting state is then used as an initial guess for the high-fidelity Newton method, which completes convergence. The corrective step is computationally inexpensive since it only requires residual evaluations and the solution of a small least-squares problem. The methodology is weakly intrusive once the high-fidelity residual fields and a script-based programming interface are available. This strategy reduces the number of Newton iterations and decreases the overall CPU time. Numerical experiments on representative PDE problems show quantifiable speedups compared with standalone surrogate initialization. Significant speedups are observed. This generic approach can be applied to a broad class of large-scale nonlinear problems.

</details>


### [278] [ClawTrack: Towards Trace-Level Evaluation and Improvement of Real-World Autonomous Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28037)
*Xingjian Wu,Xuhang Zhu,Xingchen Liu,Junlin Liu,Jianing Wang,Linsen Guo,Xiaoyu Li,Xuezhi Cao,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ClawTrack是一个面向LLM自主智能体的双重评估基准，同时衡量智能体"完成了什么"（Task Score）和"如何完成"（Process Score）。基准包含320个跨8个领域（教育、金融、法律、办公、DevOps、零售、旅行、媒体）的任务，配备25+个确定性mock服务。Process Grader按四个维度（目标对齐、效率、信息利用、结果验证）对每个推理轮次评分，锚定12,541个任务特定rubric项。在21个模型、16,000+次试验的评估中，发现：（1）过程评分能有效归因成败，过滤纯结果评估遗漏的"幸运通过"；（2）四个维度互补，结果验证是系统性瓶颈；（3）框架对评估者选择稳健；（4）基于过程的轨迹过滤可在多个模型规模上带来一致的后训练提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体被部署到复杂的多步骤工作流中，现有基准普遍仅评估最终结果（outcome-only），存在关键评估盲区：无法区分可靠推理与幸运成功，也无法将失败归因于特定过程缺陷。这一"过程盲区"在长时任务中尤为突出，可能掩盖系统性的过程缺陷并误导优化方向。作者主张过程质量应作为独立的多维构念，与任务结果并行衡量。

Method: 采用四层架构框架：（1）Task Layer——每个任务包含自然语言指令、输入工件、参考解、任务特定rubric；（2）Harness Layer——Docker化工作空间，ReAct风格执行循环，记录完整轨迹；（3）Evaluation Layer——独立双评分器：Outcome Grader（结合完成度s_comp、安全性s_safe、鲁棒性s_rob，得分s_task = s_safe·(α·s_comp + β·s_rob)）和Process Grader（按四维度评分，per-turn score s_proc^(t) = g_t·(w_e·e_t + w_i·i_t + w_v·v_t)）；（4）Reporting Layer——聚合为Pass@k、Pass^k等可靠性指标。采用双阈值通过准则（τ_task=0.75, τ_proc=0.60），每任务执行3次独立试验。Rubric通过半自动化流水线生成：人类专家为8个领域各5个种子任务编写rubric（40个种子，Cohen's κ=0.874），再用Claude-Opus-4.8提炼为可复用的rubric-generation skill，应用于其余任务。过程评分LLM与人类判断的一致性达Pearson r=0.912、Cohen's κ=0.851。基于Process Grader还构建了轨迹过滤管线，用于从~20k轨迹（ToolBench/τ-bench/WildClawBench）中筛选高质量监督微调数据（s_proc≥0.65）。

Result: 主要实证发现：（1）峰值能力与一致性可背离——Claude-Opus-4.7在Pass@3领先（76.4%），而Claude-Opus-4.8在Pass^3领先（51.1%），非多模态229任务上20个模型排名中，MiniMax-M3以66.7% Pass@3位列第5；多模态91任务子集上GPT-5.5全面领先（Pass@3=53.3%）；（2）过程质量与任务成功相关（Pearson r=0.466, Cohen's d=0.945），双阈值准则有效过滤21.2%的"幸运通过"；（3）四个维度中等正交（r=0.49–0.67），结果验证独立性最高且为系统性瓶颈；（4）四名不同评判LLM间一致性高（平均两两r=0.81），同族模型一致性最高；（5）过程感知轨迹过滤在Qwen3三个规模（14B/30B/80B）上一致优于随机采样，分别+10/+16/+19 Pass@3。领域分析显示Legal和Media最难（最佳47.5%/48.7%），DevOps和Retail最易（>80%）；模型呈现显著领域专精化，无单一模型全面领先。过程评分仅增加约21%的输入token开销。

Conclusion: ClawTrack通过双评估设计解决了仅结果评估的诊断盲区。实验证明过程评分提供独立的智能体成败归因信号，rubric锚定框架对评估者选择稳健，基于过程的轨迹过滤能带来跨模型规模一致的后训练增益。作者希望该工作推动社区向过程感知评估范式转变，使评估同时支持智能体推理的诊断与优化。

Abstract: As LLM-based agents are deployed in complex, multi-step workflows, a critical evaluation gap has emerged: most existing benchmarks judge only final outcomes, unable to distinguish reliable reasoning from lucky success or attribute failures to specific process deficiencies, hindering attribution in long-horizon tasks. In this work, we present ClawTrack, a dual-assessment benchmark that simultaneously measures what an agent achieves (Task Score) and how it achieves it (Process Score). ClawTrack comprises 320 tasks across 8 domains with 25+ deterministic mock services. A Process Grader scores each reasoning turn along four dimensions (goal alignment, efficiency, information utilization, and result verification), anchored by 12,541 task-specific rubric items.
