Evaluating 21 models over 16,000+ trials, we find that: (1) process scores effectively attribute success and failure to specific reasoning dimensions, filtering lucky passes invisible to outcome-only evaluation; (2) the four dimensions are complementary, with result verification as the systematic bottleneck; (3) the framework is robust to evaluator choice across different judge LLMs; and (4) process-based trajectory filtering yields consistent post-training improvements across model scales.

</details>


### [279] [GVR-Coder: A Visual-Feedback Framework for Structured SVG Generation in Complex Document and Meeting Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28073)
*Yiming Xu,Jihua Kang,Chunsai Du,Qifan Zhang,Wangqiu Zhou,Yiting Wu,Tianqi Li,Qi Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GVR-Coder框架与DocMeetSVG-100K数据集，针对办公文档和会议场景下从长文本生成高质量、逻辑清晰的SVG逻辑图这一任务，通过课程学习驱动的拒绝采样微调、双重渲染反馈强化学习与生成-验证-修复智能体循环三个阶段，在复杂逻辑图生成上显著优于传统方法和主流闭源大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代办公场景(文档撰写、会议纪要)中冗长文本带来高认知负荷，而将文本转化为结构化SVG图表能显著提升信息传达效率。然而当前Text-to-SVG生成面临三大挑战:(1)缺乏面向复杂逻辑场景的高质量数据集(现有数据集主要面向简单图标);(2)缺乏显式布局先验,导致生成结果空间排布混乱;(3)缺乏细粒度视觉反馈机制,无法验证渲染输出并修正美学缺陷。

Method: 提出GVR-Coder三阶段框架:(1)课程驱动拒绝采样微调(CRSFT)——根据拒绝采样成功率将数据分为简单/中等/困难三级,采用"由易到难"三阶段训练,并注入碰撞避免、连接逻辑、防幻觉等布局约束知识;(2)双重渲染反馈强化学习(RLDRF)——结合美学奖励(基于VLM六维缺陷检测的扣分机制)与复杂度奖励(确保元素密度匹配参考图),通过GRPO在8000个困难样本上优化;(3)生成-验证-修复智能体循环(VRL)——验证器基于Gemini-3-Pro对渲染图进行细粒度缺陷归因,修复器根据反馈定向重构SVG代码,循环最多3次。同时构建DocMeetSVG-100K数据集(10万对,六类,含四类测试基准)。

Result: 在Arena_human_50、Meeting_cover_100、Meeting_topic_50、Svg_with_rules_120四个测试集上,GVR-Coder-32B-VRL分别达到94.7%、100%、97.3%、96.9%的得分,接受率(Ar)分别为82.0%、100%、90.0%、88.3%,全面超越Gemini-3-Pro、GPT-5.5、Kimi-k2.5等闭源大模型;首遍渲染成功率>99%;人类评估中语义匹配9.05、视觉质量8.82均居首位;消融实验表明三阶段呈累积增益(从基线49.1%提升至95.8%接受率),跨评估器一致性验证了结果稳健性。

Conclusion: 本文通过数据集与模型的协同创新,验证了视觉反馈机制对复杂SVG生成的关键作用:课程学习建立基础能力,双奖励强化学习弥合代码与视觉模态差距,智能体循环实现细粒度定向修复。GVR-Coder在办公场景下生成了逻辑严谨且视觉美观的图表,为AIGC驱动的结构化信息呈现提供了实用方案;同时开源了代码与数据以促进后续研究。

Abstract: In demanding professional environments and meeting review scenarios, lengthy text often imposes a high cognitive load. To facilitate efficient information communication, transforming verbose text into logically clear diagrams is essential. Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) provide an effective representation for this purpose due to their editability and resolution independence. However, current research on Text-to-SVG generation remains hindered by three major challenges: (1) the scarcity of datasets for complex, logic-rich diagrams; (2) the absence of explicit layout priors, which leads to chaotic spatial arrangements; and (3) the lack of fine-grained visual feedback to validate rendered outputs and correct aesthetic defects. To address these challenges, at the data level, we introduce DocMeetSVG-100K, a large-scale SVG dataset tailored for document authoring and meeting review scenarios. At the model level, we propose GVR-Coder, a novel framework designed to generate high-quality logical diagrams from lengthy professional texts. Specifically, we adopt a curriculum-driven rejection sampling fine-tuning to progressively enhance the model's capability in modeling complex structures, while explicitly incorporating layout constraint knowledge during training. In addition, we introduce reinforcement learning from dual rendering feedback, a mechanism that provides implicit feedback through reward signals to jointly optimize structural complexity and visual aesthetics. Furthermore, we design a generate-verify-repair agent loop, which improves generation quality through explicit, fine-grained feedback and targeted refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GVR-Coder outperforms competitive baselines and reliably produces logically coherent and visually appealing diagrams. Code and data are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [280] [From Expert Reduction to Behavioral Divergence: Tracing Numerical State through Sparse MoE Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28097)
*Tianyang Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究发现在DeepSeek-V4-Flash的稀疏MoE推理中,数学上等价的专家归约顺序会因浮点精度产生不同的执行轨迹,可引发路由分歧甚至延迟的文本分歧;C方案(BF16操作数+FP32累加器)在评估范围内保持与原生参考一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏MoE模型中,专家聚合的数学表达式对置换不变,但浮点实现并非如此。不同归约顺序在动态MoE解码器中可能跨过路由器top-k边界或argmax边界,导致执行语义不一致;然而现有后端兼容性测试通常只比较最终token,忽略了中间状态差异带来的潜在行为分歧。论文旨在揭示数值计算差异如何成为隐藏的执行语义,并提出分层运行时一致性契约。

Method: 在DeepSeek-V4-Flash原生运行时中冻结局部MoE状态,仅改变专家聚合语义。设计四种方案区分操作数表示与累加器精度(P32/C/A/B);通过trace-freeze-fork干预映射post-mHC状态到文本盆地;实施post-mHC端点精确重构和decode边界持久状态FP64精确重构两个对照实验;验证10个分支的确定性回放;在50个提示上探索性测量不同生成长度的分离情况。

Result: 1)单层干预在"why the sheep"实验中:A模式720排列压缩为10个文本盆地,B模式360个结构类产生11个文本盆地;2)B模式Chinese提示下360类分化为202裁员/113招聘/45其他三个事件方向;3)精确post-mHC端点重构可比特级复现后续339个post-mHC向量和7个完整decode步;4)FP64持久状态重构在7个decode步内比特级复现301个post-mHC状态、路由与文本;5)C方案在192条轨迹上与原生参考比特级一致;6)50提示在8/16/32 token时分离数分别为12/24/36,呈现horizon依赖性;7)10分支64-token回放验证确定性。

Conclusion: 数值一致性应被视为分层状态转换契约而非仅输出级测试。post-mHC状态作为token内一致性边界,全持久状态作为跨token连续性边界。后端迁移必须明确指定跨专家操作数表示、累加器精度与归约顺序,并在持久状态、层级状态、路由与算子层面验证。C方案(BF16操作数+FP32累加器)在评估的六项状态与调度范围内提供稳定的兼容性契约。相同token不一定意味着相同自回归状态:差异可跨token边界存活并延迟显现。

Abstract: Mathematically equivalent expert-reduction orders can produce observably different sparse-MoE executions. We isolate this effect in native DeepSeek-V4-Flash by freezing local MoE state and varying only aggregation semantics. Four schemes separate operand representation from accumulator precision. At one layer-5 fork, 720 A-mode orders yield 10 continuation basins; 720 B-mode orders form 360 exact structural classes and 11 basins. Under one Chinese prompt, the B classes split into 202 layoffs, 113 hiring, and 45 other continuations. Maximum-L-infinity B-branch selection separates 12, 24, and 36 of 50 prompts by 8, 16, and 32 tokens. Across 192 persistent trajectories per scheme, P32, A, and B change every native-reference route trajectory, while C preserves routes, token sequences, and texts. A separate 192-trajectory C check matches native MoE, post-mHC, next-router, and LM states bitwise. For one controlled B branch, exact post-mHC endpoint reconstruction reproduces the measured downstream trajectory. At the next decode boundary, exact FP64 reconstruction of the branch's full persistent state yields agreement for 301 downstream post-mHC states, 301 persistent-state checkpoints, 301 routes, predictions, and text over seven steps, given the same naturally generated next input. These controls identify post-mHC as an intra-token boundary and full persistent state as a cross-token continuation boundary. Identical tokens need not imply identical autoregressive state: divergence can survive a token boundary and become visible later. These results make expert operand conversion, accumulator precision, and reduction order part of a numerical compatibility contract for sparse-MoE runtimes and hardware backends. They establish controlled causal possibility, not deployment incidence; C's order invariance is limited to evaluated six-term states and schedules.

</details>


### [281] [LM-GRASP: Instance-Specific Language Models for Combinatorial Construction via Online Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28135)
*Mohand Mezmaz,Grégoire Danoy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LM-GRASP框架，将GRASP的构造阶段重构为在线模仿学习任务，从零开始在每个问题上训练解码器Transformer策略，结合局部搜索作为专家，无需离线预训练或手工特征工程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统组合优化的机器学习方法依赖大规模离线数据集和固定问题类别的强化学习预训练，存在训练成本高、分布外泛化差的问题；经典GRASP依赖静态短视的启发式规则，难以应对复杂解空间景观。

Method: 将GRASP的随机化构造阶段重新建模为在线模仿学习任务：局部搜索作为专家oracle，decoder-only Transformer作为构造策略；采用迭代的learn-infer-improve循环，通过行为克隆在精英轨迹动态档案上进行在线训练，无需外部数据或离线预训练，仅通过目标评估器与问题域交互。

Result: 在Taillard PFSP基准（ta51-ta60，最具挑战性的数据集，一半最优解未知）上，LM-GRASP平均比GPU-GRASP降低28.4个makespan单位，接近GPU加速相对于顺序执行的改进（27.2单位），但标准差有重叠。

Conclusion: 针对特定实例、在线训练的语言模型是手工设计构造器的有前途且实用的替代方案，特别适用于对经典贪心构造具有抵抗性的解空间景观。

Abstract: Machine learning for combinatorial optimization typically relies on neural constructors trained via reinforcement learning on large offline datasets for a fixed problem class-incurring high pretraining costs and generalizing poorly outside the training distribution. We propose an alternative: a metaheuristic framework that reformulates the randomized constructive phase of GRASP as an online imitation learning task, trained from scratch on each problem instance. A local search procedure acts as an expert oracle, while a decoder-only Transformer serves as the constructive policy. Unlike classical GRASP, which relies on static, myopic heuristic rules based on localized scalar costs, our approach is fully data-driven: the construction policy emerges from high-quality solutions discovered during the search itself, with no problem-specific feature engineering required. We instantiate this as LM-GRASP, a hybrid metaheuristic following an iterative learn-infer-improve cycle, training the policy online via behavioral cloning on a dynamic archive of elite trajectories-no external data or offline pretraining needed. The pipeline interfaces with the domain solely through the objective evaluator used by local search. Evaluated on the Taillard PFSP benchmark (ta51-ta60), the most discriminating block due to half its optima being unknown, LM-GRASP outperforms GPU-GRASP by 28.4 makespan units on average-comparable to the gain from GPU acceleration over sequential execution (27.2 units), though with overlapping standard deviations. This suggests instance-specific, online-trained language models are a promising, practical alternative to hand-engineered constructors, especially for landscapes resistant to classical greedy construction.

</details>


### [282] [Multi-channel Uplift Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28182)
*Changjian Liu,Tianyu Wang,Xiaoxuan Deng,WenTao Zhu,Yuwei Xu,Jungqi Jin,Yong Gao,Chuan Yu,Jian Xu,Bo Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对电商平台在固定营销预算约束下进行多渠道分配的组合式提升决策问题，提出 ReAlloc 框架——一种快-慢因果框架。该框架通过正交教师网络（消除观测混淆）和解释引导的学生网络（在长期范围内蒸馏边际场）实现支持感知的保守再分配决策，并已在淘宝平台大规模在线部署，支付订单提升 3.53%，收入提升 3.26 pt。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商平台需要在异构干预渠道（如广告引流、优惠券等转化激励）之间分配有限的营销预算。这些渠道既可能互补又会发生替代（如增加广告投入会稀释转化激励），最终产出由复杂的联合响应面决定。核心挑战在于：(1) 标准预测-优化（PTO）范式因观测混淆与严重外推问题在组合空间中失效——渠道独立建模无法恢复联合最优，黑盒全局优化会利用外推误差，且事实预测损失无法保证反事实边际排序；(2) 历史分配由遗留策略驱动，治疗分配与物品状态系统纠缠，使下游因果梯度有偏。论文将问题形式化为单纯形约束下的提升决策问题，决策原语从绝对 ITE 转向相对边际价值。

Method: ReAlloc 采用三阶段快-慢双系统架构：
（1）**正交响应教师（Stage I）**：在近期短窗口日志上通过交叉拟合估计基线需求 m̂ 与遗留策略倾向 ê，然后构建残差化产出和残差化处理（类似 Robinson/DML 变换）。教师响应面参数化为 μ̂ψ = m̂ + rψ(H,B, p − ê(H,B))，并通过复合损失（事实拟合 + 残差回归 + 局部方向导数正则）联合训练，确保在支撑邻域内得到可靠的因果局部边际场 gψ = P₀∇z rψ|z=0。
（2）**学生边际蒸馏（Stage II）**：慢速学生由标量势函数 sθ 参数化，其投影边际效用 uθ = P₀∇p sθ 保证有限分配变化可经势差一致评分，避免循环矛盾。教师为每个可行扰动 p' = p + δ(e_l − e_k) 生成有限差分目标 y^ψ_{k→l,δ} 与投影 Jacobian gψ，学生通过配对损失 + Jacobian 损失在回放缓冲 R 上蒸馏，并通过 EMA 累积更新。
（3）**支持感知决策（Stage III）**：放弃无约束全局最大化，枚举可行局部候选 C(p) 并基于学生势差计算预期增益。引入保守增益 Ĝ_cons = Ĝ − β·σ̂ − λ_s·φ(ω)，其中 σ̂ 为集成/MC Dropout 不确定性，ω 为基于核密度或逆 KNN 的方向支撑分数。策略选取最佳保守候选；仅当保守增益超过安全阈值 τ_min 时才执行更新，否则保持原状。

Result: **理论结果**：证明了 (i) 全局提升等价于沿可行路径的边际场路径积分（Theorem 5.1），为学生采用标量势函数提供动机；(ii) 事实拟合不能保证策略质量——存在光滑响应面与零事实风险的 PTO 预测器却具有恒定决策遗憾，且预测梯度可在 L∞ 上发散（Proposition 5.2）；(iii) 正交局部场估计在支撑集 R 上以 n^{-1/2} h^{-(K+1)/2} 速率收敛且对 (m,e) 扰动 Neyman 正交（Theorem 5.3）；(iv) 路径一致势函数的场误差以 2L_max·ε_g + ε_search 控制遗憾（Theorem 5.4/Corollary 5.5）。
**实验结果**：合成 DGP（K=3，含状态依赖混淆、边界偏斜、ILR 映射）显示 ReAlloc 在 Benign/Medium/Hard/Extreme 四个重叠度递减的设置下，可部署提升分别达 0.97/0.79/0.71/0.57，分别恢复局部机会的 88%/86%/84%/83%，最强 S-NN 基线边际为 0.04/0.07/0.09/0.06；非约束 PTO 原始提升高但部署价值低（验证外推不安全）。淘宝平台大规模在线 A/B 实验同时提升支付订单 3.53% 与收入 3.26 pt。

Conclusion: ReAlloc 将不安全的预测-优化范式转化为支持感知的因果再分配：通过正交化解决观测混淆（Stage I），通过标量势蒸馏解决预测-决策失配（Stage II），通过保守局部搜索与不确定性/支撑正则解决外推脆弱性（Stage III）。论文在形式化（单纯形约束组合提升）、方法（教师-学生蒸馏+支撑感知决策）、理论（路径积分等价、正交局部场估计、势函数遗憾界）与工业落地（淘宝大规模部署同时提升支付订单与收入）四个层面作出了贡献，验证了局部再分配可作为多渠道固定预算分配的稳健决策原语。

Abstract: E-commerce platforms must allocate fixed marketing budgets across multiple channels to maximize business utility. However, standard predict-then-optimize (PTO) paradigms fail in this compositional space due to observational confounding and severe extrapolation. We formulate this challenge as a simplex-constrained uplift decision problem and propose ReAlloc, a fast-slow causal framework. Specifically, an agile Orthogonal Teacher extracts unbiased local gradients from short-term logs, while an Explanation-Guided Student distills them into a structured marginal field over long-term horizons. This design enables support-aware, conservative decisions that capture cross-channel substitutions. Extensive simulations and large-scale online A/B tests on Taobao platform demonstrate that ReAlloc achieves simultaneous lifts in both pay order and income.

</details>


### [283] [TopoFormer: Topology Meets Attention for Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28259)
*Md Joshem Uddin,Astrit Tola,Cuneyt Gurcan Akcora,Baris Coskunuzer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Topoformer 是一种轻量级、可扩展的图表示学习框架，通过 Topo-Scan 模块将图的拓扑结构分解为短小的有序拓扑 token 序列，使 Transformer 能够高效处理图数据。它在图分类和分子性质预测任务上达到 SOTA 性能，同时具备可并行化和计算可预测的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统持续同调（persistent homology）管道计算昂贵、难以并行化，且难以与标准深度学习架构集成。作者希望将拓扑归纳偏置（topological inductive biases）无缝融入注意力框架，从而实现一种兼具表达力与计算效率的图表示学习方法，弥补 GNN 与拓扑方法之间的鸿沟。

Method: 核心是 Topo-Scan 模块：通过节点或边滤过（filtration）对图进行"切片"（slicing），将图分解为一个短小的有序拓扑 token 序列。该序列捕获从局部 motif 到全局组织的多尺度结构模式，再由 Transformer 处理以生成图级嵌入。方法可并行化，无需计算持续图（persistence diagram），并提供了关于拓扑编码稳定性的理论保证。

Result: 在图分类和分子性质预测基准测试上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，匹配或超过强 GNN 基线以及基于拓扑的基线方法，同时具备可预测且高效的计算开销。

Conclusion: Topoformer 开辟了一条并行化且统一化的图表示学习新路径，成功将拓扑归纳偏置整合进注意力机制框架，为图深度学习提供了新的设计方向。

Abstract: We introduce Topoformer, a lightweight and scalable framework for graph representation learning that encodes topological structure into attention-friendly sequences. At the core of our method is Topo-Scan, a novel module that decomposes a graph into a short, ordered sequence of topological tokens by slicing over node or edge filtrations. These sequences capture multi-scale structural patterns, from local motifs to global organization, and are processed by a Transformer to produce expressive graph-level embeddings. Unlike traditional persistent homology pipelines, Topo-Scan is parallelizable, avoids costly diagram computations, and integrates seamlessly with standard deep learning architectures. We provide theoretical guarantees on the stability of our topological encodings and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across graph classification and molecular property prediction benchmarks. Our results show that Topoformer matches or exceeds strong GNN and topology-based baselines while offering predictable and efficient compute. This work opens a new path for parallelizable and unifying approaches to graph representation learning that integrate topological inductive biases into attention frameworks.

</details>


### [284] [HARGO: Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization for RL Post-Training of LLMs on HPC Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28301)
*Tiangang Li,Xiangbo Tian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HARGO（异构性感知奖励引导优化）是一种针对高性能计算（HPC）任务的大语言模型强化学习后训练方法。它通过置信度调制的优势函数实现逐响应重要性加权，无需任务类型标签，即可在二元分类、事实问答和语义生成等高度异构的任务上统一优化。该方法在四个HPC任务、九种方法的对比实验中，在三个主要指标上均取得最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监督微调（SFT）虽能为LLM注入HPC领域知识，但不能保证任务适配行为：同一SFT模型在数据竞争检测上准确率达88.65%，却在事实问答中产生65.9%的冗长低精度回答。HPC任务存在极端异构性——答案长度差异达58倍、奖励分布跨越三种类型、SFT基线准确率从51%到100%不等。GRPO等均匀加权RL方法无法适应这种异构性，导致梯度贡献被浪费在无信息批次上。

Method: HARGO引入两个互补的内部信号实现逐响应重要性加权：（1）判别信号d——通过对优势函数进行调制得到 A_mod,i = A_i × (1 + α·c_i)（α=0.3），再由|A_mod,i|的归一化幅度派生；（2）置信度信号c——通过参考模型的逐token对数概率相对于EMA基线（ρ=0.9）的sigmoid归一化计算得到。响应权重 w_i ∝ d_i，当组内优势近零时回退为均匀加权。该设计确保置信度仅调制梯度幅度而不反转学习方向，并将梯度上界限制为(1+α)倍GRPO，无需任务类型标签或额外模型，计算开销极小。

Result: 在四个HPC任务（race_c、race_fortran、mlperf、plp）上对比九种方法（PPO、DPO、KTO、SimPO、GRPO、DrGRPO、HARGO以及SFT和HPC-GPT基线），全部从相同的Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct SFT检查点出发。HARGO在三项主要指标上均领先：WinRate 54.62%（+4.79超过HPC-GPT）、数据竞争F1 91.30%（Recall 94.23%，FN=9最少）、PLP相似度 0.8558（+0.050）。逐任务上，race_fortran第一（94.90%）、plp并列第一（100%）、mlperf第三（56.04%）。消融实验验证d和c两个信号的互补贡献：B3（完整HARGO）相比B1（仅d）WinRate提升+1.28，PLP提升+0.0078，同时F1几乎不变。模型已在单卡RTX 3080（16GB）上完成训练并开源。

Conclusion: HARGO将HPC任务异构性识别为RL后训练的关键挑战，并通过置信度调制优势函数实现逐响应自适应加权，有效解决了均匀加权方法在异构任务上的梯度资源浪费问题。其有界缩放机制（上限1+α）提供内建正则化，允许使用更低的KL系数（β=0.02）。在所有三个训练周期上WinRate单调提升而无崩溃，证实了该方法的稳定性。未来工作将扩展到更大模型规模并刻画其计算效率特性。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can equip large language models (LLMs) with domain knowledge for high-performance computing (HPC) tasks such as data race detection and benchmark question answering. However, knowledge alone does not guarantee task-appropriate behavior: the same SFT model that correctly classifies 88.65\% of C/C++ data race samples produces verbose, imprecise answers to factual queries, with 65.9\% of MLPerf responses exceeding 40 characters. Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training addresses this gap by optimizing for task-specific rewards rather than token-level imitation. Yet HPC tasks exhibit extreme heterogeneity, with binary classification, factual QA, and semantic generation differing by 58x in answer length, spanning three distinct reward distributions, and showing widely varying SFT accuracy. This makes uniform-weight RL methods such as GRPO suboptimal. We propose HARGO, Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization, which introduces per-response importance weighting via confidence-modulated advantage: computing a discrimination signal from group-level reward contrast and a confidence signal from reference model log-probabilities, then modulating the advantage before computing per-response weights, without requiring task-type labels. Across four HPC tasks and nine methods, HARGO achieves the best performance on all three primary metrics: WinRate 54.62\%, Data Race F1 91.30\%, and PLP Similarity 0.8558. Ablation confirms complementary contributions from both signals. HARGO establishes the best overall alignment quality among compared methods for heterogeneous HPC tasks.

</details>


### [285] [Semi-Supervised Learning for Molecular Graphs via Ensemble Consensus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28304)
*Rasmus Tirsgaard,Laurits Fredsgaard,Marisa Wodrich,Mikkel Jordahn,Mikkel N. Schmidt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于集成一致性（ensemble consensus）的分子图半监督学习方法，无需依赖标签保持的数据增强。该方法在多种分子数据集、任务类型和图神经网络架构上均显著提升了预测精度，尤其引人注目的是：单个集成成员的性能几乎在所有情况下都超过完整传统监督集成，并降低了校准误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子科学中获取高质量标签数据成本高昂（如DFT计算或实验测量），而大量未标记分子数据易于获取。然而，主流半监督学习方法（如一致性训练、伪标签等）依赖标签保持的数据增强，这在分子领域难以设计——分子结构的微小变化可能导致化学性质的剧烈改变。此类领域特殊性使得现有SSL基准和算法难以直接迁移到分子科学应用中，亟需一种无需显式数据增强的半监督学习框架。

Method: 方法核心是"集成一致性损失"（ensemble consistency loss）：训练一个包含M个不同随机初始化模型的集成，每个成员同时通过两个损失进行训练：(1) 标记数据上的标准监督损失；(2) 未标记数据上迫使该成员预测与整个集成共识（成员预测的均值）一致的一致性损失。该方法的理论依据是集合损失分解（Ensemble Loss = 平均个体损失 - 歧义性/多样性），由Jensen不等式保证集成预测严格优于平均个体预测，因此可作为无需预热的高质量监督信号。耦合权重γ控制个体精度与多样性之间的平衡，梯度计算时通常对共识预测进行detach处理。该框架无需显式数据增强，特别适合分子图等难以构造标签保持增强的领域。

Result: 在QM9数据集12个回归任务上，使用PaiNN架构（集成大小M=4），该方法在所有目标上均降低MAE（监督基线±0.0619 vs 监督+SSL±0.0613 meV示例）。单个成员在所有QM9目标上一致优于完整传统监督集成。在GNN+基准测试（ZINC、peptides-struct/func、ogbg-molhiv/molpcba）上，使用GCN、GIN、GatedGCN三种架构均有提升。在CIFAR-10/ResNet-18上将集成扩展至32个成员仍稳定有效。方法还提升了校准性能（降低NLL和ECE），并通过Hessian迹估计证明其将模型推向更平坦（更鲁棒）的极小值区域。与Frad等模态特定自监督方法结合时也能带来额外改进。计算开销约为2倍（因需要额外处理无标签批次）。

Conclusion: 论文证明集成一致性是一种有效且通用的分子图SSL方法。其最显著的发现是具备"知识蒸馏"般的效果——单个集成成员即可达到甚至超越完整传统集成的性能，使得训练时的高成本换来推理时的低开销，特别适合需要大规模筛选的化学性质预测任务。此外，该方法通过正则化效应提升模型鲁棒性并改善校准。在多种数据集、架构（从等变网络PaiNN到通用GNN和CNN）以及回归/分类任务上的一致性改进，证明了方法的广泛适用性。主要局限在于训练时需要训练M个模型同时处理双倍批次大小，计算开销限制了其在大规模基础模型上的应用。

Abstract: Machine learning is transforming molecular sciences by accelerating property prediction, simulation, and the discovery of new molecules and materials. Acquiring labeled data in these domains is often costly and time-consuming, whereas large collections of unlabeled molecular data are readily available. Standard semi-supervised learning methods often rely on label-preserving augmentations, which are challenging to design in the molecular domain, where minor changes can drastically alter properties. In this work, we show that semi-supervised methods that rely on an ensemble consensus can boost predictive accuracy across a diverse range of molecular datasets, task types, and graph neural network architectures. We find that training with an ensemble consensus objective increases robustness in models and exhibits an effect similar to knowledge distillation; an individual member of an ensemble trained this way outperforms a full ensemble trained in a traditional supervised fashion in almost all cases. In addition, this type of semi-supervised training reduces calibration error.

</details>


### [286] [Beyond Geometric Complementarity: Coherent Overlap in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28308)
*Huiyuan Tian,Bonan Xu,Shijian Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏混合专家(MoE)语言模型中"几何互补性"的常见假设提出质疑：作者提出ESSI指标和2×2因子设计，在6个MoE架构上系统地区分路由一致性、候选质量与候选-上下文交互,发现专家子空间存在显著重叠,但实际路由仍保持一致性;更关键的是,在全部39个因子单元中,候选-上下文交互效应均为负值,表明真实前缀缩小了选中候选的相对优势;然而功能性干预显示后期专家仍具预测价值,Top-2在所有3个训练种子中优于Top-1。由此提出"一致重叠"概念,强调几何相似性不能单独决定冗余性或剪枝价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有解释多将MoE多专家受益归因于"几何互补性"——即被共选的专家应贡献不同的表征方向。然而,这种直觉将三个本可独立存在的性质混为一谈:(1)路由一致性(route coherence),(2)候选质量(candidate quality),(3)正向几何互补性(positive geometric complementarity,即候选的优势依赖于其共选上下文)。准确识别共选专家是否真正互补,需要独立地交叉变换候选与上下文,这是本工作要解决的核心方法论空白。

Method: 本文采用三层方法学:(1)提出ESSI(专家子空间分离指数),通过Grassmann流形上的归一化弦距度量专家间距离,并以局部切向色散作为基准进行归一化;(2)设计前缀受控的2×2因子实验,在OLMoE/Mixtral/DeepSeek三种架构共39个单元中交叉"选中候选vs最强未选对手"与"实际前缀vs匹配替代前缀",通过双重差分估计交互效应D;(3)通过冻结路由的NLL干预(添加/替换专家)评估功能价值,并进行控制中间容量的Top-1与Top-2匹配训练对比。样本包括OLMoE-1B-7B、Mixtral-8x7B、DeepSeek-MoE-16B以及Qwen3、Gemma4、Qwen3.6共6种架构,采用2,048 held-out tokens/layer,基于1,000次源上下文bootstrap计算95%置信区间。

Result: 三项主要发现:其一,ESSI在18层中范围为0.776-1.060(中位数0.969),显示专家子空间重叠显著,但替代/实际路由的残差比在全部18个单元中均大于1(1.012-1.901),证实路由具一致性;其二,在39个因子单元中,A_actual>0在所有单元成立,但交互效应D在全部39个单元均为负,95%置信区间全部低于零(OLMoE/Mixtral宏估计D=-0.05548 [-0.05780,-0.05340],DeepSeek宏估计D=-0.05770),表明真实前缀缩小而非放大了选中候选的相对优势;其三,在39个冻结路由加法中24例的下一个NLL下降,15例无定论;Top-2在三种子子中均低于Top-1,差值Δ=0.1016±0.0025。敏感性分析(原始增益、最近邻匹配、严格校准)及独立SVD数值验证均支持上述结论。

Conclusion: 作者将所观察到的整体模式命名为"一致重叠"(coherent overlap):路由器从共享的、受token条件约束的几何邻域中挑选出相关性强的专家,而有用的多专家计算在缺乏不相交线性覆盖的情况下依然存在。研究表明:(1)专家间几何相似不应被用作冗余性、剪枝价值或多专家收益的替代指标;(2)输出级干预(而非输入子空间重叠)才是评估功能重要性的必要条件;(3)共选上下文会改变候选的有效性,这对MoE压缩、合并和跳过策略具有直接含义。实践上,任何声称"互补"的论断都应明确其表示、秩、度量与干预方式。

Abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models route each token to multiple experts, suggesting a geometric account of their benefit: co-selected experts should contribute distinct representation directions. Existing evidence often conflates route coherence, candidate quality, and candidate-by-context interaction. We distinguish these quantities using an Expert Subspace Separation Index (ESSI), matched-route residuals, and a prefix-controlled $2\times2$ factorial; frozen-route interventions and a controlled Top-$k$ study assess functional value. Three paired contrasts organize the findings. First, across six MoE architectures, expert subspaces overlap substantially, yet actual routes explain token representations better than matched alternatives. Second, across the 39 factorial cells in OLMoE, Mixtral, and DeepSeek, the selected candidate explains more of the residual representation than the strongest unselected rival in every cell, yet the actual prefix narrows this advantage throughout: all interactions are negative, and every 95% confidence interval lies below zero. Third, this geometric narrowing does not imply functional redundancy: adding later experts improves next-token prediction in 24 of 39 frozen-route comparisons, while the other 15 estimates are inconclusive; a controlled training study also favors Top-2 over Top-1 in all three seeds. We call this joint pattern coherent overlap: routing selects token-relevant experts from a shared geometric neighborhood, while useful multi-expert computation persists without disjoint linear coverage. Separating these quantities clarifies why geometric similarity alone cannot determine redundancy or pruning value.

</details>


### [287] [Measuring Distortion in the Empty Regions of Dimensionality Reduction Scatterplots with the Gap Index](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28324)
*Jaume Ros,Alessio Arleo,Fernando Paulovich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了Gap Index (GI)，一种用于评估降维（DR）投影质量的度量指标。与现有度量（如stress和trustworthiness）主要关注点之间的直接关系（如距离或邻域）不同，GI通过Delaunay三角剖分将2D投影空间分解为三角形，并比较这些三角形与其高维对应物的相对面积差异，从而量化投影中空白区域（间隙）的压缩和拉伸变形。GI既可以聚合成单一标量值，也可以叠加在散点图上以可视化局部失真模式。其计算复杂度为O(N log N)，在所有测试指标中可扩展性最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流行的降维质量度量（如stress、trustworthiness）主要基于逐点距离或邻域关系进行计算，难以捕捉投影中空白区域的视觉失真。然而，空白间隙（gaps）是定义散点图中聚类和视觉模式的关键特征（基于格式塔接近性原则），这些视觉上显著的失真可能导致用户过度信任不准确的投影结果。论文通过plane数据集示例展示了t-SNE投影产生明显虚假聚类模式但stress和trustworthiness几乎无法检测的问题，凸显了开发新指标的必要性。

Method: GI的计算分四个模块化步骤：(1) 三角剖分——对2D投影点进行Delaunay三角剖分，将视觉空间划分为非重叠三角形；(2) 三角形变形计算——对每个三角形t_i，使用Heron公式（仅需三角距离，无需高维坐标）计算其相对面积A'(t_i) = A(t_i)/ΣA(t_j)，并与高维对应三角形t̂_i的相对面积比较，变形值D(t_i, t̂_i) = (A'(t_i) - A'(t̂_i))/max(A'(t_i), A'(t̂_i))，范围[-1, 1]，正值表示拉伸，负值表示压缩；(3) 聚合——以权重w_i = max(A'(t_i), A'(t̂_i))进行加权平均，得到GI(X, X̂) = Σw_i|D(t_i, t̂_i)| / Σw_i，确保较大且视觉显著的间隙对最终值贡献更大；(4) 可视化——使用红-黄-蓝发散色方案将每个三角形的变形值直接着色到空白区域，可选高斯模糊平滑以减少视觉噪声。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的大量实验表明：(1) 在plane数据集上，PCA和t-SNE投影的stress分别为0和0.0764、trustworthiness分别为1和0.9993，差异极小，但GI值分别为0和0.5118，显著区分了两种投影的视觉失真；(2) 在sphere数据集上对mMDS投影进行迭代扭曲（Δ从0到0.2），大多数指标保持不变，只有GI从0.444上升到0.745，捕捉到了视觉显著的间隙变化；(3) 在t-SNE对cube数据集不同perplexity值的投影中，GI能清晰识别虚假模式和间隙失真；(4) 可扩展性测试中，在250k点的fiber数据集上，GI是唯一能在10秒内、2 GiB内存内完成的指标，而stress、trustworthiness和S&C均因内存不足失败；(5) 噪声稳定性测试显示，GI的标准偏差随噪声水平增加而增加但保持合理范围，18个数据集×3种DR方法的测试验证了其稳定性；(6) 在MNIST CNN嵌入的t-SNE投影XAI用例中，GI=0.81（t-SNE）vs 0.63（mMDS），可视化揭示了类间相对距离信息（如类5和8、0和6实际更接近）。

Conclusion: GI作为一种新颖的降维质量度量，填补了现有指标在评估空白区域失真方面的空白，通过三角剖分和相对面积比较有效捕捉视觉上显著的变形。它具有三大优势：对小结构变形的高灵敏度、可扩展的O(N log N)计算复杂度、以及直观可解释的可视化能力。然而，它也存在局限性：基于面积的变形函数无法捕捉整体均匀拉伸等变形；依赖三角不等式；Delaunay三角剖分导致的非连续性；以及压缩区域可视化较弱等问题。作者建议未来工作探索替代变形函数（如周长、角度）、其他三角剖分策略、用于压缩区域的可视化增强，以及基于GI优化的降维方法设计。GI应与其他质量度量结合使用，作为全面评估投影质量的多角度工具之一。

Abstract: Quality metrics play a crucial role in the proper use of dimensionality reduction projections for visual analysis of high-dimensional data. They quantify the degree of distortion of a projection compared to the high-dimensional data and provide a reliable indication of how confident users can be in the structures they see in the resulting layouts. However, most popular metrics focus on capturing direct relationships between points (e.g., distances or neighborhoods) while neglecting distortions in empty areas of the layout, even though these often compose visually relevant features of a 2D layout. In this paper, we introduce the Gap Index (GI), a quality metric for 2D projections that captures visual distortion by measuring spatial distortion in empty areas of a projection. It does so by decomposing the space into empty triangles, which are then compared to their high-dimensional counterparts to compute the deformation. This per-triangle deformation can be aggregated into a single scalar value or overlaid on a projection to visualize regional distortion patterns. Results show that, contrary to popular quality metrics, the GI is sensitive to small structural deformations that have high visual impact. It is also fast to compute and interpretable.

</details>


### [288] [LEDGERMIND: Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28374)
*Enjun Du,Hange Zhou,Chenxu Du,Siyi Liu,Zirong Chen,Ziyu Zheng,Yongqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LedgerMind是一个面向多模态智能体推理的免训练框架,将代理轨迹建模为受溯源约束的状态机。其核心是用结构化证据账本(Structured Evidence Ledger)替代自由文本缓存,使推理与决策声明只能引用账本中的活跃条目,并通过三层接地协议(支持覆盖率、实体一致性检查、数字一致性检查)进行实体与数值层面的验证,配合自适应双路径分发器与事件触发的类型化修复引擎,在形式上保证"溯源非放大"——修复不能引入无工具产出溯源的新条目。该框架针对四类被终答准确性掩盖的失败模式(轨迹忠实性缺口、幻象接地、过度推理悖论、修复时放大)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态智能体以"感知-检索-推理"的多步轨迹运作,但评测仍以终答准确率为主。该聚合信号无法区分正确答案是源自有依据的证据、语言先验还是误差对消。现有ReAct/Reflexion类框架将轨迹存储为自由文本,工具输出、模型释义、推导事实、修复重写混杂其中——引用结构可能掩盖结论级幻觉(Phantom Grounding),自由形式自我反思无法稳定纠错且会引入新无依据主张(repair-time amplification),更深推理链并非普遍有益(overthinking),因此需要将"溯源"从提示偏好提升为结构性约束,在实体与数值粒度上验证,防止修复过程中污染账本。

Method: 1. 结构化证据账本(11字段模式:id, src, 类型κ∈{Perception,Retrieval,Derivation}, 规范化事实fe由确定性映射M从工具输出得到, 置信度σe, 生命周期ωe∈{Active,Stale,Conflicted,Dropped}, 空间框be, TTLℓe, 替换指针ξe, 反向依赖集De),遵循四条不变量:证据起源于工具输出、引用有效性、声明-证据包含性、修复局部性。2. 三层接地协议:支持覆盖率ρ(c)=词元重叠比、实体一致性ECC(所有结论实体被引用池覆盖,允许别名)、数字一致性NCC(类型感知容差Δu,年份/计数/选项精确,连续视觉读数允许15%相对容差)。3. 自适应双路径分发器:基于规则复杂度分类器φ(q)在简单查询走Direct路径、复杂查询走FullPipe(含任务规划、观察声明、九宫格crop-zoom、2.5×放大、双读验证、双轮检索、[E]→[I]→[J]接地推理、最终决策三重防线)。4. 事件触发验证与修复:T1-T6(工具异常/陈旧引用/冲突/置信下跌/无依据决策/幻象接地)触发七种类型化算子(证据层Drop/Refresh,动作层Retry/Switch/Acquire,轨迹层StopAndAnswer/Abstain),遵循局部优先升级策略与固定每触发预算M₀=2。5. 命题1(溯源非放大):任何修复算子r产生的账本新条目必须有工具产出溯源。6. 轨迹级评估指标:UCRreason(无依据推理率↓)、GDR(决策接地率↑)、R4R(证据支撑的成功率↑)、WDG(错误但表面接地的比率↓),配以对称推理忠实性审计(S-RFA)与外审模型(Gemini-3.1-Pro)逐原子声明标注。

Result: 在六大公共基准与自建Hard-200压力集上、六个前沿MLLM骨干(GPT-4o/GPT-5.5、Gemini-3-Flash/3.1-Pro、Claude-Sonnet-4.6/Opus-4.7、Kimi-K2.6)上一致提升终答准确率与轨迹忠实性:①VTC-Bench:Gemini-3-Flash达58.9%创SOTA,Gemini-3.1-Pro +11.8、Gemini-3-Flash +12.4、GPT-4o +23.3;②通用VLM基准MMStar/MMMU/MMMU-Pro排名第一(11个基线),MMMU-Pro上自适应的直接路径对抗过度推理;③EMMA:整体58.29%(+9.58),数学+16.15、物理+16.02;④Hard-200:各骨干+11.2至+19.7,Kimi-K2.6在BrowseComp-VL从19.5%跃升至46.0%(+26.5);⑤MC-Search:F1从41.78%提升至61.28%,HPS从31.35%提升至57.82%,RD从0.89降至0.54,链对齐增益超过答案F1增益——表明收益源于接地轨迹而非事后答案改写;⑥S-RFA雷达图显示LedgerMind多边形在所有骨干、基准、轴上包围基线,WDG轴上缩减最显著,印证对F2幻象接地的抑制;⑦消融(同为工具预算):去账本-15.39为最损,去类型化修复-8.49次之,去ECC/NCC在困难子集伤害最重,Dispatcher's absence使易题掉分而难题不变(F3过推理签名)。

Conclusion: LedgerMind提出了一种以结构化证据账本为核心的免训练溯源约束运行时,通过三层接地协议、自适应分发器与事件触发类型化修复的统一接口,在四类被终答准确率掩盖的失败模式上同时改善答案准确率与轨迹忠实性,链对齐指标的提升幅度超过答案F1佐证了增益来源——而非末端答案拟合。命题1的溯源非放大保证使任何残留错误均可追溯至显式源。未来方向包括:扩展至具持久记忆的长视野智能体、将类型化修复推广到视频与具身交互模态、以账本级监督信号训练MLLM。局限性:依赖确定性别名表与规则分发器,泛化到更异质任务分布与跨语言/跨指代场景仍需更丰富的实体链接模块与可学习分发策略。

Abstract: Multimodal agents for visual question answering increasingly operate as multi-step trajectories that interleave perception, retrieval, and reasoning, yet evaluation still largely reduces to final-answer accuracy. This aggregate signal cannot tell whether a correct answer was reached through grounded evidence, language priors, or accidental error cancellation. We propose to treat a multimodal agent trajectory as a provenance-constrained state machine: tool outputs are normalized into a Structured Evidence Ledger that serves as the trajectory state, downstream reasoning and decision claims may cite only active ledger entries, grounding is checked at the entity and numeric level, and repair is realized as typed state transitions that cannot introduce content without tool-produced provenance. We instantiate this design as LedgerMind (Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger), augmented by a Three-Layer Grounding Protocol, an Adaptive Dual-Path Dispatcher that matches reasoning depth to question complexity, and an Event-Triggered Verification-and-Repair engine with a formal provenance non-amplification guarantee. We use LedgerMind to target four recurring failure patterns that final-answer accuracy tends to obscure: unsupported intermediate reasoning, citation-backed entity hallucination (Phantom Grounding), over-reasoning on simple queries, and repair-time amplification. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks and backbone MLLMs show that LedgerMind improves both answer accuracy and trajectory-level faithfulness.

</details>


### [289] [Hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo for Order-Optimal Neural Actor-Critic in Average-Reward CMDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28390)
*Ankur Naskar,Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对无限时域平均奖励约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）中的神经评论家（neural critic）参与者-评论家算法，提出了一种分层多级蒙特卡洛（HiMLMC）方法，首次实现了在一般策略参数化下、$\tilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$ 的阶最优收敛率，并消除了对混合时间先验知识的需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全关键应用（如交通、通信、机器人、医疗）需要智能体在最大化长期奖励的同时满足长期约束，这天然地建模为 CMDP。尽管已有针对线性评论家的最优收敛保证，但将阶最优保证扩展到神经评论家的平均奖励 CMDP 一直是一个未解决的问题。核心挑战在于神经评论家估计中存在固有的偏差-成本权衡（bias-cost tradeoff）：在神经正切核（NTK）框架下，减少评论家偏差会大幅增加评论家优化成本，阻碍了原始-对偶框架中的阶最优收敛。

Method: 提出 HiMLMC-PD-NAC 算法，核心创新是分层多层蒙特卡洛（hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo, MLMC）神经评论家，包含两个 MLMC 层：(1) 外层通过随机化优化步数（$H_k \sim \text{Geom}(1/2)$）在评论家优化层面进行去偏；(2) 内层通过随机化轨迹长度在轨迹采样层面进行去偏。算法包含两个子例程：Algorithm 2（层次化 MLMC 评论家）和 Algorithm 3（MLMC NPG 估计器）。整体算法为原始-对偶自然参与者-评论家框架，其中评论家是 $L$ 层前馈神经网络，策略参数化是通用的。

Result: 在 $T$ 次总样本复杂度下，HiMLMC-PD-NAC 实现了最优性差距（optimality gap）和约束违反（constraint violation）均为 $\tilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$ 的阶最优收敛率。这是首个在无限时域平均奖励 CMDP 中使用神经评论家和一般策略参数化达到阶最优收敛保证的原始-对偶自然参与者-评论家算法。即使在无约束设置中，这一结果也是新颖的。此外，算法不需要已知混合时间 $\tau_{\text{mix}}$，使其更适用于大规模强化学习问题。

Conclusion: 本文解决了神经评论家估计中的偏差-成本权衡瓶颈，通过分层 MLMC 方法首次在平均奖励 CMDP 中实现了 $\tilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$ 的阶最优收敛，并消除了对混合时间知识的依赖。技术上，关键创新在于引入第二层 MLMC 来去偏评论家优化过程，使估计器以对数级别的期望样本成本获得长时间评论家优化运行的偏差。这项工作为大规模安全强化学习的实际应用提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) provide a natural framework for reinforcement learning in safety-critical applications, where agents maximize long-term reward while satisfying long-term constraints. Although primal-dual actor-critic methods with linear critics are well understood, extending order-optimal convergence guarantees to neural critics in average-reward CMDPs has remained open. The main challenge is a fundamental bias-cost trade-off in neural critic estimation: under Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) analysis, reducing critic bias substantially increases critic optimization cost, preventing order-optimal convergence in the primal-dual framework. We resolve this bottleneck by introducing a hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo (MLMC) neural critic that performs debiasing simultaneously across trajectory sampling and critic optimization. The resulting estimator attains the bias of a long critic optimization run with only logarithmic expected sample cost. Building on this estimator, we develop a primal-dual Natural Actor-Critic algorithm that achieves both an optimality gap and a constraint violation of order $\tilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$. This establishes the first order-optimal convergence guarantees for infinite-horizon average-reward CMDPs with general policy parameterization and neural critics, while eliminating the need to know the underlying mixing time. Our results are novel even in the unconstrained setting.

</details>


### [290] [Why Are GUI Agents Correct but Late? Decode on the Decision-Time Critical Path, Tested with Pre-Compiled Policy Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28399)
*Zihan Dong,Rui Qian,Qishi Zhan,Dongshen Peng,Kaixin Li,Yu Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自适应预期策略树（AAPT），通过在空闲屏幕期预编译一个有界的条件策略树，将生成推理从决策时间关键路径中移除，解决GUI智能体在瞬态事件中"正确但迟到"的失败问题。在受控实验中，AAPT将成功率从0.50提升至0.79（p=1.8×10⁻³），且零错误动作，并在独立通用模型上得到复现（p=4.9×10⁻¹³）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体在处理瞬态GUI事件（启动提示、自动消失对话框、认证请求、toast、反应时间游戏状态）时常失败——典型失败模式并非理解错误而是"迟到理解"：智能体在事件窗口关闭后才计算出正确动作。论文将此归因于多模态大模型自回归解码的高延迟出现在关键路径上，并设计AAPT作为受控实验来隔离这一单一原因，区分"未能预见"与"预见正确但被自身延迟击败"两种解释。

Method: 核心方法AAPT包含三阶段：(1) **规划阶段**——空闲期间，同一冻结多模态模型构建一棵扁平条件策略树（含可观测guard、预授权动作、置信度、风险、截止时间），树大小按 T_cover ≥ L_p95 + M 的延迟覆盖规则确定（p95延迟+500ms安全裕量）；(2) **路由阶段**——事件时，轻量级低token观察者在变化门控帧上输出JSON分支ID（NONE为弃权值），执行受三道抑制检查（资格、置信度阈值 τ_m=0.45、决策年龄≤截止时间）；(3) **回退阶段**——不匹配、超时或验证失败时回退至重规划。结构预算（K_max、深度、节点数）由验证器硬约束，决策阈值（τ_c、τ_r、ρ）由提示工程软约束。理论形式化为：success = 正确动作 ∧ 动作在截止前。

Result: 在42对配对试验、精确双侧McNemar检验下：(1) **核心结果**：650ms窗口T2成功率33/42(0.79) vs R0(反应式基线) 21/42(0.50)，p=1.8×10⁻³，零错误动作；(2) **机制隔离**：R1(开环)和P1(预测-重规划)虽也提前动作，但因执行时仍需解码，得分0；O1(神谕路由)估计存在约0.14-0.17的头部空间差距；(3) **预计算预算扫描**：在L_p95+M≈2.4s处跨越，0.5-1s时T2为0/42，2s时为36/42（与R0并列），4s时为42/42；(4) **三道能力门**：亚秒级观察者解码、平面树有效性≥0.85、分支路由准确度≥0.85——六个模型中两个通过全部门并复现增益（Holo-3.1-35B和独立通用模型Qwen3.6-35B，126对p=4.9×10⁻¹³）；(5) **k×n前沿**：最小足够配置(k=3,n=1)即成功42/42，n=2无额外收益；(6) **预算边界**：误设分支预算（过少或过多）会将"未命中"转化为"错误动作"；(7) **外部迁移**：DynaCU-Bench上39个任务聚合并列（p=1.0），所有AAPT独占胜出为仪表板截止类（响应可在编译时枚举），所有反应式胜出需要多步序列或晚期揭示值。所有结果均经过预登记，包括两个失败的预测（700ms主端点和UI-Venus神谕探测预测），均完整报告。

Conclusion: 论文将GUI智能体"正确但迟到"问题重新定义为调度失败而非推理失败：AAPT证明只要事件被编译树覆盖且在截止时间前路由，将生成移出关键路径即可恢复"晚到的正确动作"。三个关键贡献：(i) 受控方法隔离解码延迟为错过动作窗口的原因（而非新智能体架构本身）；(ii) 在预登记端点和精确配对检验下，提供恢复性能的证据并验证延迟基准的sizing规则；(iii) 消融实验揭示三个能力门，并复现于独立未调优模型；外部基准证明该方法适用于候选动作可预先枚举的情形，与反应式执行互补。展望：未来应构建混合控制器，先检测转移是否可预先枚举，对可枚举情况使用AAPT，对晚期绑定或多步交互保留反应式执行；蒸馏路由、异步树刷新、可复用策略记忆是降低延迟和摊销准备成本的方向。限制：积极结果限定于Qwen3.5-MoE架构类内的两个检查点加一个外部基准；绝对成功率对种子集和延迟敏感，仅配对比较有解释力；预编译树无法绑定晚期参数（坐标等）。

Abstract: Computer-use agents often fail on transient GUI events because they produce the correct action only after the relevant window has already closed. We identify the main cause as expensive autoregressive decoding on the decision-time critical path. We propose Adaptive Anticipatory Policy Trees (AAPT), which eliminates this delay without modifying the underlying model. During idle screen periods, the same frozen multimodal model constructs a bounded conditional policy tree with observable guards, pre-authorized actions, and branch-specific deadlines. The tree is sized to cover the model's own decoding latency. When an event occurs, a lightweight observer matches change-gated frames to a prepared branch and immediately executes the corresponding action without generating new text. In paired trials with pre-registered endpoints and exact McNemar tests, AAPT improves the success rate from 0.50 to 0.79 within a contested decision window ($p=1.8\times10^{-3}$), while producing no incorrect actions. Both open-loop and predict-and-replan baselines achieve zero success because they still decode during execution. A preparation-time sweep shows that the gain emerges where the latency-based tree-sizing rule predicts, and ablations reveal three key requirements: fast observer decoding, valid tree planning, and accurate branch routing. A pre-registered oracle probe rejects our initial hypothesis and instead points to branch routing as the causal bottleneck. We further reproduce the effect on an independent general-purpose multimodal model over 126 paired trials ($p=4.9\times10^{-13}$). On an external benchmark, AAPT matches the overall performance of a reactive baseline, although the two methods exhibit complementary strengths. Together, these results suggest that AAPT performs best when candidate actions can be enumerated in advance, whereas reactive execution remains stronger when they cannot.

</details>


### [291] [QAdapt: A Noise-Adaptive Neural Pre-Decoding Framework for Quantum Error Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28422)
*Ran Miao,Rui Luo,Xiaohan Shan,Xiaoming Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QAdapt提出了一种噪声自适应的神经预解码框架,结合异构时空特征提取网络(HTNet)与基于弹性权重整合的量子持续学习机制(Q-EWC),通过局部神经预解码+全局匹配解码的混合流水线,应对表面码量子纠错中硬件噪声的非平稳、异构分布漂移问题,在110种合成OOD噪声配置和Google Willow基准上均实现了逻辑错误率与后端解码延迟的同时降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 容错量子计算(FTQC)的性能不仅受物理噪声限制,还受经典解码器处理快速综合征数据的延迟制约。实际硬件噪声具有强、异构、非平稳的特性,且仿真到硬件的分布偏移会严重降低固定神经解码器的性能。在不同噪声分布下重新训练解码器成本高昂,且需要目标域代表性数据,可能覆盖先前学到的知识。因此,需要在不修改量子码、不替换全局解码器的前提下,构建对分布偏移鲁棒的解码接口,这是FTQC可扩展性的系统级需求。

Method: 1. **混合局部-全局流水线**:HTNet从检测器张量中学习局部修正,经检测器拓扑映射生成残差综合征,再交由PyMatching执行全局匹配解码;2. **HTNet异构时空特征提取**:采用3D卷积干+三个HTNet块(112通道、扩展168通道),每个块分离空间分支(1×3×3深度卷积,捕获轮内链)、时间分支(3×1×1,捕获跨轮传播)、联合分支(分组3×3×3卷积,捕获耦合模式),通过逐样本逐通道的softmax自适应融合,并加入轴感知校准(通道/时间/空间门控加性sigmoid)和原始证据跳跃连接;3. **Q-EWC持续适应**:构建物理可解释的噪声任务序列T0→T1(测量)→T2(CNOT)→T3(空闲)→T4(Z偏置),每阶段20轮,使用对角Fisher信息估计各参数重要性,通过惩罚项λ∑F(θ-θ*)²缓解灾难性遗忘(λ=100,Fisher用65536样本估计);4. **在线残差解码**:HTNet输出四通道修正logits,阈值化后通过H⊕ê映射到残差检测器,PyMatching在更新后的检测器图上执行全局解码。模型参数量约65万,小于基线Ising-fast的91万。

Result: **分布内(T0环境)**:d=7时LER从0.05071降至0.04280(-15.59%),d=9时从0.04037降至0.03286(-18.61%);残差PyMatching延迟在d=7降低7.34%,d=9降低12.04%。**合成OOD(110配置)**:QAdapt在全部110个配置上LER均低于Ising-fast,d=7平均降低3.18%、d=9降低3.23%,后端延迟分别降低5.72%和5.65%;在高负载子集(密度≥0.13106,74配置)上全部改善,平均ΔLER=-0.00788。**Willow零样本迁移(无目标域微调)**:d=5时LER降低5.79%、延迟降低1.43%;d=7时LER降低2.51%、延迟降低9.32%,表明学习的局部修正可迁移至训练噪声族之外。

Conclusion: QAdapt证明神经预解码可在不修改量子码、不替换全局解码器的前提下,同时改善逻辑精度与后端解码效率,成为非平稳量子硬件与稳定经典解码算法之间的模块化接口。其Q-EWC持续学习机制有效缓解了噪声漂移下的灾难性遗忘,异构时空特征提取有效分离了轮内链、跨轮传播与耦合模式。未来工作需扩展至更长纠错窗口、更大码距、逻辑操作、漏失与串扰主导噪声,以及在线噪声估计驱动的全在线自适应、组件消融实验、端到端延迟量化与二项置信区间报告。

Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) relies on quantum error correction to suppress physical errors and preserve logical information at scale. In practice, however, performance is constrained not only by physical noise but also by the latency of classical decoders processing rapidly generated syndrome data. This challenge is exacerbated by hardware noise that is strong, heterogeneous, and nonstationary, as well as by the simulation-to-hardware distribution shift that can substantially degrade fixed neural decoders. We present QAdapt, a noise-adaptive neural pre-decoding framework for surface-code quantum error correction. QAdapt captures local spatiotemporal correlations in syndrome data, sequentially adapts to evolving noise conditions while mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and forwards the residual syndrome to a conventional global decoder. Across 110 synthetic out-of-distribution noise configurations for rotated surface-code memory circuits, QAdapt consistently reduces the logical error rate relative to the neural pre-decoding baseline. On Google's Willow benchmark data, without target-domain fine-tuning, it achieves reductions of up to 5.79 percent in logical error rate and 9.32 percent in backend decoding latency on the residual syndrome. These results demonstrate that QAdapt provides a practical and decoder-compatible approach to improving the robustness and backend decoding efficiency of quantum error correction under evolving hardware noise.

</details>


### [292] [Kohn-Sham Spectral Embedding on Sparse Graphs at the Nishimori Temperature for Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28428)
*V.S. Usatyuk,D. A. Sapozhnikov,S. I. Egorov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Kohn-Sham Spectral Embedding (KSSE)，一种基于统计物理的稀疏图谱嵌入方法，将预训练 CNN 特征映射到拟循环 LDPC 图上的随机键伊辛模型 (RBIM)，在 Nishimori 温度下通过正则化拉普拉斯算子（Bethe–Hessian）的特征值问题实现图像分类。KSSE 在 ImageNet-1000 上以约 21.24M 参数（仅为 Swin-L 的 1/10、ViT-H/14 的 1/30）取得 88.93% Top-1 准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1) 现有大型视觉模型（Swin-L 197M、ViT-H/14 632M）参数规模庞大、计算开销高，需要更高效的分类器替代方案；2) CNN 终端全连接分类头需要固定输入尺寸且难以随类别数扩展；3) 受统计物理中 Kohn-Sham 形式体系与自旋玻璃 Nishimori 温度理论的启发，将图像分类重构为稀疏图上的能量推断问题，探索能否以极少的参数实现 SOTA 性能。论文前期工作已证明在 ImageNet-10/100 上 RBIM 框架的可行性，本文尝试将其扩展至 ImageNet-1000 全规模。

Method: 核心技术路线包括：(1) **图结构与耦合定义**：使用拟循环 (QC) LDPC 图作为骨架，利用 Pontryagin 自对偶性 $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}\hat{}\cong\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ 使循环块可被 FFT 对角化；通过 Manhattan 距离归一化将预训练特征映射为键权重 $J_{ij}^{(k)}$。(2) **Kohn-Sham 分解**：将 D 维特征通道解耦为 D 个独立的正则化拉普拉斯本征问题（类比 DFT 中 N 个单粒子方程再现总密度），在 Nishimori 温度 $\beta_N$（满足 $\lambda_{\min}(L_\beta)=0$）下用 FFT 求特征值，计算复杂度 $\mathcal{O}(N\log N + k_\text{mode}^2 N)$。(3) **星形域手术 (Star-domain surgery)**：不彻底消除所有陷阱集（会破坏承载类别信息的码字 $TS(a,0)$），而是通过边移位构造围绕码字的局部凸性，将残差受挫约束到 $\rho(B_\gamma)\leq 1+\delta$，吸引域宽度 $\Omega(1/\sqrt{d_\min})$。(4) **多尺度分形分析**：用关联维数 $D_2$ 作为诊断指标，引导手术从粗糙区域 ($D_2>3$) 过渡到星形域 ($D_2<1$)，仅需 $k_\text{mode}=5$ 个傅里叶模即可完成 Rayleigh 精化。(5) **六个理论定理**：广义 Ihara–Bass 恒等式（联系 BP 与拉普拉斯）、陷阱集特征值对应、加性通道可分性、星形域手术定理（带受挫上界）、准平稳性扰动界（$|\Delta\beta_N|=\mathcal{O}(N_T/N_F)$）、收敛不动点定理。(6) **直推式 (transductive) 推理协议**：冻结训练代表 + 融化测试节点在同一稀疏图中联合嵌入，配合逻辑回归分类。

Result: 在 ImageNet-1000 上以冻结 EfficientNet-B4 特征 ($D=1792$) 进行实验：(1) 最优配置（$N=45{,}000$，列重 48，5 个融化样本/类）取得 88.93% Top-1，比 EfficientNet-B4 基线（82.53%）提升 +6.4pp；最差配置 ($N=20{,}000$) 仍有 80.20%。(2) 系统消融表明：列重对 $d_\min$ 与存储容量具有单调正贡献，$N=45{,}000$ 时列重从 28 增至 48 提升 +2.69pp；图规模扩大 +8.13pp；融化样本数减少 +1.23pp，与准平稳性界吻合。(3) 与同协议的 $k$-NN 基线相比仍领先 +2.5pp，证实物理嵌入超越最近邻转导的优势。(4) 直推协议对比归纳变体（仅冻结子图特征向量投影）约 86–87%，直推协议本身贡献约 2pp。(5) 参数对比：21.24M vs Swin-L 197M（10×）/ ViT-H/14 632M（30×），FLOPs 不高于 EfficientNet-B4 backbone 本身。(6) 重要警示：Swin-L/ViT-H/14 均为归纳协议，跨协议数值比较需谨慎；该结果需理解为「冻结 EfficientNet-B4 + 转导谱嵌入 + 逻辑回归」组合系统的准确率。

Conclusion: KSSE 证明可利用统计物理（Kohn-Sham 形式体系与 Nishimori 温度）从冻结 CNN 特征中提取判别谱结构，以 10–30 倍的参数缩减达到甚至超越当代大型视觉模型的准确率。核心洞见在于：完全消除所有受挫循环（陷阱集）会破坏承载类别信息的码字 $TS(a,0)$，故应当构造边移位以围绕码字建立宽星形域吸引盆（$D_2<1$，$\Omega(1/\sqrt{d_\min})$）同时将残差受挫抑制为 $\rho(B_\gamma)\leq 1+\delta$，借此 Pontryagin 自对偶性使少模 Rayleigh 精化可行。协议匹配对比与归纳变体分析均表明，Nishimori 温度谱嵌入本身（而非仅直推效应）贡献了独立的性能增益。当前局限包括：(i) 准平稳性要求冻结节点远多于融化节点；(ii) 精确可分性仅适用于拓扑层级 1（循环图），层级 2–3（CSS 量子码）需近似方法；(iii) 图拓扑优化目前离线执行，实时流式扩展仍是开放问题；(iv) 直推协议限制其与纯归纳基准的直接比较。未来工作拟将 KSSE 扩展至 CSS 与同调乘积码的量子图与非 Clifford 代数框架，结合量子 DNN 加速器以增强表达能力。

Abstract: We introduce Kohn--Sham Spectral Embedding (KSSE), a physics-inspired energy-based model replacing dense CNN classifiers with a sparse-graph spectral embedding evaluated at the Nishimori temperature of an associated Random-Bond Ising Model. By mapping pre-trained features onto quasi-cyclic low-density parity-check graphs and constructing a regularized Laplacian acting as a Kohn--Sham Hamiltonian, we solve $D$ independent channel spectral problems in $\mathcal{O}(N\log N + k^2_{\text{mode}} N)$ time via FFT on circulant blocks (leveraging Pontryagin self-duality of $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$) and low-order Rayleigh refinement. Graph topology is optimized using \emph{star-domain surgery}: rather than destroying information-carrying codewords by removing frustrated cycles, we construct edge shifts creating local convexity around codewords while bounding residual frustration to $\rho(B_\gamma)\leq 1+\delta$. Multi-scale fractal analysis ($D_2$ spectrum) and fractal learning-rate landscape certifies a landscape transition from rough regimes ($D_2>3$) to star-domain basins ($D_2<1$), enabling Rayleigh refinement with $k_{\text{mode}}=5$ modes. We prove six theoretical results: a generalized Ihara--Bass identity linking belief propagation to the Laplacian; trapping-set eigenvalue correspondence; additive channel separability with an explicit exchange-correlation bound; a surgery theorem bounding frustration with attractor width $\Omega(1/\sqrt{d_{\min}})$; a quasi-stationarity perturbation bound; and a fixed-point convergence theorem. In a transductive protocol on ImageNet-1000 with frozen EfficientNet-B4 features ($D=1792$), KSSE achieves \textbf{88.93\%} Top-1 accuracy using $\approx 21.24$M parameters, outperforming Swin-L (197M, 86.4--87.3\%) and matching ViT-H/14 (632M, 88.0--89.5\%) under standard inductive setups, while reducing model footprint by $10\times$ and $30\times$, respectively.

</details>


### [293] [Oracle-Budgeted Molecular Optimization with Short-Term Graph Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28437)
*Jiannan Yang,Veronika Thost,Xiang Ling,Tengfei Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"短期图记忆"(Short-Term Graph Memory)模块,作为一种即插即用的代理选择器,用于在固定Oracle预算下优化分子优化任务。该模块通过在线微调图神经网络代理,对每轮候选池进行预筛选,将预算集中在预测效用更高的分子上,在不增加Oracle调用次数的前提下提升搜索效率。在四个不同类型的生成器(GenMol、InVirtuoGen、REINVENT、Graph-GA)上验证,在1000次调用的紧凑预算下全部获得提升,并揭示了模块收益与生成器搜索广度及反馈利用方式之间的兼容性关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子优化中,Oracle评估(湿实验、docking、proxy模型等)的成本远高于分子生成,构成真正的瓶颈。在真实药物发现场景中,可承受的评估次数极少(几十到几千次),因此如何在固定且紧凑的预算下更明智地分配Oracle调用、避免浪费在弱候选上,成为比"如何生成更多分子"更关键的问题。已有方法多关注生成器或搜索策略的改进,但均未解决每轮候选池内部的选择问题。

Method: 核心方法是"短期图记忆"模块:在生成器与Oracle之间插入一个在线微调的图神经网络代理(基于GraphGPS的5层GINE+attention架构,以ZINC上预训练的motif预测权重初始化)。每轮生成N个候选后,代理先对其进行打分,仅将Top-k送入Oracle评估;新评估的真实分数同时累积到缓冲区并用于微调代理。提供两种选择规则:确定性Top-k(最大化利用)与温度采样的随机选择(可调利用强度)。模块不改变生成器架构与原生更新规则,仅作为外部排序层,因此可跨片段式、离散流、策略梯度、遗传算法四类生成器即插即用,且对Oracle预算保持中性。

Result: 在PMO基准的22个Oracle上(排除valsartan SMARTS):(1) 紧凑预算(1000次调用)下,四种生成器平均Top-10分数均提升(GenMol 0.542→0.613、InVirtuoGen 0.532→0.569、REINVENT 0.531→0.571、Graph-GA 0.530→0.557),Wilcoxon检验均显著。(2) 完整预算(10000次)下,搜索更广的GenMol(0.648→0.784)和InVirtuoGen(0.687→0.730)保持优势,而已具有强反馈利用能力的REINVENT和Graph-GA的最终分数增益消失,但Top-10 AUC仍较高(更快发现好分子)。(3) 收益与生成器对反馈的原生利用强度负相关:反馈利用越弱(GenMol用未加权种子)收益越大,反馈利用越强(REINVENT用策略梯度)收益越小。(4) 收益以多样性下降为代价,随机选择可调节这一权衡。(5) 与Augmented Memory(Guo & Schwaller 2024)在GenMol同条件下对比,图记忆以16/4/2胜出且保留更多多样性。(6) 硬过滤选择会导致REINVENT策略梯度崩溃(三个Oracle在600-9800次调用处停滞),故REINVENT必须使用随机选择。

Conclusion: 短期图记忆是一种Oracle预算中性的即插即用模块,在紧凑预算下可一致提升四类不同生成器,无需改变其架构或更新规则。其收益大小取决于生成器自身的搜索广度与反馈利用程度:原生利用越弱的生成器受益越持久,原生利用越强的生成器在预算充裕时增益减弱甚至消失。利用压力可通过随机选择进行可控调节。该工作将分子优化中的"候选分配"从"候选生成"中独立出来,提供了一种简单可迁移的机制,并给出了判断哪些生成器适合搭配代理选择器的经验信号(无引导基生成器的Top-100多样性)。局限在于证据来自计算代理而非真实实验,模块对超紧凑预算(<<1000)的适用性需进一步验证,且仅测试了四种生成器家族与单一代理架构。

Abstract: Molecular optimization is commonly performed under a limited oracle budget, which makes deciding what to evaluate as important as deciding what to generate. We introduce short-term graph memory, a plug-in module that preserves the generator architecture and native update rule while learning from previously evaluated molecules to prioritize subsequent oracle queries. The module maintains an online graph neural surrogate that pre-screens each round's candidate pool, so the fixed oracle budget is spent on molecules with higher predicted utility. Applied to a fragment-based generator on a standard molecular optimization benchmark, it improves the mean top-10 score at no extra oracle cost and never falls behind the base on any oracle; the gain extends to all four generators we tested at a tight budget of one thousand calls. We then analyze how surrogate-guided selection interacts with the exploration and exploitation behavior of different generators. Its benefit at larger budgets is consistent with two properties of the backbone: how broadly it searches, and how effectively its native search already exploits oracle feedback. We provide a simple way to spend a fixed oracle budget more selectively, and evidence on which generators benefit from it.

</details>


### [294] [Cybersecurity Detection Classification with Reasoning-enabled Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28460)
*Amol Khanna,Manu Nandan,Cristian Viorel Popa,Joan Pujol-Roig,Diana Bolocan,Laura Vasilie,Alexandru Apostu,Chase Helwig,Mihaela Gaman,Michael Brautbar,Edward Raff,Chase Midler,Sven Krasser*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于思维链（CoT）推理的安全运营中心（SOC）告警分诊系统，通过四阶段训练（提示优化、自训练、RLVR强化学习、置信度校准）显著提升对Windows端点检测的恶意/良性分类性能。系统使用30B参数的Nemotron模型，在高置信度操作点上比直接输出标签的基线模型良性和恶意召回率分别提升43.0和18.3个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决SOC中告警疲劳问题。现有方法直接提示或微调LLM输出分类标签，但未训练模型推理检测是否为真实威胁；此外CoT推理会损害标签token概率这一自动化分诊所依赖的置信度信号。论文旨在引入推理中心的方法，并解决CoT与置信度估计之间的冲突。

Method: 四阶段训练流程：(1) 提示优化——使用GEPA优化器结合LLM-as-judge多维度评分（多字段推理、阈值刚性、推理鼓励、字段覆盖、泛化潜力）防止生成脆弱的决策树式指令；(2) 自训练——基于AdaSTaR，使用优先级堆和难度课程学习，对错误样本进行rationalization（理据化）并用LLM判官筛选真实独立分析；(3) 强化学习——使用GRPO算法，基于格式与正确性的可验证奖励进行RLVR训练；(4) 置信度校准——单独训练一个校准器读取完整推理轨迹和标签，输出correct/incorrect的token判断作为置信度信号。基座模型为Nemotron-3-Nano-30B，训练数据为388K人工标注的Windows端点检测。

Result: 系统测试准确率达82.6%；在高置信度操作点上（自动分诊的关键阈值），良性召回率64.8%，恶意召回率53.0%，相比直接标签SFT基线（21.8%和34.7%）分别提升43.0和18.3个百分点。消融实验表明四个阶段单调提升性能；校准器训练是必要组件，未训练的置信度判官使高置信度召回率降至零；微调后的30B模型显著优于多个前沿通用模型（包括Claude Opus），验证了领域专业化训练优于单纯扩大规模。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了显式训练模型对安全检测进行推理（而非直接输出标签）能带来显著分诊增益，并强调置信度校准器是高精度自动分诊不可或缺的前提条件。提示优化、自训练和强化学习各阶段互补并产生累积增益。然而良性高精度的验证-测试分布漂移表明部署中需要持续监控和周期性重校准。论文未涉及多分类、其他传感器平台及更紧的控制验证-测试差距作为未来工作方向。

Abstract: A major issue in Security Operations Centers (SOCs) is alert fatigue, as the number of detections reported is more than staff can triage in a given day. Prior work prompts or fine-tunes large language models (LLMs) to emit a triage label directly, but does not train them to reason about whether a detection is a genuine threat. We train a chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning-enabled triage classifier on real, human-labeled Windows endpoint detections by combining automated prompt optimization, self-training, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. We find that CoT reasoning also degrades the label-token probabilities that automated triage relies on, so we separately train a calibrator that reads the full reasoning trace and estimates the probability that the verdict is correct. Our system reaches 82.6% test accuracy and, at the high-confidence operating point that governs automated triage, improves benign recall by 43.0% and malicious recall by 18.3% over a direct-label LLM classifier. We further show that the trained calibrator is necessary - an untrained confidence judge collapses high-confidence recall to zero - and that a finetuned 30B model significantly outperforms frontier general-purpose models, motivating targeted training over scale.

</details>


### [295] [Stage-Replay Divergence Follows the KV Cache: Fixed-Prefix Precision Controls and Bidirectional Cache Transplantation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28495)
*Alexander Boesgaard Lorup*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文审计了"stage-replay"诊断方法中的一个关键假设——即通过重建中间token前缀并以one-shot prefill方式继续，可等同于原始decoder在到达该边界时的状态续生成。作者在Qwen2.5衍生的多分支推理系统中通过五个精心设计的实验表明：在BF16精度下，看似可重复的精确token重放会产生大量轨迹分歧（166/200后缀不同），而FP32则不产生可观察到的分歧；进一步通过48层K/V cache的双向移植实验，证明边界K/V cache是导致轨迹分歧的因果充分载体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Stage-replay诊断方法广泛用于反事实token-credit估计、前缀干预、定上下文聚合探针和特权中间状态的蒸馏。然而，现有方法存在一个"捷径"：将存储文本作为新prompt重建，并以重复运行的一致性作为状态保真度的证据。作者认为这一推断过于强烈——live自回归解码通过增量cache更新到达边界，而fresh replay则通过prefill重建相同前缀，两者的kernel结构、内存布局和浮点累积顺序均可能不同，因此重复性仅说明各执行契约稳定，而非内部状态等价。

Method: 方法学核心是"四重保真度声明"框架：(1) 副本（replica）建立每种构造内的底线；(2) 精确token和执行契约确立构造代表同一离散前缀；(3) 保留的live参考测试重建是否保留实际到达的状态；(4) 直接状态移植测试候选状态变量是否承载分歧轨迹。具体包含五个实验：实验1在BF16和FP32下使用配对的200项GPQA Main holdout，对比retained live cache与one-shot prefill；实验2采用2×2固定前缀设计，冻结200个整数前缀并交叉构造（incremental vs prefill）与精度（BF16 vs FP32）；实验3用12行结果盲选的prefix进行live-to-incremental前瞻性桥接验证；实验4在24个先验分歧+8个先验精确行上进行48层K/V cache的双向整体移植；实验5在不同的后期checkpoint上以结果盲选方式进行复制。所有实验在B200上用Hugging Face SDPA执行，严格控制token/role/mask/position/cache position/padding/物理batch契约，使用duplicate-of-two设计验证replica底线。

Result: 实验1（BF16）：副本对在所有200项上完全一致（包括boundary cache、logits、后缀和正确性标签）；两种状态构造在边界上非bit-exact但立即argmax一致；后续在166/200后缀、49/200答案、20/200正确性标签上分歧，首次分歧中位数为边界后88个token；live得93/200，prefill得95/200，差+1.0pp (95% CI [-3.5,+5.5])，McNemar p=0.824。实验2（固定前缀2×2）：所有200个BF16/FP32前缀完全相同；BF16重现166/200后缀、49/200答案、20/200标签分歧；FP32三种指标均为0/200（Wilson 95%上限1.88%）；BF16相对L2差异中位数0.01224 vs FP32的4.27×10⁻⁶。实验3（前瞻桥接）：12/12行上incremental构造与retained live cache在所有48层bit-exact，边界logits和完整后缀也完全一致。实验4（移植）：所有24个先验分歧行上，双向整体移植均精确跟随cache donor（24/24，Wilson [86.2,100]%），8个精确控制行无新轨迹（0/8）。实验5（结果盲复制）：后期checkpoint上43/48行出现incremental/prefill分歧（89.6%），所有43个分歧行上双向移植均跟随donor（43/43），5个自然精确行无新轨迹。

Conclusion: 本文确立了一个操作性结论：在测试的普通BF16表面上，精确token的fresh prefill不是增量decoder状态的忠实替代；完整K/V状态承载了两个移植实验中每个测试的分歧后缀；高精度（FP32）在测试的固定前缀上消除了可观察的行为差异。由此提出"测量规则"：重建上下文不应被解释为端到端decoder所占据的状态，除非比较包含保留的live参考、副本底线、精确token/role/mask/position契约以及感兴趣的端点。本研究不主张重放准确性收益或损害、通用的BF16/FP32规律、唯一的kernel/scheduler原因或潜在阶段结构的缺失，声称是操作性的、限定于被测试状态的。

Abstract: Stage-replay diagnostics reconstruct intermediate token prefixes and treat fresh-prefill continuation as continuation from the decoder state that originally reached the prefix. We audit that assumption at a whole reasoning-stage boundary in a Qwen2.5-derived system. A matched 200-item experiment compares retained live cache with one-shot prefill of identical integer tokens and places an exact replica on both sides. In BF16, replicas remain exact while the constructions differ on 166 suffixes and 20 correctness labels; the accuracy difference is only one point (paired 95% CI [-3.5, +5.5]). A fixed-prefix 2x2 holds all 200 token states constant while crossing construction and precision. The BF16 disagreements recur, whereas FP32 produces no decoded disagreement (95% Wilson upper bound 1.88%). A prospective bridge makes token-by-token incremental and retained live caches bit-exact on 12/12 rows; an all-200 saved-ledger audit reproduces every retained trajectory and comparison fingerprint. Bidirectional transplantation of all 48 key/value layers makes every tested divergent continuation follow its cache donor, both on a selected set at the primary checkpoint (24/24) and an outcome-blind replication at a later checkpoint (43/43). Exact-token replay can therefore be repeatable without preserving live-state fidelity. On the tested states, boundary K/V cache is a causally sufficient carrier of the divergent trajectory, while numerical precision moderates its behavioral expression.

</details>


### [296] [The Role of Causality in Algorithmic Recourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28497)
*Srikanth Avasarala,Varun Gupta,Shahin Jabbari,Saber Salehkaleybar,Juba Ziani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种因果performative算法救济框架，通过引入结构因果模型（SCM）来建模救济干预在特征间的因果传播效应，将救济问题形式化为performative prediction问题。研究表明，考虑因果结构的救济策略能够引导代理进行有意义的真实改善（而非博弈），并显著减少重复模型再训练的需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有算法救济方法仅关注翻转模型预测，忽略了所建议的特征变化是否真正改善了个体的真实资格（如还款能力），还是仅仅用于博弈分类器。这会导致Goodhart's law问题——代理的策略性行为会降低预测准确性，使救济在模型再训练后失效。需要联合设计模型和救济策略以促进有意义的改善同时保持高预测准确性。

Method: 1. 因果特征建模：使用加权有向无环图（DAG）表示特征间因果依赖，通过邻接矩阵A的特征贡献矩阵G_x = (I-A^T)^{-1} = ΣA^k捕捉直接和间接因果效应；2. 代理响应建模：代理选择最大化效用函数 w^T(x+Δx(a)) - (1/κ)c(a) 的干预a，得到闭式解 a* = (κ/2)C^{-1}G_x w；3. Performative预测框架：因最优问题非凸，将学习问题形式化为performative prediction，通过RRM（重复风险最小化）和RGD（重复梯度下降）算法求解performative稳定解；4. 灵敏度分析：通过特征贡献矩阵的算子范数表征分布映射的ε-敏感度 ε = (κ/2)Λ(C,G_x,G_y)，证明收敛条件 κ < γ/(βΛ)。

Result: 1. 理论结果：建立稳定解存在性条件，证明RRM和RGD算法收敛到performative稳定解的充分条件，并证明稳定解与performative最优解的接近性；2. 实证结果：在半合成7维贷款数据集和台湾信用数据集上验证：- 因果救济模型相比朴素ERM在performative目标上获得显著改善，且随κ增大改善更明显；- RRM和RGD在不同κ值下均能收敛；- 不同干预成本结构（uniform、upstream-cheap、downstream-cheap）展示了因果传播对救济分配的影响，下游特征虽不可直接干预但通过因果传播获得显著变化。

Conclusion: 将因果结构整合到算法救济中是减少代理博弈激励、提高模型鲁棒性的有效方法。通过将救济问题形式化为performative prediction，可以表征稳定解的存在性和计算复杂度，并保证迭代算法的收敛性。实验表明因果救济策略在多个数据集上 consistently 优于朴素ERM，且减少了对重复模型再训练的需求。未来方向包括联合学习因果图不确定性以及扩展到更丰富的预测模型类别。

Abstract: Algorithmic recourse aims to provide individuals with actionable changes to improve their predicted outcomes in high-stakes classification settings, such as loan and mortgage applications. However, most existing approaches focus only on flipping a model's prediction, without accounting for whether the recommended changes lead to genuine improvement in an individual's true qualifications or merely enable strategic gaming of the classifier. Consequently, deployed recourse policies can induce behavioral responses that degrade predictive accuracy and become ineffective after model retraining. In this work, we formalize this failure mode through a causal performative framework for recourse. We model how recourse actions propagate through a structural causal model, capturing interactions among features as well as their effect on the true label. These causal responses induce a non-convex optimization problem, even under standard convex losses. We characterize conditions under which performatively stable solutions exist and can be efficiently computed via simple iterative dynamics. Our analysis reveals that recourse policies that ignore causal structure can induce large, misaligned behavioral responses, whereas causal recourse leads to stable equilibria that reduce incentives for gaming. Experiments on both semi-synthetic and real credit datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms standard empirical risk minimization while reducing the need for repeated model retraining to accommodate distribution shifts caused by strategic agent behavior.

</details>


### [297] [Same Graph Cross-Task Transfer in GNNs: Protocols and Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28525)
*Neelam Akula,Surbhi Kumar,Murat Kantarcioglu,Baris Coskunuzer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了同一图上节点分类(NC)与链接预测(LP)之间的跨任务迁移学习,提出了防泄漏的标准化评估协议,发现迁移具有显著的方向性与可预测性:NC→LP在同质性图上持续有效,而LP→NC仅在结构主导型数据集(USA、Europe、Brazil)上可靠地改善NC。文章引入CoTask Score(CTS)作为联合性能度量,并证明同质性是NC→LP增益的强预测因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实图数据同时包含节点标签(NC监督)和观测边(LP监督),但现有评估采用不一致的数据划分、消息传递图与负采样规则,导致跨任务迁移结论不可靠。需要一个统一、可复现的协议来研究"同一图上NC与LP何时能互相促进"这一基本问题,同时为实践中使用共享编码器(降低训练与部署成本)提供指导。

Method: 1) **防泄漏协议**:固定节点与边划分(NC标签60/20/20,LP正边80/10/10),消息传递图仅使用训练正边(A_obs = Adj(V, E⁺_tr)),固定LP负样本集(1:1正负比)跨方法复用。2) **五种迁移机制**:WS(参数热启动)、ET-Rep(以源嵌入替换输入特征)、ET-Concat(拼接源嵌入与原始特征)、MV(双编码器+InfoNCE跨视图对齐)、Joint(单编码器加权多任务)。3) **三种骨干网络**:GCN、GraphSAGE、GPS。4) **CoTask Score (CTS)**:以固定GCN参考模型为锚,计算NC准确率与LP AUC的平均相对增益百分比。5) **数据集**:11个图,覆盖同质、异质、结构主导三种正则。

Result: **NC→LP**:在Cora、Citeseer、PubMed等同质图上,所有骨干网络和机制均带来稳定AUC增益(GCN上WS+9.4至+11.9,ET Rep最高达+10.7至+11.9);MV与Joint通常最优,表明联合训练优于事后复用。**LP→NC**:总体脆弱且不稳定,ET-Rep在同质图上常导致严重负迁移(GCN上PubMed下降21.4pp,Cora下降12.7pp);但在USA、Europe、Brazil(结构主导型,LP易学而NC未饱和)上,ET-Concat与Joint可带来显著增益(如GraphSAGE在Brazil上+20.4pp)。**预测因子**:同质性He、Hn与NC→LP增益呈强正相关(ET-Rep的r=0.787/0.847,ET-Concat的r=0.838/0.904,均p<0.01);但与LP→NC增益相关性弱且不一致,全局聚类系数(CC)成为LP→NC ET-Concat的预测因子(r=0.782, p<0.01)。**几何证据**:NC训练后正负边对的余弦相似度差距在同质图上增幅约0.61(2.1倍于异质图的0.29),解释了NC→LP的方向性。**CTS**:在同质图上MV/Joint获最佳联合分数;异质图上正CTS集中在GraphSAGE/GPS的MV/Joint;混合正则下结果具有数据集特异性,无单一普适机制。

Conclusion: 同图跨任务迁移具有**强方向性与正则依赖**:NC→LP在同质图上可靠受益且可由同质性预测;LP→NC在结构主导正则(高LP可学性+NC未饱和)下方可作为结构预训练有效,但不能作为默认策略。**联合训练(MV、Joint)比事后复用更稳定**,ET-Rep易引发负迁移。CTS揭示了任务间的权衡,简单的数据集统计量(尤其同质性)可指导机制选择以避免负迁移。该研究为多目标图学习提供了可复现的评估范式与实用指导。

Abstract: Many real-world graphs support multiple predictive tasks over the same underlying structure, creating an opportunity to reuse supervision across node classification (NC) and link prediction (LP). However, existing evaluations often rely on incompatible splits, observed-graph assumptions, and negative sampling rules, making conclusions about same-graph cross-task transfer unreliable. We formalize same-graph NC-LP transfer and propose a leakage-free protocol that fixes node and edge splits, uses a shared message-passing graph that excludes evaluated edges, and employs fixed negatives for LP. Across three backbones (GCN, GraphSAGE, GPS), we find that transfer is strongly directional and predictable: NC $\to$ LP is consistently beneficial on homophilic graphs, while LP $\to$ NC is fragile and can even degrade accuracy under naive representation reuse. LP $\to$ NC becomes reliably positive mainly in a structure-dominant regime where LP is easy but NC is unsaturated, suggesting that LP acts as structural pretraining. Finally, we introduce the CoTask Score (CTS) to summarize joint NC+LP utility when a shared encoder must serve both tasks, and show that simple dataset statistics, especially homophily, can guide mechanism choice and help avoid negative transfer.

</details>


### [298] [$β$-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28582)
*Jiawei Xu,Minghui Liu,Juzheng Zhang,Tom Goldstein,Furong Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: β-OPSD提出了一种新的在线自蒸馏框架,将传统OPSD重新解释为KL正则化策略优化家族中β=1的特例,通过引入可控的正则化参数β和return-to-go信用分配机制,在数学推理任务上稳定优于标准OPSD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线自蒸馏(OPSD)在实践中往往脆弱不稳定,需要大量工程调优才能有效工作。现有OPSD方法直接以教师模型作为唯一优化目标,缺乏对学生偏离参考策略程度的显式控制。这种结构性缺陷是OPSD不稳定性的根源,亟需一种原则性方法来解决。

Method: 方法包含三个核心贡献:(1) 揭示vanilla OPSD等价于KL正则化策略优化在β=1处的特例,将β从隐式固定值变为显式正则化参数;(2) 推导β-OPSD的最优策略为参考策略与特权教师之间的几何插值:π*β ∝ π_ref^(1-1/β) · p_T^(1/β),通过调度token级logit插值高效实现蒸馏目标,避免难以处理的序列级归一化常数;(3) 提出return-to-go信用分配机制G_t = Σ_{s≥t} γ^(s-t) ρ_s,用折扣未来log-ratio作为token级权重,替代短视的局部token-KL更新,从而获得序列级目标的无偏梯度估计器(γ=1时)。

Result: 在AIME 2024、AIME 2025和HMMT 2025数学推理基准上,以Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B为基座进行实验,β-OPSD在avg@12指标上稳定优于vanilla OPSD,在Qwen3-1.7B上最高提升达9.16个百分点。消融实验证实了RL推导的插值目标和序列级return-to-go信用分配两个组件各自的贡献。同时探索了混合学生-教师采样的off-policy变体(带重要性采样),虽能获得类似改进但实现复杂、采样效率低,故未作为默认方案。

Conclusion: β-OPSD建立了一个原则性框架,将on-policy蒸馏视为轨迹级策略优化而非局部token模仿,标准OPSD是参考正则化RL家族的β=1教师终点。几何插值目标路径和return-to-go信用分配是改进在线自蒸馏的两个有效原则。未来可探索自适应或理论优化的插值调度、更低方差的return-to-go估计器,以及在数学推理以外的应用。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is a promising approach to improve reasoning language models, but it remains brittle in practice: making it work reliably often requires substantial engineering effort. We identify a structural source of this difficulty: vanilla OPSD is precisely the $\beta=1$ member of a broader policy-optimization family, where $\beta$ weights the KL penalty anchoring the student to a reference policy. This equivalence turns $\beta$ from an implicit value fixed at one into a controllable regularization parameter, yielding a more general formulation that trades off proximity to a reference policy against privileged teacher guidance. We introduce $\beta$-OPSD and derive its optimal policy as a geometric interpolation between the reference policy and the privileged teacher. Directly optimizing this objective with reinforcement learning, however, would be costly and high-variance. Rather than optimize the RL objective directly, we turn its closed-form solution into a distillation target. Each value of $\beta$ selects a target along the reference-to-teacher path, which we implement efficiently by mixing their token-level logits. In this way, inexpensive distillation approximates the solution of expensive policy optimization. Return-to-go credit assignment further aligns token updates with the sequence-level objective while retaining the simplicity of OPSD. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that $\beta$-OPSD consistently outperforms vanilla OPSD, improving optimization stability and downstream reasoning performance. Our results provide a principled route from self-distillation to policy optimization and back without sacrificing the efficiency that makes OPSD practical.

</details>


### [299] [KAISEN: Reproducible Subgroup Fairness Auditing for Clinical Risk Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28608)
*Sparsh Roy,Samuel Girmachew,Nishita Chavan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KAISEN 是一个面向临床风险模型的可复现子群体公平性审计流水线，将审计拆解为分层、差异测量、机制诊断、后处理缓解与纵向漂移监控五个阶段，并在已知真值的合成基准（16 种疾病任务 × 15 个 SDOH 轴 × 3 个交集）上将每一阶段"压至失效"。其核心立场是：审计本身是测量仪器，未经压力测试的仪器会以静默方式失败；任何"无显著差异"或"无材料性差异"的结论都必须在读数旁同时公布其分辨力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床风险模型常具备较强的整体判别性能，却在患者子群体间产生显著不同的错误率。现有审计流水线存在三类系统性问题：(1) 仅报告聚合指标，掩盖子群体失败；(2) 子群体分析稀疏且不一致；(3) 几乎没有纵向公平性追踪。更关键的是，审计组件本身未经压力测试——一份"无差异"或"无材料性差异"的输出至少对应三种现实（差异确实不存在、诊断指错了特征、子群体样本量不足以解析），但打印结果完全相同。论文因此追问"每个审计组件在什么条件下失效，以及失效是否会在其报告中显形"。

Method: 提出 KAISEN 五阶段流水线：Phase I 按敏感属性分层并标记 n_min 以下的小样本组；Phase II 计算 AUC、EOD（含基于结果-种子条件分层的 5,000 次单侧置换检验 + BH FDR 校正 α=0.05）、等宽/等分位 ECE 与 MCE；Phase III 通过"反事实代理探针"（替换劣势组代理特征列）与"残差分歧探针"对每组相对匹配对照进行机制判别，输出单标签（模型驱动 / 标签噪声驱动 / 无材料差异）；Phase IV 串联 IPW 加权群组 Platt 缩放与分组阈值优化（坐标下降 + 96% 精度约束）；Phase V 在滚动窗上对 Medicaid/无保险与商业保险人群的 EOD 流应用单侧 CUSUM，阈值由基线 σ 自适应设置。基准为受控 SCM 生成的合成 SDOH 数据（N=12,000/疾病），注入"无 / 模型驱动 / 标签噪声"三种差异机制。三种基线模型（LR、HGBT、MLP）均剔除 15 个敏感属性作为直接输入。三种子群单元大小通过 Monte Carlo 功效曲线给出每轴自己的 MDE；用 EOD/MDE = R 进行轴内标准化。统计推断采用配对运行差 + bootstrap 95% CI + Wilcoxon 符号秩 + Clopper-Pearson 计数 CI，而非比较配置均值。所有结果由脚本从提交工件生成。

Result: 四项主要发现：(i) 显著性按"效应量对每轴自身分辨力"排序，而非按原始 EOD：15 个单轴中 EOD 与显著疾病数的秩相关为 ρ=0.56（p=0.029），而用 R=EOD/MDE 标准化后升至 ρ=0.78（p=0.0005）；在 0/16 疾病达到显著的两个轴（年龄、性别）恰为 R 最低的两个轴（R=0.34、0.23），而所有至少达到一次显著的轴 R≥0.46；12/15 测试轴处于 R<1 的欠功效状态。(ii) Phase IV 后处理：阈值优化在 48/48 保持运行中降低 EOD，配对 Δ=−0.285（95% CI [−0.313,−0.252]，Wilcoxon p=3.1×10⁻⁵），AUC 几乎不损失（+0.004）；IPW+群组 Platt 缩放虽在 ECE 上更优（33/48 改善，Δ=−0.006，p=0.004），但在 EOD 上表现如抛硬币（19/48 改善，Clopper-Pearson CI [0.26,0.55]，配对 CI [−0.007,+0.024]，跨疾病 SD=0.033 vs 均值 0.009），应报告方差而非均值。(iii) Phase III 机制诊断：在受控生成器上 144/144 案例正确分类，但当代理列错配时 0/48 识别为模型驱动（36/48 输出"无材料差异"，12/48 错判为标签噪声），且不发出任何失败信号；混合机制下 21/48 与 27/48 近均匀分裂，不存在单一真标签。(iv) Phase V CUSUM 在 6σ 参考阈值下检测 40/48 注入漂移（平均滞后 2.50 窗，约 3,000 例患者），27 次误报；但 27 个误报全部来自种子 37，8 个漏检中 7 个来自种子 23（χ² p=0.002），阈值在一种 cohort 调好后无法迁移到另一种——自适应阈值在基线噪声最大的群体上恰好最高，使最该检测到的群体被错过。所有发现均基于合成数据，不构成临床有效性证据。

Conclusion: KAISEN 将审计拆解为可分别测试的阶段，并将每阶段推到失效点。论文给出三个可外推到真实数据的结构性结论：(1) 沉默失败是普遍模式——无显著轴与无材料差异结论必须与分辨力（n_min⁺、MDE、R 与代理集）一并发布；(2) 改进不可组合——校准与等错率目标方向不同，群组 Platt 缩放与阈值优化需分别匹配到决策真正依赖的指标；(3) 聚合会掩盖结果——应在配对运行层而非均值层报告缓解效果，在 ARL₀ 与检测率层面报告漂移监控。论文建议按决策上下文（30 天再入院=均衡漏检率；脓毒症预警=固定误报率下的均衡漏检率；院内死亡=分群 ECE 与 MCE）选择优先级指标；并以 MIMIC-IV 上的复制、真实漂移而非注入漂移的纵向评估、代理集预先登记并报告灵敏度范围的 Phase III 协议、与临床伙伴设计的前瞻性审计作为下一步。所有结果由脚本从提交工件生成，git commit、SHA-256 配置哈希、Python 版本与平台均记录于 run_metadata.json，对应 commit 46341ee0、配置哈希 4bb87ed0，固定种子 {11,23,37}。

Abstract: Clinical risk models routinely achieve strong aggregate performance while producing materially different error rates across patient subgroups. Audit pipelines have been proposed to catch this, but their components are rarely stress-tested, so it is unclear which parts of an audit can be trusted and under what conditions. We present KAISEN, a five-phase audit pipeline covering subgroup stratification, disparity measurement, mechanism diagnostics, post-hoc mitigation, and drift monitoring, evaluated to the point of failure on a synthetic benchmark of 16 disease tasks, 15 social-determinant axes from Healthy People 2030, and three prespecified intersections. Four findings follow. (i) Significance tracks each axis's gap against its own minimum detectable effect: rank correlation between significance count and raw equalized-odds difference (EOD) across the 15 axes is rho = 0.56, rising to rho = 0.78 once EOD is standardized by that floor. (ii) Per-group threshold optimization reduces EOD in 48 of 48 held-out runs (paired delta = -0.285, 95% CI [-0.313, -0.252]), while group-wise Platt scaling -- the better calibrator -- behaves as a coin flip on EOD (19 of 48 runs improved, 95% CI [0.26, 0.55]) with mean effect near zero, so what an audit should report is the variance, not the average. (iii) The mechanism diagnostic classifies 144 of 144 controlled cases correctly but recovers none of 48 model-driven cases under proxy misspecification, with no signal that it failed. (iv) CUSUM failures and false alarms track cohort realization far more than disease: at the reference threshold, all 27 false alarms and 7 of 8 missed shifts come from different seeds (chi-squared p = 0.002), so a threshold tuned on one cohort fails to transfer. All results are synthetic with known ground truth and do not establish clinical validity. Code, artifacts, and scripts reproducing every number are released.

</details>


<div id='cs.DS'></div>

# cs.DS [[Back]](#toc)

### [300] [Extended Depth-First Representations of $k^2$-trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28136)
*Gabriel Carmona,Paolo Ferragina,Giovanni Manzini,Francesco Tosoni*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文针对$k^2$-树传统层次布局（level-wise layout）缓存局部性差的问题，提出了四种深度优先（DF）表示方法：纯深度优先布局（EDF-1）、平衡括号布局（BP）及其压缩变体（CEDF、CBP），并基于后缀数组与LCP数组设计了线性时间的相同子树检测与压缩算法。在WebGraph、Wikidata和随机数据集上的矩阵-向量乘法、矩阵-矩阵加法与乘法实验表明：CEDF在多数场景下压缩率最优，EDF-1与CEDF峰值内存最低，不同操作的最佳布局各异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: $k^2$-树是稀疏二值矩阵的经典压缩表示，其传统层次遍历（广度优先）布局将树中位置相近的节点分散存储于内存远端，导致矩阵-向量、矩阵-矩阵等需要遍历整棵树的线性代数操作产生大量缓存未命中，严重影响计算效率。同时，层次布局将可能存在的相同子树（对应重复子矩阵）的编码散布在不同层级，难以高效识别与压缩。论文的核心动机即是通过重新组织内存布局来同时改善缓存局部性与重复子树的检测能力。

Method: （1）**四种深度优先表示**：
- *Plain Depth-First (PDF/EDF-1)*：按深度优先顺序重排节点描述符，对每个内部节点输出其$k^2$个孩子的位块；
- *Enriched Depth-First (EDF)*：在EDF-1基础上，为大于阈值$\tau$的子树存储"skip"值以支持$O(\tau)$时间的子树跳转；
- *Balanced Parenthesis (BP)*：基于Munro-Raman括号编码，将末层叶子值分离到独立向量$L'$，并提出两层（enriched节点+excess分块）方案以支持快速find_close；
- *DFUDS（基线）*：Fariña等人基于深度优先一元度序列的表示。

（2）**线性时间子树压缩**：利用后缀数组（SA）与LCP数组在序列$B$或$P'$中检测最大可互换（BP）或最大相同（PDF）子树，将被剪枝子树替换为引用指针。BP采用`(()())`模式、PDF采用`0000`块作为占位符，避免引入额外辅助位向量。

（3）**复杂度分析**：通过Lemma 1–7给出各表示的空间上界（均包含$o(\cdot)$辅助项）与子树遍历时间（恒定时间或$O(\tau)$）。

Result: 实验在三类数据集上对比六种实现（K2-TREE、K2-DFUDS、K2-EDF-1、K2-CEDF、K2-BP、K2-CBP）：
- **磁盘空间**：CEDF在WebGraph（除AM-2008外）和Database几乎所有矩阵上取得最优比特数/非零元；EDF-1次之；DFUDS、BP、CBP空间开销较大，BP在随机稀疏矩阵上膨胀显著。
- **峰值内存**：EDF-1与CEDF在矩阵-矩阵加法和乘法中始终最低，主要因深度优先布局避免了K2-TREE合并所需的辅助队列。
- **运行时间**：矩阵-向量乘法中EDF-1几乎在所有数据集上最快；矩阵-矩阵加法中K2-DFUDS最快；矩阵-矩阵乘法中无单一优胜者——K2-TREE在极稀疏矩阵上优（rank操作高效），K2-DFUDS在WebGraph上整体最快（常数时间子树跳过），EDF-1/CEDF在密集矩阵或大量子树遍历场景中具有竞争力。SUB+DYN（动态skip计算）变体在大矩阵上显著优于纯SUB变体。K2-BP/K2-CBP在大多数场景下最慢且内存最高。

Conclusion: 论文证明深度优先布局是$k^2$-树传统层次布局的实用且高效的替代方案，能在压缩率与计算性能两方面同时带来改进。CEDF在压缩率上几乎全面胜出，EDF-1与CEDF在峰值内存上一致最优；不同操作的最佳选择因工作负载而异。论文扩展了会议版本，新增了矩阵-向量乘法与矩阵-矩阵加法的实验以及空间/时间复杂度的理论分析。未来工作包括：利用子树重复优化矩阵操作、引入更紧凑的DF表示、为K2-DFUDS添加子树压缩、实现并行版本，以及研究深度优先布局对能耗的影响。

Abstract: In this paper, we study static, computation-friendly, lossless compression formats for graphs, focusing on memory locality and operational efficiency of $k^2$-trees. We observe that their traditional level-wise layouts suffer from poor cache performance due to weak locality, especially in operations such as matrix-vector and matrix-matrix operations. To address this limitation, we propose four depth-first representations of $k^2$-trees: a plain depth-first layout (EDF-1), a balanced-parenthesis representation (BP), and their compressed variants (CEDF and CBP). We further introduce a linear-time compression method based on suffix and LCP arrays to identify and compress identical subtrees. We experimentally evaluate the execution time, the disk space, and the peak-memory usage of our approaches against classical level-wise $k^2$-trees and DFUDS-based representations across two real and one synthetic dataset (i.e., Web Graphs, Wikidata, and random adjacency matrices) over the above linear-algebra operations. Results show that our depth-first layouts are competitive and often superior than known approaches: CEDF achieves the best compression in most settings, EDF-1 and CEDF reduce the peak memory usage consistently, and performance varies by workload, with different layouts excelling in different operations and data regimes. Overall, this work demonstrates that depth-first layouts of $k^2$-trees provide a practical and efficient alternative to traditional layouts, improving both compression and computational performance in matrix operations.

</details>


### [301] [Improved RIP Bounds for Gaussian Partial Circulant Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27676)
*Zhao Song*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文针对高斯部分循环矩阵（Gaussian partial circulant matrices）的限制等距性质（Restricted Isometry Property, RIP）改进了所需的采样复杂度下界，将Krahmer–Mendelson–Rauhut (KMR) 界中因子 $\log(2N)$ 的一个替换为 $\log(em)$，从而在 $\log m = o(\log N)$ 的参数范围内获得严格的渐近改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 压缩感知中，独立亚高斯矩阵的RIP基准采样复杂度为 $m \asymp K\log(eN/K)$。核心问题是：在强代数依赖结构下，这一标度能否保持？高斯部分循环矩阵是一类极端刚性的测试对象——其行是单一高斯向量的平移依赖副本。此前KMR利用泛型链方法在任意固定行集设定下获得了 $m \gtrsim \delta^{-2} K\log^2(eK)\log^2(2N)$ 的线性-in-$K$的界，但其中含两个 $\log N$ 因子。作者旨在证明其中一个 $\log(2N)$ 可以被 $\log(em)$ 取代，从而在稀疏参数 $m$ 远小于 $N$ 的尺度下改善界。

Method: 证明的核心技巧是对粗尺度熵估计的精化，绕开传统的Fourier $\ell_\infty$ 上界路径：
1. **算子度量保留**：直接处理部分循环矩阵 $V_z = m^{-1/2}R_\Omega C_z$，而非先控制 $\|Fz\|_\infty$。
2. **Schatten矩估计**：对 $u_1,\ldots,u_L \in U = \{\pm e_j\}$，利用矩阵 $B_\ell = R_\Omega C_{u_\ell}$ 的性质，得到 $(\sum B_\ell B_\ell^*)^{1/2}$ 和 $(\sum B_\ell^* B_\ell)^{1/2}$ 的 $S_p$ 范数均受 $\sqrt{L}\,m^{1/p}$ 控制。
3. **非交换Khintchine不等式**：取 $p = 2\log(em)$，得到Rademacher和的算子范数界 $C\sqrt{L\log(em)}$，关键之处是选取的 $p$ 依赖于 $m$ 而非环境维数 $N$。
4. **Maurey经验法+对称化**：结合 $V_z$ 的线性结构，对 $\mathcal{D}_{K,N}$ 在尺度 $u$ 下的覆盖数得到 $\log \mathcal{N} \lesssim (\Delta/u)^2 \log(2N)\log(em)$。
5. **细尺度覆盖**：对每个固定支撑使用体积覆盖加并集界，得到标准的 $K\log(eN/K) + K\log(1+C\Delta/u)$。
6. **Dudley熵积分+混沌过程框架**：应用KMR的混沌估计完成最终RIP界的证明。

Result: 主定理（Theorem 1.3）：存在通用常数 $C>0$，对任意 $1 \le K \le m \le N$，任意固定 $\Omega \subset \mathbb{Z}_N$（$|\Omega|=m$），以及 $g \sim \mathcal{N}(0,I_N)$，对所有 $\delta,\eta \in (0,1)$，当
$$m \ge C\delta^{-2} K \max\{\log^2(eK)\log(2N)\log(em),\ \log(2/\eta)\}$$
时，$A_\Omega(g)$ 以概率至少 $1-\eta$ 满足 $K$-阶RIP，常数至多为 $\delta$。
对比KMR的 $m \gtrsim \delta^{-2}K\log^2(eK)\log^2(2N)$：
- **固定 $K=O(1)$**：从 $m=O(\log^2 N)$ 改进至 $m=O(\log N\log\log N)$。
- **$K=(\log N)^q$**：充分取 $m=O(K\log N(\log\log N)^3)$。
- 当 $\log m = o(\log N)$ 时获得严格渐近改进；当 $K=N^\alpha$（$0<\alpha<1$）时对数阶相同。

Conclusion: 本文通过精化Maurey熵估计步骤，将非交换Khintchine不等式与受 $m$ 控制的Schatten矩估计相结合，成功地将KMR高斯部分循环矩阵RIP界中一个 $\log(2N)$ 因子替换为 $\log(em)$。这在任意固定行集（arbitrary fixed row sets）的更强量化顺序下成立，不依赖随机行的平均化。改进在 $\log m = o(\log N)$ 范围内渐近非平凡，为具有强代数依赖结构的矩阵的压缩感知理论提供了更精细的样本复杂度刻画。

Abstract: We prove an improved restricted isometry bound for Gaussian partial circulant matrices with arbitrary prescribed sampling sets. There is a universal constant $C>0$ such that the following holds. Let $1\leq K\leq m\leq N$ be positive integers, let $\Omega\subset\mathbb Z_N$ be any fixed set with $|\Omega|=m$, and let $g\sim\mathcal N(0,I_N)$. For every $\delta,\eta\in(0,1)$, the normalized partial circulant matrix generated by $g$ has the RIP of order $K$ with constant at most $\delta$, with probability at least $1-\eta$ over the draw of $g$, provided \[ m\geq C\delta^{-2}K \max\{\log^2(eK)\log(2N)\log(em),\log(2/\eta)\}. \] The proof refines the Maurey entropy step in the chaos-process argument by combining a noncommutative Khintchine inequality with a Schatten moment estimate controlled by $m$, replacing one factor $\log(2N)$ in the Krahmer--Mendelson--Rauhut bound by $\log(em)$.

</details>


### [302] [A Graph Matching Based Approach for the Multi-Depot Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27727)
*Jayant Chandwani,Pranav M R,Anand Jat,Anshu Ostwal,Diptendu Chatterjee,Anand Narasimhamurthy*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文针对多车场带容量车辆路径问题(MDCVRP)，提出两种基于图匹配（最小权完美匹配/Blossom算法）的近似算法——Cluster-First和Match-First，将车辆路径问题转化为一系列最小权匹配问题。理论上证明在每条路径最多服务2个目标客户的场景下，匹配方法可在多项式时间内求得精确最优解，且两种算法均为常数因子（紧因子为2）近似；实验表明在1000客户、20车场的大规模实例上，匹配方法在路径长度上匹配甚至略优于强基线组合拍卖方法，同时速度快2-3个数量级（毫秒级 vs 十秒级）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MDCVRP是NP-hard问题，实际求解器必须在解的质量与速度之间权衡。现有方法如聚类优先+OR-Tools、深度强化学习等存在可扩展性差或训练昂贵的问题，难以应对大规模和动态变化的实际场景。因此需要在保持近似最优解的同时大幅提升计算效率，并支持新客户到达时的廉价重路由。

Method: 将MDCVRP建模为完全图上的最小权匹配问题（使用Edmonds Blossom算法/LEMON实现）：(1)Cluster-First：先将每个目标分配到最近车场，再在各车场集群内独立做最小权匹配生成二客户巡回，未匹配目标作为单客户巡回；(2)Match-First：先对全部目标做全局最小权匹配，再将各配对组分配到其质心最近的车场。引入MatchAndMerge迭代合并过程以支持最多4个目标的巡回。定义了三种场景：场景1(需求≤C/2,tour size≤2)、场景2(tour size不限)、场景3(需求≤C,tour size≤2)。基线为组合拍卖方法(CA-ILP和CA-MIS两种实现)。所有方法用C++实现。

Result: 理论结果：(1)Tour size≤2时匹配方法可在O(n²K+n³)时间内求解精确最优解（Theorem B.15）；(2)Cluster-First和Match-First均为2-近似且因子2紧；(3)Cluster-First在场景2下为4-近似（也紧）；(4)匹配最优与精确组合拍卖最优一致，使拍卖成为强基线。实验结果：基础数据集(100目标,10车场)上，Scenario 3中CA-ILP路径均值5305但耗时479ms，而Match-First和Cluster-First分别为5411和5626（差距2-6%），仅需4.8ms和3.3ms；可扩展性数据集(1000目标,20车场)上，匹配方法在路径长度上略优于CA-MIS（约短2-4%），而速度快2-3个数量级（Cluster-First 69-83ms，Match-First约1.1s vs CA-MIS 31-37s），CA-ILP在此规模下无法完成。Cluster-First支持仅重路由受影响集群，利于动态场景。

Conclusion: 图匹配方法为MDCVRP提供了接近最优且极快的解决方案，将NP-hard问题在tour size≤2这一可处理边界上归结为匹配问题。匹配最优与精确组合拍卖最优的一致性表明拍卖是真正强基线。算法在1000客户20车场规模下仍保持毫秒级响应，且天然支持动态增量更新。未来方向包括：将近似保证扩展到更大tour size，弥合场景2和3的实现-理论差距，处理异构车队和时间窗约束，在标准MDVRP基准库上验证，以及将匹配路由作为拍卖/搜索求解器的廉价内层循环。

Abstract: The Multi-Depot Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (MDCVRP) asks for minimum-cost delivery tours from several capacitated depots to a set of customers. Like most vehicle-routing variants it is NP-hard, so practical solvers must trade solution quality against speed. We revisit this trade-off through the lens of graph matching. Adapting a matching-based construction first developed for the Traveling Tournament Problem, we present two algorithms, Cluster-First and Match-First, that reduce routing to a sequence of minimum-weight matchings. This is more than a heuristic. We prove that for tours of up to two targets the matching formulation solves the MDCVRP exactly in polynomial time for any number of depots, and that both algorithms are constant-factor approximations, with a tight factor of two, in the structured regimes. This matching optimum coincides with the exact combinatorial-auction optimum, so the auction serves as a strong quality baseline. On instances of 1000 customers and 20 depots our methods match or slightly beat that baseline in tour length while running two to three orders of magnitude faster, in tens of milliseconds against tens of seconds, a scale at which exact and auction-based solvers become impractical. Because Cluster-First routes each depot independently, the approach also re-routes cheaply when new customers arrive.

</details>


### [303] [Approximate Dual Separation for the Cluster LP: a 1.387 approximation for Correlation Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27829)
*David García-Soriano,Antoine Schohn*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文针对完全图上的相关性聚类（Correlation Clustering）问题，给出了 (1.3865+ε)-近似算法，将此前 Cao 等人（STOC'24）的 1.485+ε 最佳结果改进至接近已知的 4/3 下界。文章提出两项独立贡献：(1) Cluster LP 对偶的近似分离 oracle（EPTAS 算法）；(2) 基于连续条件枢轴规则的新型舍入方案，通过单一显式方差不等式加计算机辅助验证，证明 Cluster LP 的整数间隙处于 [4/3, 1.3865] 的窄区间内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
